name: Tip Tracker: Server Income
description:
Know what you really make. Tip Tracker is a private tip tracker and shift log for people who work for tips. Log a shift in seconds — hours, cash, card — and see your real hourly rate the moment you save it.

WHAT IT DOES
Most apps stop at "how much did you make tonight". This tip tracker answers the harder question: what did that shift actually pay you per hour, after you tipped out? Enter your hours and your server tips, add your tip-out and your base wage, and it does the arithmetic you would otherwise be doing in your head at 1am.

• Log a shift in seconds — hours, cash tips, card tips, tip-out
• Your effective hourly rate: base wage + tips − tip-out, over hours worked
• Track income by shift, by week and by month
• Watch your hourly rate trend across shifts as one smoothed line
• Find your best nights — which shifts actually pay, by day of the week
• A full income history you can browse as a list or on a calendar
• More than one job, each with its own wage and its own numbers
• Export your shift log as a CSV whenever you want it
• Optional tip percentage, if you log your sales

HOW IT WORKS
1. Add where you work, and your base wage if you get one.
2. At the end of the night, open the app and enter your hours and your tips.
3. Save. You immediately see what you kept and what it worked out to per hour.
4. Come back next shift. Two shifts in, you can compare them.

THE AFTER-MIDNIGHT RULE
A shift that ends at 1:40am belongs to the night that started yesterday. Between midnight and 6am this tip log files a new entry under the previous day automatically — so your week totals, your income tracker and your day-of-week stats stay right without you thinking about it. The date is always editable.

WHY THE HOURLY RATE
Two hundred dollars is a great night on a five-hour Friday and an ordinary one on a twelve-hour double. Totals alone can't tell you which shifts to ask for, which sections pay, or whether the new schedule is actually better. An hourly rate can. That is why this server tip tracker leads with the rate on every screen and draws the trend of it over time.

YOUR HISTORY, KEPT PROPERLY
Every shift you log stays. Browse your server tips as a running list or as a month calendar where the busier nights sit darker, so a season's shape is visible at a glance. Weekly and monthly summaries add up hours, tips and what you kept, and each one carries its own rate so you can compare a slow February against a good July honestly. Nothing expires and nothing is trimmed.

WHO IT IS FOR
Servers and waitresses. Bartenders and barbacks. Baristas, hosts and bussers. Delivery drivers and couriers. Hair stylists, barbers and nail techs. Valets, bellhops, casino dealers, catering and banquet staff. Anyone whose income arrives as tips and whose paycheck never tells the whole story.

A REAL INCOME LOG, FASTER THAN A SPREADSHEET
Built for a phone in a server station, not a desk. Every number in this income tracker is one you typed: nothing is estimated, nothing is averaged against other people, and nothing is filled in for you. The tip log adds it up and shows you the result — that's the whole product.

PRIVATE AND OFFLINE
Your data stays on your device — no account, no cloud. There is no sign-in and no server, so your shift log works with no signal at all: a basement bar, a walk-in, a parking garage. Your shifts are never uploaded anywhere. No ads, ever.

EVERYTHING IN ONE PLACE
Your shifts, your jobs, your rates and your whole history live in one app that opens instantly and works anywhere. Pick up a second job and its numbers stay separate from the first. Export a CSV of your own records whenever you want one — it is your data and it stays yours. This shift log is quick enough to fill in while you are cashing out, and detailed enough that it still makes sense a year later when you are looking back at a whole season of server tips.

For your personal records only — not tax, accounting, or financial advice.

DOWN TO EARTH, NOT OVERBUILT

• Role weights — servers 1.0, bar 0.8, runners 0.5 — whatever your house rule is.
• Tip-outs — pull a percentage off the top for the kitchen, bar, or support before the pool is split.
• Overrides — bump someone up for a great night, adjust for a mid-shift role change, or exclude a no-show, all with a note attached.
• Templates — save the shift structures you run every week so setup takes seconds.

WHAT'S INSIDE

Dashboard — today's tips, active shifts, and recent settlements at a glance.

Staff & Groups — add employees, assign roles, and group them (servers, bar, kitchen, support). Bulk import from a spreadsheet if you're switching over.

Shifts — build shifts from templates or on the fly. Import daily sales sheets or tip totals so you're not retyping POS numbers.

Settlements — run a settlement for any shift. Tip+ shows the source tips, the formula, and the per-person breakdown. Nothing hidden.

Audit Logs — every edit, every settlement, every override is captured so nothing gets quietly changed after the fact.

Multi-location — run more than one restaurant from a single account and switch in one tap.

Languages — English and Simplified Chinese.

BUILT FOR THE MESSY REALITY

Split shifts, mid-shift role changes, a bartender who covered a section for an hour, a no-show, a comp that changes the tip pool — Tip+ handles the awkward stuff without breaking the audit trail. Because that's the actual job.

WHY TIP+

• Fair — every split is transparent and the math is visible.
• Fast — close a shift in minutes.
• Flexible — your rules, not ours.
• Trustworthy — full audit log so staff and owners both know the numbers weren't fudged.

PRIVACY

Your data stays yours. We don't sell employee or tip information.

Stop fighting a rigid calculator. Download Tip+ and split tips the way your restaurant actually does it.

description:

Hub Gig Reader is an independent driver-assistance tool built for delivery and gig drivers. It scans supported on-screen offers, applies your preferences, and reads matching opportunities aloud so you can decide what deserves your attention.

KEY FEATURES

• Notification Mode
Filter supported notifications from services such as Bunji, Frayt, and Curri and receive a timely spoken alert.

• Driver-focused controls
Start, pause, and adjust your filters around your schedule.

HOW IT WORKS

Choose your filters, enable the features you want, and let Hub Gig Reader monitor supported offer information. When a gig matches, the app announces the details. You remain in control of reviewing and responding to every opportunity.

ACCESSIBILITY SERVICE DISCLOSURE

Hub Gig Reader uses Android’s AccessibilityService API to read gig details displayed in supported apps and to automate repetitive search steps. This access is required for the Roadie scanning feature. The app does not use AccessibilityService to make purchases, accept gigs, or change account settings.

OTHER PERMISSIONS

• Notification access: reads supported delivery-app notifications for filtering and alerts.
• Display over other apps: shows optional floating controls.
• Internet and network state: supports secure processing for Notification Mode.
• Exact alarms: schedules timely searches when enabled.
• Vibration: provides alert feedback.

PRIVACY

Hub Gig Reader does not sell personal information. When Notification Mode uses AI extraction, notification text may be sent temporarily to a third-party AI service to identify gig details. Review the app’s privacy policy for complete information.

Hub Gig Reader is an independent tool and is not affiliated with or endorsed by Roadie, Bunji, Frayt, Curri, or their owners. Availability and behavior may change when supported apps update.

name: Truck Weight Calculator
description:
Truck Weight Calculator helps you slide tandems, estimate axle weights, and stay legal—fast.
Using a platform and cat scale has never been easier. You can offset scale readings and weighing in or out of the scale.

Sliding trailer axles to the right hole eliminates guesswork and saves time and money on re-weighing. You can specify your load arrangement and weight distribution to make axle slide calculations more precise.
This helps ensure compliance at truck weigh stations, reduces the risk of overweight fines, and gives you peace of mind before rolling in. Think of it as your backup plan—built to keep you safe, legal, and confident on the road.

If you're overweight on an axle, the app helps you fix it—when possible. That might mean sliding axles to the right hole, burning off excess fuel before reaching the weigh station, adjusting the fifth wheel, or simply knowing your state’s weight regulations.

Estimating axle weight is a premium feature that lets you calculate axle weights before you even reach the scale. The app uses the gross weight of the load (payload) from your Bill of Lading and your load arrangement to make accurate predictions. It’s useful in all kinds of everyday trucking scenarios.

If there’s no scale nearby, you can set your axles in the hole with the highest chance of being compliant—no guessing required. You’ll get a calculated solution that gives you peace of mind, especially when hauling lighter loads and unsure if scaling is necessary. The estimator helps you analyze different scenarios and pick the safest hole.
Plus, you can spot load arrangement issues ahead of time—while you're still being loaded.

Whether you're hauling pallets or equipment, Truck Weight Calculator helps you stay legal, save time, and optimize your load. Core features are free, and premium tools are available via in-app purchase.

Truck Weight Calculator supports 53' (16m) and 48' (14.6m) trailers (cooler, dry-van, flatbed) with 2–3 axles and axle splits up to 11'6". While designed for palletized loads, it can also provide rough estimates for equipment on flatbeds—making it a versatile truck axle weight calculator for real-world scenarios.

Built for drivers, by those who understand the road. Whether you're scaling, planning, or adjusting on the fly, Truck Weight Calculator keeps you compliant, confident, and moving forward.

Features:

Bridge Scale Axle Calculation – Instantly compute steering, drive, and trailer weights as you roll over bridge scales

Tandem Hole Guidance – Get recommendations for sliding trailer tandems to the correct hole after scaling

Fuel Optimizer – Know exactly how much fuel to add or burn to stay within legal truck axle weight limits

Estimate axle weights using payload from the Bill of Lading and load arrangement—no scale required

name: Drivers' Hours: HGV & Van
description:
Plan your day against EU 561/2006 drivers' hours and UK Working Time (RTD 2005) rules — in real time, on your phone, with no subscription.

Built for both classic HGV work and the newer 2.5–3.5t international vans now in scope with a tachograph. If you're a courier or delivery driver touching a tacho for the first time, this gives you the same live timers, warnings and correction flow HGV drivers already rely on.

Tap Driving, Rest, Other work or Availability and Drivers' Hours does the maths:

- Countdown to your next 45-minute break (4h30 continuous driving), with 15+30 split breaks handled in the correct order.
- Daily driving left — 9 hours, or 10 hours on your two allowed days a week.
- This week (56h) and rolling two-week (90h) driving left.
- Daily rest and weekly rest deadlines (the 6 x 24-hour rule), counting down.
- Working Time (WTD) hours this week against the 60-hour individual-week limit, with cumulative break reminders (30 min after 6h, 45 min after 9h).
- A 17-week rolling WTD average against the 48-hour limit — most apps don't track this at all.
- Clear amber and red warnings before you run out — plus optional reminders that fire even when the app is closed.

Built for UK drivers: dd/mm/yyyy dates, a 24-hour clock and plain English — not the American mm/dd that other apps get wrong.

Forgot to switch mode? Every change is a single tap to correct on the timeline.

No subscription. A one-off purchase removes ads and unlocks PDF and CSV export of your log. Live status, timers and reminders are always free.

Your driving log stays on your device — no account, no cloud, no card reader, no tachograph download. (The free tier shows ads, which use an advertising identifier.)

Important — please read
This app is a planning aid, not the legal record. Your digital tachograph card and the data downloaded from it remain the only official record of your hours. Figures here are estimates from what you enter and can differ from the tacho analysis. The Working Time 48-hour figure is a rolling average over your last 17 recorded weeks; your employer's fixed reference period (17 weeks, or 26 by agreement) may differ, so treat it as a guide. Always check the tachograph.

For 2.5–3.5t vans: this app is for jobs that are actually in scope of EU 561/2006. It does not create an exemption and it does not replace the legal check on whether the van, route and carriage type require a tachograph.

FMCSA-compliant app to record driver duty status and meet the following regulations:

Drive Hours is a clean and intuitive application created for learner drivers who want to track their driving lessons and monitor progress toward obtaining a driver’s license. The app allows you to log every driving session, keep track of completed hours, and clearly see how close you are to reaching your goal. All information is presented in a simple and readable way, helping you stay organized throughout your driving course.

The application focuses on progress tracking through clear visual indicators and real-time statistics. Managing driving sessions is fast and straightforward. Each session can be added using an intuitive date and time picker, allowing you to record both hours and minutes accurately. The full history of driving sessions is always available, and previously saved entries can be edited or deleted if changes are needed. Sessions can also be categorized by license type, making it easy to stay organized even when tracking multiple courses.

Drive Hours provides helpful insights into your driving habits. Weekly activity overviews and calculated averages help you understand your learning patterns and consistency. The app also estimates how many days remain until completion based on your activity, allowing you to plan your lessons more effectively and maintain steady progress.

To keep you motivated, Drive Hours includes an achievement system that rewards progress throughout your course. Milestones such as the first recorded hour, halfway completion, and final achievement help visualize success and encourage regular practice. Achievements are dynamically adapted to your selected license category, giving you a clear sense of advancement.

The design of Drive Hours emphasizes simplicity and modern usability. The interface follows Material Design principles, offering smooth animations, intuitive navigation, and an edge-to-edge layout for an immersive experience. The app supports light mode, dark mode, and system-based themes, ensuring comfortable use in any environment. Its responsive layout adapts well to different screen sizes while remaining easy to use.

The app automatically detects your system language, and you can also change the language manually in the settings at any time. This makes the application accessible to a broader range of users without additional configuration.

Drive Hours is designed for learner drivers preparing for their driving test, students tracking mandatory driving hours, instructors helping learners stay organized, and anyone who wants a clear overview of their driving practice. Unlike complicated tracking tools, Drive Hours focuses on clarity, elegance, and ease of use, making it effortless to log sessions and understand progress at a glance.

Getting started is simple. Choose your driving license category, set your required number of hours, and begin adding driving sessions. As you continue, you can watch your progress grow and unlock achievements along the way.

If you encounter any issues or have suggestions for improvement, support is available through the app settings or by leaving feedback on Google Play.

Download Drive Hours today and take full control of your driving lessons and learning progress.

Generate personalised pupil reports from each student's marks and attendance. Smart Teacher writes natural, detailed report comments you can edit and share, saving hours every report season.

Every pupil has a page: attendance, marks, reports and notes together, so you can see pupil progress across the term and answer a parent's question in seconds. A student tracker for teachers that fills itself in as you teach.

📆 TODAY & YOUR SCHOOL TIMETABLE
Open the app and Today shows your day: which classes, which rooms, what needs marking, whose birthday it is. Your weekly timetable, month view and agenda are one tap away, like a teacher assistant that has already read your timetable.

💬 CONNECT: PARENT & STUDENT COMMUNICATION
Share announcements, updates and photos with parents and students through Connect. Post to your class feed and keep families informed.

🏫 CLASSROOM MANAGEMENT
Import your classes from a spreadsheet or add them by hand, add students, and keep grades, attendance, reports and notes for every class under one roof. Classroom management without the admin.

📤 EXPORT & SHARE
Export grades, attendance and lesson plans to CSV. Share reports with colleagues, parents or your school.

👩‍🏫 BUILT FOR REAL TEACHERS
Smart Teacher was designed by a former classroom teacher who understands the daily pressures of teaching. Primary, secondary, tutor or homeschool educator, this app fits the way you actually work.

📚 A more flexible teaching workflow—alongside your SIS

Your school or district SIS is the official system of record. Teacher Gradebook gives you a flexible daily workspace for the teaching work behind those records: grading, assessment, attendance, lesson planning, notes, student progress, and reports.

Use it alongside the SIS your school requires. Calculate and analyze grades your way, collect assessment evidence, and prepare the information you later enter into the official system. Teacher Gradebook works independently: it does not replace or automatically sync with your SIS.

Tired of juggling spreadsheets, paper notes, calendars, and multiple SIS screens? Bring your daily classroom workflow together in one organized app.

👨‍🏫 Built by a teacher, for teachers

Teacher Gradebook was created by a classroom teacher who understands the realities of teaching. It is intuitive, visual, and flexible, so you can adapt it to your grading system without being a technology expert.

📊 Grade and assess your way

• Enter numeric grades, text, icons, and visual ratings
• Calculate simple or weighted averages
• Create custom formulas and calculated columns
• Configure weights, rounding, and reassessments
• Use rubrics, checklists, and rating scales
• Create editable rubrics with AI assistance
• Assess students individually or in teams
• Add comments and observations
• Export grades and reports to PDF or CSV

Teacher Gradebook adapts to your assessment approach instead of forcing your classroom into a rigid template. Every result remains clear, editable, and traceable.

📅 Organize your classroom

• Track attendance, absences, tardies, and incidents
• Create seating charts and take attendance directly from the chart
• Manage class schedules and non-instructional days
• Plan lessons, class sessions, and instructional units
• Add reminders and view upcoming sessions
• Keep a class journal by date, class, or student
• Store student profiles, contacts, photos, notes, and files
• Import student rosters from CSV files

Your grades, attendance, planner, journal, and student profiles share the same information, so you do not have to enter the same data repeatedly.

📈 See progress clearly

Review grades, attendance, ungraded activities, and classroom notes without rebuilding everything at the end of a grading period.

• Individual student and whole-class reports
• Grade charts and statistics
• Attendance and class journal reports
• Edit compatible grades and comments directly from the Grade Report
• Create editable AI-assisted narrative reports before exporting

🔒 Private, offline, and under your control

Your academic data is stored encrypted on your device. You can do your core classroom work without an Internet connection and protect access to the app with a password.

Student information is not stored on the developer’s servers. Optional cloud backups go directly to your own Google Drive, Dropbox, or OneDrive account. You can also configure automatic backups and choose where your information is stored.

🎨 Make it yours

Customize colors, icons, columns, layouts, and table styles. Use light or dark mode and work comfortably on both phones and tablets.

Keep your required SIS as the official record. Use Teacher Gradebook as your personal, flexible workspace for the daily work that official grades are built on.

Spend less time managing spreadsheets and administrative tasks—and more time teaching and supporting your students.

More information and tutorials:
https://cuadernodelprofesor.com

A: Sometimes. Grade Corner was built independently by a parent with two kids in DC Public Schools. We're working on more official endorsements — the current list lives on our website.

name: Student Gradebook for Teachers
description:
Student Gradebook for Teachers is a secure, offline-first gradebook designed for educators, teachers, and instructors who need a reliable way to manage student records and calculate academic performance. Built to handle complex grading rules entirely on your device, this app streamlines classroom administrative workflows without requiring any internet connection.

Key Features:

Flexible Weighting and Columns
Set up customized evaluations such as assignments, homework, quizzes, midterms, and final exams. Define the maximum possible marks for each evaluation and customize weight configurations (including partial-weight distributions) to match your curriculum requirements.

Excel-Style Grading Formulas
Take control of letter grade assignments using nested IF formulas. You can input customized grade scale thresholds directly into the system to automate letter grade calculations based on your school’s unique grading framework.

Efficient Mark Entry and Fast Grading
Input records quickly using a streamlined interface. The rapid-grade entry mode displays your roster sequentially with specialized sliders, allowing you to quickly save grades for a large student cohort in a single session.

Dynamic Grade Curving
Apply statistical curves directly to classroom marks. Utilize flat boost increments clamped to the total possible weight, or use scaled curving proportional to the highest-scoring student to balance class score distributions automatically.

Detailed Class Analytics
Understand cohort performance instantly with automated statistical visualizations. Access class averages, pass rates, highest and lowest scores, letter grade distributions, student performance lists, and highlighted rosters of cohorts requiring academic support.

Strict Local Privacy and Security
Your student data belongs to you. Student Gradebook for Teachers operates with zero network requirements and zero data collection. All rosters, classes, marks, and formulas are securely stored locally inside an encrypted sandbox database on your mobile device.

Local Backup
Export class lists or share data across devices using local JSON backups. All backup and share processes are executed locally using standard secure device framework protocols.

- Increase or decrease text size to fit your classroom or your eyes
- Half Points mode adds support for half-credit answers, so partial credit doesn't send you back to a calculator
- Choose from multiple app icons to personalize how Easy Grade looks on your home screen

Easy Grade is a true EZ Grader replacement: no more searching for the cardboard slider, no more manual percentage math, no more grading scale charts taped to your desk. Enter the numbers and get your score.

Easy Grade is free to use with ads. Premium removes ads for a distraction-free grading experience, and Half Points unlocks half-credit scoring for teachers who grade that way.

Your data stays yours. Easy Grade does not share your data with third parties, and everything is encrypted in transit.

Whether you're grading tests, quizzes, or homework, Easy Grade, the EZ grader app, makes it fast and simple to turn right and wrong answers into an accurate percentage score for every student.

Feature highlights:
- Teacher Diary: Record your daily class activities, periods, topics, attendance, and notes. Build a complete day-to-day log of your teaching work that you can revisit anytime.
- Lesson Plans: Create lesson plans manually using the in-app editor, or use AI to auto-generate a complete lesson plan from a single photo of your textbook page. Up to 20 AI-generated lesson plans per month are included.
- Document Saver: Scan your degrees, certificates, joining letters, transcripts, ID cards, and any official documents using your phone camera. Files are saved locally on your device, so you can access them anytime, even without internet.
- Service Record: Store your appointment letters, transfer orders, postings, and complete government service history in one place. Find any old document in seconds.
- Student Documents: Students can save their degrees, transcripts, certificates, ID cards, and exam papers — all in one secure place.
- Backup and Restore: Export your data to a backup file whenever you want, and restore it on a new device. You stay in full control of where your information goes.

Privacy and security:
- All your documents are encrypted with AES-256 encryption.
- Your documents are stored on your device and never uploaded to our servers.
- Internet is required only when using the AI lesson plan feature; all other features work fully offline.
- Lock the app with a PIN or biometric (fingerprint or face) to keep your information private.

• Weekly recap: a plain-language read on what made the week hard or good, with trends against last week, the last 3 months and the last 6 months — from your own logs, on your phone

• Unlimited people and unlimited history
Invite a friend from the app and you both get 30 days of Nello+.

A DAY WITH NELLO
Morning: two taps on how the night went. After school: the meltdown that came out of nowhere gets captured as ABC while you still remember it. Bedtime: one win in the jar. None of it takes a minute, because an autism tracker you have to sit down for is one you stop using by Thursday.

BUILT FOR THE PEOPLE WHO ASK "WHY?"
The point of an autism behavior tracker is not the log — it is the pattern underneath it. Nello reads back what you entered: how often the hard moments follow a transition, which triggers and settings come up most, and whether this week was harder or calmer than the weeks before. You stop guessing, and you walk into appointments with one page a professional can read in thirty seconds.

FOR AUTISTIC TEENS AND ADULTS
Self-tracking mode is not an afterthought bolted onto an autism parent app. Log your own sensory load, shutdowns and glimmers in your own words. Nothing frames autistic traits as deficits, and nothing is shared unless you share it.

PRIVACY, PLAINLY
No account, no cloud. Your autism journal and its patterns stay on your phone, and nothing about you or your child is sold or shared.

THE SEARCH TERMS WE WERE BUILT FOR
Autism tracker. Autism behavior tracker. Meltdown tracker. Autism journal. Sensory tracker. ABC behavior tracker. Autism parenting app. An autism sensory diary that respects you and your child — in English, German, Spanish, French, Italian, Japanese, Dutch, Polish and Portuguese.

name: Planit: Photo Planner
description:
In this free version, the Ephemeris feature is provided as an in-app purchase. After the purchase, it will be the same as the paid PlanIt Pro. Some screenshots listed here have Ephemeris features enabled. The free version can actually do a lot of things than you thought. It is a plan/marker file reader, a focal length estimator on the map, a DoF and panorama calculator and can even preview the aerial view for your drone. The Ephemeris feature is so highly integrated that it is hard for us to provide some of them in the free version and ask you to pay for the rest. You can see how many users give us a one-star rating simply because we didn't provide a trial. I think that's not fair. But as we said, although we didn't provide a trial, please feel free to purchase to try it. We can refund you at any time if you don't like it.

Please email info@planitphoto.com for bug reports or feature requests. Please also remember to visit https://youtu.be/JFpSi1u0-is for more video tutorials. Each video only lasts a few minutes but you will sure learn a lot from them. You can also reach us through Instagram or Facebook. Links are under the menu inside the app.

This is a special call to landscape photographers, travel photographers, nature photographers and those who are interested in night photography, city photography, time-lapse, star-trails, milky way or astro-photography: look no more, this is the ultimate app for you - the Planit Pro. It only costs you a cup of Frappuccino but will save you tons of time and effort and a lot of gas money. Most importantly, it will make you enjoying landscape photography even more.

Ansel Adams dedicates the beginning of his first book "Taos Pueblo" to visualization. He introduced the idea of "previsualization", which involved the photographer imagining what he wanted his final print to look like before he even took the shot. Of course, there are many great photos which were taken impromptu. However, for landscape photographers, being able to previsualize the scene before going there will greatly reduce the chance of being caught unprepared and will greatly increase the chance of getting better shots.

Photographers use various tools to help them pre-visualizing the scene. Nowadays, many of those tools are phone apps. Planit Pro is an all-in-one solution that is designed to leverage the map and simulated viewfinder technologies to provide the necessary tools for photographers to pre-visualize the scene in combination with the ground subjects and the celestial objects such as the Sun, the Moon, Stars, Star-trails and Milky Way.

In the Planit Pro app, we packed it with features - from location scouting such as GPS coordinates, elevations, distance, elevation gain, clear view, focal length, depth of field (DoF), hyperfocal distance, panorama and aerial photography, to the Ephemeris features such as the sunrise, sunset, moonrise, moonset time and direction, twilight time, special hours of the day, sun/moon finder, major stars, constellations, nebulae azimuth and elevation angle, star trail planning, time-lapse calculation and simulation, sequence calculation and simulation, milky way searching, solar eclipse and lunar eclipse, exposure/ND filter calculator, light meter, rainbow position prediction, tide height and tide search etc. All the information are either represented on the map as an overlay or visually presented in simulated viewfinders (VR, AR, picture, or street view), just like you look through your camera's viewfinder. Whatever you want for your landscape photography, it is there in the Planit Pro.

Landscape photography is an adventure in the nature world. We understand sometimes there won't be any network connection when you are out exploring. Planit Pro was designed for have it in mind. If you preload the offline elevation files and the offline mbtiles maps, you can use the app fully offline without the need for network connections.

name: SiteCam Construction Photo App
description:
If the location context of your site photos matters, choose SiteCam. The SiteCam mobile app is an easy-to-use camera app that streamlines photo collection from the field, with location context. Pin photos to plans/blueprints and maps to improve your photo documentation records, better communicate defects, and produce more insightful project reports to stakeholders.

Discussing a site issue and it gets buried in the chat? In SiteCam you can Tag people in comments linked directly to the photos, their notes, and location context to better communicate job updates, requests for info, required tasks, etc. Our notification system takes them straight to the conversation, with context so they can understand what you’re talking about, and get you answers quickly.

SiteCam is built to help with your field documentation so you have the records you need for project scoping, condition assessments, site updates, photo evidence, and issue flagging. Photos are automatically timestamped and GPS-stamped to improve your evidence records.

Add value to your site records. Tag, describe and categorize photos as you capture them to ease reference, search and reporting. Photos that your team adds are synced online and instantly accessible on the computer via the SiteCam web app.

Cover yourself with photos of before, during, and after work is completed. Track changes through time by adding update photos to a Capture Group Timeline.

Turn a selection of your site records into a detailed photo report in minutes, not hours. Photos in SiteCam can be sent to our report template, ready to edit, share via a URL, or download as a PDF. Reports include photo locations on your plans, GPS information, timestamps and your notes.


View your team’s photos by location, using map or plan views, or scroll through the gallery. You can search through photos by date, tags, record type, description text, and more. The AI search within the app allows you to search using the contents of a photo that has been analyzed and auto-tagged.

Capture construction defects or snags, with markups and descriptions of what needs to be done. Pin each defect to the plan to show exactly where work is needed, all clearly shown in your report. Add update photos to a pin to record evidence of how an issue has been fixed.

What is SiteCam good at?
Creating a centralized construction photo database for your team, instead of everyone having their own system.
Showing the location of your photos on a plan and map
Helping you show before, during, and after update photos in a location through time
Producing better records with timestamped and GPS-stamped photos
Improving your photo record security with all photos backed-up safely online and not filling-up your phone (optional on-phone duplicates).
Giving you field upload options, from storing optimized photos to high-res originals, with timestamps and GPS.
Streamlining work from field to office with mobile and web platforms.
Saving time when creating reports and easing access via a sharable report URL or PDF.
Helping you create a photo organization system that matches your project structure

name: Shoot Planner: Photo Shot List
description:
Plan the shoot before the shoot. Shoot Planner is a photo shoot planner and shot list app for photographers and filmmakers — and every part of it works offline.

Most tools do one thing: a moodboard, or a shot list, or a sun calculator. Shoot Planner chains them into one pipeline — references to shots to locations to lighting to storyboard to gear — then follows you into the field on the day.

WORKS WITH NO SIGNAL
The golden hour engine and the field mode are fully on-device. No signal on a canyon rim, in a basement venue, or on a plane means nothing to this app. Your shoot day does not depend on a login screen loading.

SHOT LIST
Build a shot list with priorities, descriptions, focal length and camera notes. Assign shots to a day, drag to reorder, and mark each one captured as you go.

REFERENCES AND MOODBOARD
Collect a visual moodboard per project — shoot with the camera, pull from your photo library, or paste a Pinterest, Instagram or web link and the image and title are fetched for you. Browse it as a masonry gallery and filter by tag.

REFERENCE TO SHOT, IN ONE TAP
Turn any reference into a shot, permanently linked. On set you see the inspiration image beside the shot you are taking — not buried in a different app on a different tab.

GOLDEN HOUR AND BLUE HOUR
An offline solar engine gives sunrise, sunset, the golden hour window with its exact duration, blue hour, and the sun path for every day and location in your plan. No network, no subscription wall, no waiting for a map tile.

LOCATION SCOUTING AND MAP
Geo-tag each shot and see the whole project as numbered pins in shooting order. Save access notes — parking, gate codes, permit restrictions, the walk in — and hand off to your maps app for directions.

STORYBOARD
Lay scenes out as horizontal filmstrips, drag to sequence them, and set per-shot durations with realistic travel and setup gaps between them. See whether the day actually fits before you promise it.

GEAR LIBRARY AND PACKING LIST
Keep a reusable inventory of bodies, lenses, support, power, filters and drone kit. Build a packing list per project and watch the packed progress climb. Stop arriving without the one lens the shot needed.

SHOOT MODE
The reason this is not just another planning document. One-handed, one shot at a time: the current shot with its reference image, a live golden hour countdown, a big capture button, skip and advance, and a place for on-set notes. The screen stays awake. It runs entirely offline and syncs when you are back in service.

TEMPLATES AND REMINDERS
Save any project as a template and reuse it, or start from Wedding Essentials, Location Scout or Brand Day. Set shoot-relative reminders — pack gear two hours before call — and push shoot days to your device, Google or Apple calendar.

WHO IT IS FOR
Wedding, portrait, landscape, brand and commercial photographers. Videographers and filmmakers running their own film pre-production. Solo shooters who plan properly and want the plan in their hand on the day.

BUILT FOR THE WAY SHOOT DAYS ACTUALLY GO
Your shooting schedule slips because the light moved, the location was gated, or the client added a setup. Shoot Planner is built to be edited on the day, not admired the night before. Reorder the shot list in the field, re-check the sunrise and sunset times for the new spot, mark the shots you got, and keep the photo shoot checklist honest as the day changes around you.

PRICING
Free to use, with a capped number of projects. Pro unlocks unlimited projects at $6.99/month or $59.99/year — around 28% off annually — and starts with a 7-day free trial.

Shoot Planner is a photo shoot planner, shot list app, photography planner, storyboard tool, location scouting notebook, camera gear checklist and golden hour calculator — the whole shoot day pre-production workflow in one offline app.

Download Shoot Planner and walk onto your next shoot knowing exactly what you came for.

name: PlanIt Earth: VR Photo Planner
description:
For landscape, travel, nature, cityscape, night, time-lapse, star-trail, Milky Way and astro photographers: PlanIt Earth builds on everything we learned from PlanIt Pro and takes previsualization to a whole new level.

Ansel Adams called it previsualization — imagining the final print before the shot is ever taken. Seeing a scene before you travel to it greatly increases the chance of coming home with the photo you wanted. PlanIt Earth is built around that one idea: see the shot before you go.

What sets it apart is the photorealistic VR viewfinder. Instead of reading numbers on a map, you stand at your camera position and see the real terrain — built from satellite imagery and elevation data — with the Sun, Moon, Milky Way, stars, clouds, 3D markers and your framing exactly where they will be. Scrub time and watch light and shadows move through your composition.

There isn't always a signal out in the field. Preload offline elevation, maps and markers, and keep scouting and planning entirely offline.

Plan the light. Preview the scene. Arrive ready.

FEATURES

Photorealistic VR planning

Real terrain and horizon rendered from elevation data and satellite imagery
Photoreal city backgrounds with Google 3D Tiles, plus Street View and your own photos
Aim with camera and scene pins; focal length, angle of view and line of sight
Live depth-of-field and bokeh preview — see the blur instead of reading numbers
Aerial and drone view, immersive full screen, and an AR viewfinder for framing on site
Sun, Moon, Milky Way and sky

Sunrise, sunset, moonrise, moonset, golden hour, blue hour, twilight and astronomical darkness
Sun and Moon direction, altitude, paths and alignment timing
Milky Way Center direction, visibility and realistic sky placement, with Milky Way Seeker for the best dates and locations
Stars, planets, constellations, meteor showers, comets, eclipses, rainbows and moonbows
The Sun drawn from a time-matched NASA SDO image at its true apparent size
Alignment and shoot planning

Find where and when the Sun or Moon lines up with your subject
Search the sky across years for the conditions you want
Plan sequences, multi-day shoots and time-lapses on a key-frame timeline
Exposure guides for eclipses, star trails, the Milky Way and more
Smart auto shooting fires your camera at the moment you planned for
Measure distance, height, elevation and two-station geometry
Map-based scouting

Full-screen planning map with camera and scene pins and direction lines
Multiple map providers and layers, terrain, light-pollution and aurora overlays
Search locations, save markers and 3D models, record and import tracks
Offline regions: map, elevation and markers downloaded for the field
Weather and field conditions

Photographer-focused weather and forecast cards
Cloud, visibility, fog, wind, humidity, frost, dust and other shooting conditions
Aurora forecasts, solar activity, space-weather alerts, tides and waves
ISS and satellite passes, aircraft transits and rocket launches, with an alarm for an upcoming transit
Telescope rig control

Drive an equatorial mount, an electronic focuser and an astronomy camera from the phone over Wi-Fi or USB, or through the SharpCap bridge on a PC
Still being finished: many models are untested against real hardware, so check the behaviour with your own gear
Plans, markers and tracks

Save complete plans with map position, pins, time and shooting setup, and save shots inside each plan
Sign in with your PlanIt account to sync plans, markers, tracks and settings across your devices
PlanIt+ PlanIt Earth is free to explore. PlanIt+ unlocks the photorealistic VR viewfinder, the night, time-lapse, alignment, aerospace and weather modules, and offline regions — as an annual subscription or a one-time lifetime purchase, on every platform. Coming from PlanIt Pro? Your past purchases become credit toward PlanIt+.

name: Time Calculator Cardamon
description:
Add, subtract, multiply, and divide spans of time, then read the answer in any of 26 formats. Time Calculator by Cardamon is a free time duration calculator for hours, minutes, seconds, and more, with no ads.

Working out a shift minus lunch? Type 8 hours 45 minutes, subtract 1 hour 15 minutes, and get 7 hours 30 minutes. Need to know how long three 50-minute sessions run? Multiply 50 minutes by 3 to get 2 hours 30 minutes. Splitting a 6-hour job across 4 people? Divide 6 hours by 4 to get 1 hour 30 minutes each. This is the hours and minutes calculator for anyone who is tired of doing time math in their head.

Time Calculator works with durations, not clock times. It does not tell you what time it will be or work with calendar dates. It figures out how long, then converts that time span into whatever units you need. Think of it as a time span calculator and a duration calculator rolled into one clean keypad.

WHAT YOU CAN DO

- Add and subtract time: 2 hours 30 minutes + 45 minutes, or 5 days minus 18 hours. The add and subtract time calculator handles mixed units in a single line.
- Multiply and divide a duration by a number: 25 minutes times 12, or a week divided by 5. Scale any time span up or down in one tap.
- Continue from your last answer: press = and keep typing to build the next calculation on the previous result.
- Read the result in 26 formats: from a single unit like Hours or Minutes, to combined views like Day Hour Minute, up to All Units, from years down to milliseconds.

CALCULATE HOURS THE EASY WAY

Stop converting minutes to decimal hours by hand. Enter your hours and minutes, and the hours minutes calculator does the rest. Total a timesheet, work out hours worked across a week, or check how many hours a project really took. Add overtime, subtract breaks, and read the clean total in the format you prefer. When you need to calculate hours worked fast, the math stays in the app instead of on a scrap of paper.

8 TIME UNITS

Milliseconds, seconds, minutes, hours, days, weeks, months, and years. The millisecond is the smallest unit. Switch the keypad to show either a Milliseconds or a Years key depending on what you work with most, so the units you use live one tap away. Mix any units in one expression and let the duration calculator sort out the totals.

RATE CALCULATOR

Enter an amount and a label, such as 25 and USD, and see the total per hour, per day, per week, and per each of the 8 time units for your current duration. The label is free text, so use it for pay, output, distance, or anything measured over time. Note: this multiplies your amount by the interval. It does not convert currency or fetch exchange rates.

THREE THEMES

Choose System, Light, or Dark. Dark mode is built in and applies instantly, no restart needed. The whole app follows your phone or your preference.

WHO USES IT

- Shift workers and timesheets: total your hours worked minus breaks, then read the result in decimal hours or hours and minutes.
- Freelancers and contractors: add up billable time across tasks and calculate hours for an invoice.
- Payroll and admin: tally shift hours and overtime, then check the weekly total in seconds.
- Cooking and brewing: stack and split timing across steps without losing track.
- Sport and training: add up intervals and rest, then divide a session into even blocks.
- Music and video: add clip and track lengths to find a total runtime.
- Students and teachers: add study sessions or split a deadline into work blocks.
- Anyone who needs clean time math, a quick time span calculator, or a duration calculator without a clock or calendar.

Questions or ideas? Send feedback from Settings and we read every message.

name: Stage Metronome with Setlist
description:
Tired of fumbling with tempo between songs? Stage Metronome lets you save every song's settings in a setlist — ready at the right BPM in one tap for every song in your set.

SETLIST FOR YOUR WHOLE SET

Build a setlist before the gig and store each song's tempo, time signature, beat pattern, and accent beats together. On stage, tap a song and everything loads instantly — no sliders, no reconfiguring under pressure. Export the setlist as a file and your bandmates can import the same settings on their own devices in seconds.

A DISPLAY YOU CAN READ FROM ACROSS THE ROOM

The beat number is large enough to read from behind a drum kit or across a stage. Full-screen mode shows only the beat number and beat lights — no controls, just a clear visual reference for the whole band. Three configurable beat light patterns and per-device audio-visual delay calibration ensure the click and the light land at the same moment on your specific device.

STAY IN CONTROL ON STAGE

Tap the SYNC button to reset the beat to 1 without stopping or changing tempo — useful when the count gets lost mid-song. Connect a Bluetooth page turner or headset to start, stop, navigate songs, and adjust volume without putting down your instrument. The metronome keeps running in the background when you switch apps or the screen turns off.

DIAL IN YOUR CLICK

Choose from 6 click sounds. Set the volume independently for the accent beat, the main beat, and the sub-beat so the click mix works in any monitor environment — from a quiet rehearsal room to a loud stage. Use tap tempo to set BPM by feel, or hit the half/double buttons to switch between full-time and half-time in an instant. Tempo range covers 10 to 500 BPM with 12 beat-pattern presets.

FOR PRACTICE AND REHEARSAL

All the same settings work for band rehearsal and solo practice. The in-app timer tracks session length. Notification controls let you start, stop, and manage the click from the lock screen without opening the app.

WHO IT'S FOR

Stage Metronome is built for live musicians and bands who need a reliable click track on stage — drummers keeping the kit locked to a setlist, guitarists and bassists who need the right tempo loaded without touching the phone mid-performance, and anyone who has lost their tempo at a gig because their metronome was too fiddly under pressure. - Advanced Looping: loop and save precise parts of the song.

- Guitar/Piano display of 30 types of chords (maj, sus4, min7…)
- Fret Play: learn the guitar fretboard through note training exercise.

- Metronome of any time signature and tempo.

Original Backing Tracks:

- Backing Tracks (Jam Tracks): play along original tracks of different genres made for you to elevate your soloing skills.
- Live Notes Mode: see the chord progression of the backing track along any scale on the guitar fretboard or piano view.
- Interactive Drums: build drum tracks in the style of famous drummers for you to play along.

Backtrackit's original backing tracks are helping thousands of musicians improve their improvisation skills through its unique "Live Notes Mode". You can see the chord progression outlined on the guitar fretboard or piano where the notes of the current chord are highlighted. If you're a beginner or an advanced player, jamming to these tracks will help you develop a greater sense of music and improvisation skills.

Backing Tracks Genres:
- Rock
- Blues
- Metal
- Pop
- Ambient
- Jazz
- Neo Soul
- Classical
- EDM
- Hip Hop
- Tanpura
- Drum tracks

name: Legato: Music Practice Journal
description:

BUILD YOUR INNER EAR
Inner Ear is a foundational ear training course with 12 chapters, 57 units and 232 lessons. Start by matching a note, then build your sense of relative pitch, remember melodies and explore intervals, harmony and modes.
- Listen, hold the sound in your mind, then sing it back
- See how your voice matches the target with pitch feedback
- When a question is difficult, replay it and hear the correct answer before moving on
- Follow a structured path from first steps to more advanced listening

TRACK YOUR PRACTICE
- Time sessions and keep a practice log as you play
- Track multiple instruments with colour-coded profiles
- Set daily goals and follow your streaks, heatmap and practice stats
- Pause your streak with holiday mode when you take a break
- Keep your goals and weekly progress close with home screen widgets

PLAN A SESSION THAT FITS
- Prepare sessions in advance and build reusable practice routines
- Mix repertoire, technique and your own activities, with time targets for each
- Keep your plan, timer and tools together on the practice screen
- Add notes and recordings to remember what worked and what to try next

TRAIN YOUR RHYTHM AND INTONATION
- Rhythm Course: 65 graded levels with feedback on timing, drift and consistency
- Polyrhythm Course: 58 levels to develop rhythmic independence
- Intonation Trainer: record a phrase and review how each note sits in tune
- Calibrate audio timing for your device before drills

YOUR EVERYDAY MUSIC TOOLS
- Metronome with subdivisions, accents, polyrhythms and multiple visualisations
- Choose Classic, Wood, Beep or Rimshot clicks; preview a sound and keep your favourite
- Tuner with adjustable reference pitch from 415 to 466 Hz
- Drone tones and a live pitch graph to support intonation practice
- Vibrato monitor for speed, width and consistency
- Record, trim and share takes with your teacher or keep them in your journal

KEEP YOUR SHEET MUSIC CLOSE
- Import PDF files into Legato from the Android share menu
- Attach scores to pieces or scan paper sheet music with your camera
- Annotate with pen, highlighter and white-out
- Use bookmarks and pick up where you left off with last-page memory
- On tablets, view your score beside your running session

EXPLORE CHORDS
- Browse chords in every key on piano, guitar and staff
- Explore guitar voicings and tap a chord to hear it
- Hear piano playback with a detailed grand piano sound

SEE HOW FAR YOU'VE COME
- Break an exam, recital or musical goal into manageable milestones
- Keep lesson notes, challenges and breakthroughs in your practice journal
- Look back through completed milestones and your practice history
- Tap a day on the dashboard to open the practice log for that week

PRACTISE ACROSS YOUR DEVICES
Sync sessions, sheet music, recordings and settings between your devices, with layouts for phones and tablets.

Whether you play piano, guitar, strings, wind, brass or drums, or use your voice, Legato gives your practice a place to grow. Bring your next piece, choose one thing to work on, and begin.

description:
Whether you’re operating during ARRL Field Day, chasing contacts for POTA, calling CQ in your ham shack, or just checking FCC rules on the go, this app gives you a complete and easy-to-use reference to the official US ham radio bands.

• Support for seasonal contests – Great for Field Day or Parks on the Air, POTA, when you need fast access to band data to know where you are allowed to operate in a congested band.
• US callsign lookup – Quickly identify hams by their callsign using the built-in lookup using our callsign database.
• Includes additional radio services – View allocated bands and channels for non-ham services like:
 • CB (Citizens Band Radio)
 • FRS (Family Radio Service)
 • GMRS (General Mobile Radio Service)
 • Maritime Radiofacsimile broadcasts
 • MURS (Multi-Use Radio Service)
 • NOAA Weather Radio
 • NIST Time & Frequency signals
 • USAF Messages (HFGCS)
• Offline use – Designed to work even in remote locations with no cell service

📬 Feedback Welcome
This app is built by a fellow ham who cares deeply about utility and accuracy. If you have a feature suggestion, see something off, or just want to say thanks, feel free to email me or leave a review. Your input helps improve the experience for every ham out there.

name: Functional Ear Trainer
description:
Ear training can be easy and fun! With a right approach.

Have you (or one of your friends) ever wanted to learn to transcribe or play music by ear?

It is so important for a musician to know what you are hearing. A good musical ear helps when you are composing, improvising, transcribing melodies, or playing with others.

Most likely you have already tried different programs to learn to recognize intervals or even to acquire perfect pitch. However, although such programs develop your ear, but can you actually play any melody you hear as soon as you listen to it?

Imagine you could understand music… It is like when somebody is talking to you, you not only hear pleasant sounds, but you recognize words and their meaning.

One day I came across Alain Benbassat's program called “Functional Ear Trainer” and have been using it ever since. It is based on Alain's ear training method to learn to recognize tones.

The main difference between the Functional Ear Trainer and other methods is that it teaches you to distinguish between tones in the context of a particular musical key. You begin to recognize the role (or function) of each tone in this key, which is incredibly similar to its role in other keys of the same scale.

And it is *guaranteed* anyone can gradually develop this skill. It does not matter:
– who you are – an absolute beginner in music or a virtuoso professional musician;
– how old you are – a 3 yo kid or a 90+ adult;
– what musical instrument you play (you don't even have to play one).

The only requirement is to practice for 10 minutes a day.

I was so excited about this ear trainer that I have developed an Android app based on the Alain Benbassat method. I hope you will find it useful.

Download this app right now, and have fun with your ear training!

When you want to understand what you heard, look it up in the chord, interval and scale dictionaries. You can also tap notes on the piano to find matching chords and scales.

—

• Log exercises, sets, reps, and weights. Add notes or personal videos.
• Track calories and meals using a large food database, with GPT-powered suggestions.
• Record body measurements and photos for progress tracking.
• Communicate with trainer in the in-app chat.

Benefits:
• Trainers save time on program creation and administration.
• Clients see their program and log results instantly.
• Both parties stay synchronized in real time.
• Quick program setup: from creation to client execution in under 5 minutes.
• Full progress tracking and analytics for better coaching outcomes.

description:

Baby daybook: breastfeeding and bottle feeding, sleep schedule, diaper log, weight and height

The first months with your baby are a special time when every day matters for your infant's development. Parents want to understand how their baby eats, how much sleep they get, whether diapers are changed regularly, and if growth is on track. Our baby daybook helps make parenting simple, organized, and calm - from the first days of breastfeeding to establishing feeding and sleep routines.

"My Baby Tracker" is created for parents who want to easily track their baby's feeding, monitor sleep patterns, log diaper changes, and follow their infant's development.

What's inside the app:

Main screen with latest baby data
Convenient dashboard shows all important information about your baby in one place: when was the last breastfeeding or bottle feeding, how much time has passed since last sleep, when the diaper was changed, current infant weight and height. All information at your fingertips - you instantly see your baby's status.

Feeding tracker
Record every feeding: breastfeeding, bottle feeding, or formula. Mark start time and duration, which breast, amount of formula. Feeding timer helps you remember when baby ate last. Statistics show nursing frequency and help establish a feeding routine.

Sleep diary
Log every baby sleep: when fell asleep, how long slept, sleep quality. Sleep tracker shows total daily sleep time and helps build a routine. You'll see if your infant gets enough rest and how sleep patterns change over time.

Diaper tracking
Mark diaper changes and their contents. This is important for monitoring baby health: the number of wet and dirty diapers shows whether the infant is getting enough nutrition and how digestion is working.

Growth and weight
Record measurements of height, weight, head circumference. Growth charts show dynamics and help track how your baby is growing. Compare indicators with norms and share data with your pediatrician.

Growth and weight standards
Built-in standards help understand if baby weight and height correspond to age norms. You see how your infant develops compared to standard indicators for breastfed or formula-fed babies.

Sleep norms by age
Compare your baby's sleep patterns with recommended norms for their age. The app shows how much an infant should sleep at different months and helps understand if your baby is getting enough rest.

Development calendar
Track important milestones in baby development: when started holding head, rolling over, sitting, crawling. Development calendar suggests what skills appear at each age and helps not miss important moments.

Teething order
Mark the appearance of baby's first teeth and track teething order. Teething calendar shows typical sequence and timing of infant tooth appearance, helps prepare for this period.

Statistics and charts
All records about feeding, sleep, diapers are collected into visual charts. You see baby's daily routine, nursing frequency, total sleep time and can notice changes in development. This helps better understand infant needs.

Notes and reminders
Add notes about baby's wellbeing, mood, feeding or sleep specifics. Set reminders for next feeding or sleep time so you don't miss important moments.

"My Baby Tracker" - your reliable parenting assistant. Everything you need to track feeding, sleep, diapers, and development - in one place.

description:
This App is a handy and reliable assistant for breastfeeding your newborn baby. You can track breastfeeding, bottle feeding, solid feedings and milk pumping. You can save diaper changes, sleeping periods and the results of your baby's height and weight measurements. This baby tracker app will help parents get through the wonder weeks.

With this breastfeeding tracker you can:

✔️ Track feeding by one breast or by both, if you give your baby two breasts at one feeding
✔️ Track bottle feeding
✔️ Measure solid food feeding - food type and amount
✔️ If you need to pump your milk, measure how many ml/oz of each breast were expressed with a pump log
✔️ Tracking diaper changes, you can note whether it is wet or dirty, or both :)
✔️ You’ll always know how many diapers were changed per day
✔️ Record baths, temperatures, walks, and medications
✔️ Handy breastfeeding timer and sleep timer are easy to stop and to restart
✔️ Your baby's height and weight can be measured almost daily! They are also easily stored in the baby diary.
✔️ You can add a reminder for each event - periodic and easy-to-set
✔️ Displays baby nursing and sleeping timers in the notification bar, so you have easy access to the App
✔️ Logging and tracking activity of multiple babies. Supports twins!

Being a FTM (first-time mom), or new mom, in general, is very tiring and challenging! You got through pregnancy, you’ve probably just made it home from the hospital, are totally exhausted, and a little overwhelmed by your new responsibilities. The first few months of your baby’s life mostly revolves around a schedule of eating, sleeping, diaper changes and occasional little doctor’s visits.

It’s not always easy to remember the last time you fed your baby or changed their nappy. It’s very helpful to monitor everything and get a quick glance to remind you the last time you did it, or the next time you have to. It will definitely give you a peace of mind and make your day that much easier to have a log to check whenever needed.

It’s extremely important to track when you had your last feeding session, but also track the weight and how long they were eating to make sure they’re eating properly and gaining weight at a normal rate.

Also, keeping track of diapers is very imperative to keeping your baby healthy. All moms definitely need an easy way to check how often they’re changing diapers. Not to mention, you should definitely track if everything looks normal during diaper changes.

For some parents, it’s very important to track every ounce of food and it’s imperative they have a baby feeding tracker. Some babies, unfortunately, have minor illnesses after coming home from the hospital. Keeping track of all this information will help your baby on the road to recovery and healthy growth much more easily.

As a new mom, don’t forget to take care of yourself as well. The first few weeks will be tiring! There will definitely be times you fall asleep on the couch suddenly, and everyone needs some help or handy reminders. Alarms and graphs are a great way to have an at-a-glance look at what you need to do without stressing over “what if I forget?”.

Just click the appropriate button to begin feeding, or other activities. Your baby care history will be reliably stored. All this information may be useful when you visit the pediatrician, as well as for the further development of your child.

Feed baby easily and quickly. This breastfeeding app helps you track everything and enjoy motherhood.

Cell-enabled remote vitals tracking devices are available for just $5/month extra per device (also requires one-time device purchase). Options include: Blood Pressure Monitor; Digital Weight Scale; Pulse Oximeter (to measure Blood Oxygen); Glucometer.

Custom Notifications:

SAFETY+ | $45/month

Senior Medical Alerts:

name: Caregiver Planner: Elder Care
description:
Caring for aging parents is rarely a one-person job. Reminders, doctor visits and "did anyone pick up the prescription?" messages pile up in a group chat until something slips. Caregiver Planner gives a family caregiver one calm place to organize elder care: medication reminders, tasks, appointments, a care log and the numbers you call most.

It is an organizer for the logistics of caregiving, not a medical app. It helps you plan, remind, hand over and keep track. It never gives dosing, diagnosis or treatment advice.

WHAT YOU CAN DO

• Profile: add the person you look after, whether a parent, a spouse or someone else, with a relationship and notes.
• Medication reminders: add each medication as printed on the label and the times you want a reminder. Log each one as taken or skipped, or snooze it for 15 minutes. The app reminds you of the time only and never suggests what or how much to take.
• Tasks: add jobs like "pick up prescription" or "call the clinic", note who is doing it, set a due date and check it off.
• Appointments: keep doctor and specialist visits with the provider, place and notes, and get a reminder before each one. After a visit, write down what was decided and turn follow-ups into tasks.
• Log: note visits, calls and updates. Group entries into concern threads ("sleep at night", "swollen ankle") so you can tell a clinician how long something has been going on.
• Contacts: save doctor, pharmacy, nurse and family numbers, and pin two to Today for a one-tap call.
• Rotation: set a weekly pattern of who is on duty and when, with an end-of-shift reminder.
• Handoff brief: reminder times, the next tasks and appointments, recent updates and who to call, ready to send to a sibling or save as a PDF.
• A weekly recap you can share, and a log export as a PDF for your own records.
• Prep checklists: pick a situation (specialist visit, hospital discharge, home safety, organizing medications, new diagnosis questions, in-home help, documents) and get an organizational checklist of questions to ask, papers to bring and jobs to divide up.

FREE TO START, NO SIGN-UP

Start as a guest right away; your plan stays on your phone. The free version covers one person:
• up to 5 active medication reminders
• unlimited tasks, appointments, log entries and contacts
• handoff brief, weekly recap and PDF export
• one AI checklist to try

The free version shows ads: banners for our other apps and an occasional full-screen ad after you save a task or an appointment.

PRO, FOR FAMILIES WHO SHARE THE LOAD

• Care Circle: invite siblings and other helpers with a code and post tasks, log notes and duty shifts to a shared feed everyone in the circle sees. It updates when the app opens or when you refresh.
• More than one person, each with their own Today, tasks and schedule.
• Unlimited medication reminders.
• Unlimited AI prep checklists, plus AI visit preparation and follow-up suggestions (up to 30 a month).
• Cloud backup and restore (with a free account).
• No ads.

Pro is a monthly or annual subscription. The free senior care organizer stays useful on its own.

YOUR DATA

As a guest, your plan is stored on your phone. Care Circle and cloud backup store the shared or backed-up items on our servers. AI checklists and suggestions are drafted by a third-party AI service (OpenRouter), only after you agree; medication names and recent log entries are sent only if you switch that option on. We use Firebase for sign-in, analytics and crash reports, and Google AdMob for ads in the free version.

NOT MEDICAL ADVICE

Caregiver Planner helps you coordinate the day-to-day of looking after an elderly parent or loved one. It does not provide medical, dosing or health advice. For any medical question, consult a licensed professional; in an emergency, call your local emergency number.

name: Elder Care: Pill Reminder Log
description:
Elder Care is a free medicine reminder and personal health record built for older adults and the family members who look after them. Big text, plain words, one-tap answers — and everything stays on your own phone.

NEVER MISS A DOSE
• Reminders at the exact time you set — not "sometime in the next 15 minutes"
• Answer from the notification: "I took it" or "Remind me later"
• Every schedule real prescriptions use: daily, set weekdays, every few days, monthly, every N hours, cycles like 21 days on / 7 off, and as-needed
• Steroid tapers and short courses: the dose steps down on its own and reminders stop on the last day
• "With food / before food / empty stomach" printed on the reminder itself
• Double-dose check: if you already took it minutes ago, the app asks before recording another
• Skip with a reason ("felt unwell", "ran out", "doctor said stop") — the reason goes into your doctor report
• Refill warnings in days, not just tablets — and a warning if a course cannot be finished with what is left
• Reminder health check: send yourself a test alert, and get step-by-step battery fixes for Xiaomi, Samsung, Huawei, OPPO, vivo, OnePlus, realme, TECNO and more

SCAN A LABEL INSTEAD OF TYPING
Point the camera at the box. Name, strength, form and directions are read on the phone — nothing is uploaded — and you check them before saving.

TRACK HOW YOU ARE DOING
• Blood pressure, blood sugar, pulse, oxygen, temperature, weight, breathing, sleep, water, steps
• Pain and mood on a faces scale — no arithmetic while you are hurting
• mg/dL or mmol/L, kg or lb, °C or °F — your choice
• Trend charts with the commonly published range shown for context
• Symptom diary with the medicine you suspect — the app counts and dates them for your appointment, and never claims a cause

KEEP YOUR PAPERS
Photograph prescriptions, lab reports, X-rays, hospital letters and vaccination cards. Search them by the words on the page. Lab values are read off a scanned report and offered for you to confirm — with the range your own laboratory printed.

LAB RESULTS
130 common tests — HbA1c, creatinine, cholesterol, TSH, vitamin D and more — with history and charts per test.

READY FOR THE DOCTOR
• Doctor report PDF: what was taken, what was missed and why, readings, symptoms
• Readings export as PDF or CSV, choose the dates per metric
• Visit preparation: what to mention and what to ask, assembled from your own record
• Family update: a short plain-text message for whoever helps you
• Wallet-sized emergency card with allergies, conditions, medicines and contacts

MADE FOR OLDER EYES AND HANDS
Four text sizes, stronger-contrast mode, dark mode, full-width buttons, no long-press secrets, spelled-out "Required" instead of a tiny asterisk, and every date written out in words.

TWO PEOPLE, ONE PHONE
Keep separate records for yourself and the person you care for, and switch with one tap.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account. No server. No analytics. No ads. No subscription. Your record is encrypted on this phone and the key stays in your phone's own secure keystore. Sharing a report, a card or a backup is a file you hand over yourself. Uninstalling removes everything.

Elder Care records what you tell it and shows it back to you. It does not diagnose, dose or replace your doctor or pharmacist.

Free forever. Made with care for the people who need it most.

FAMILY SHARING

Walks, food, meds, vet visits, play — every action shows on the Home activity feed in real time. Profiles, walk history, photos, and vet records sync across the household.

PAW PALS — YOUR DOG'S MEISHI BOOK
When your dog meets a new pup, exchange Dog Cards by QR in seconds. Both owners tap "scan" and each card — name, breed, photo — lands in your meishi book. Recurring friends are detected automatically from time, place, and breed. Tap a card to read about that breed in the built-in encyclopedia.

RAINBOW BRIDGE (NEW)
Honor the dogs who've crossed. A dedicated memorial page — rainbow-halo photo, story, memories, gallery, anniversaries, and a shareable card.

WALK TRACKING & HEALTH
GPS records every walk's route, distance, duration, and pace. The post-walk summary shows results at a glance, with space for keepsake photos. Auto-syncs to Health Connect so your steps and your dog's walks share one timeline. Past walks live in a calendar view; monthly totals tally automatically; favorite routes save (Plus).

PRIVACY FIRST
Your data and your dog's are yours. Walk routes, photos, and dog profiles are stored securely in your account. No ad tracking, and your location data is never used for advertising or sold to anyone. Family Sharing and Paw Pals show other users only your nickname — your name and email stay private.

WANWANWALK PLUS
For owners who want more depth. Manage multiple dogs, save favorite routes, view your full walk history, get a 7-day weather forecast, join Paw Pal challenges, collect season-limited Dog Card designs, unlock the full breed database, and get a year-in-review report.

name: PetVitality Pet Health Tracker
description:
PetVitality is a pet health tracker for dogs and cats, designed by veterinarians and built around what actually gets asked in the exam room: when was the last seizure, how much has the weight changed since spring, which vaccine is due. Nobody can hold all of that in their head. A good pet health tracker holds it for you, and it does the calculating.

Dog and cat health records in one place:

Each pet gets a profile with weight, active medications and the next treatment due on the front page.

What the health tracker follows

* Seizure tracker: log each seizure in under a minute with a timer and video. PetVitality calculates the seizure-free streak, a regularity score and an estimated window for the next seizure. For owners of epileptic dogs, this is the feature that changes how they plan their lives.
* Heat cycle tracker: average cycle, regularity and a forecast for the next heat with a date window you can add to your calendar.
* Weight tracker: quick weigh-ins in kg or lb, food changes marked on the chart so you can see whether the new diet worked, and an evaluation of the trend against your pet's breed and age. Works as a puppy growth chart too.
* Stool tracker and vomiting log: a 1 to 7 stool scale with photos, vomiting frequency with a warning when it clusters.
* Allergy tracker: symptom severity over time, so seasonal patterns become visible instead of remembered.
* Heart rate and breathing rate counter: tap along with each breath or beat, checked against normal ranges for dogs and cats.
* Mood, energy, diary entries, photos and documents, per pet.

Every tracker exports as a PDF. Bring it to the consultation or send it ahead. From the clinic side of the table, a clean seizure log or weight chart changes the quality of the decisions that get made, and that is the standard these reports are built to.

Medication reminder and vaccine tracker

* Vaccines, flea and tick treatments, dewormers and dental care, with the next due date on the front page and a reminder before it lapses.
* Medication reminder with dose schedules and plain-language information about each medicine.
* Routines: walks, feeding, tooth brushing, nail trims and vet visits, as repeating reminders.

For when things go wrong

* Chocolate toxicity calculator using your dog's actual weight and the type of chocolate, with clear guidance for each risk level and a button to call your vet.
* Emergency guides and articles written by veterinarians.

Pet sitter instructions:

Health status, emergency contacts, feeding, medication, exercise, behaviour and house rules, exported as one PDF with your pet's photo on it. This is free for everyone, because a well-informed sitter is better for every pet.

Most veterinary decisions depend on the information the owner brings to the appointment. PetVitality exists to make that information good.

Questions or suggestions: contact@petvitality.io
