name: Pet Medication & Pill Reminder
description:
Pet Meds is a simple pet medication tracker and pill reminder for dog and cat owners. Add your dog or cat, add each medicine as your vet prescribed it with the time it is due, and get a reminder on your phone when it is time. Tap Log dose or Skip, and the Today view moves on to the next one — no sticky notes on the fridge, no guessing whether this morning's tablet already went in.

Everything you log becomes a medication history for your dog or cat: what was given, what was skipped and what was missed, day by day. Before a checkup or a refill, Pro lets you export a vet-ready summary of that history and share it with the clinic or another caregiver.

WHAT YOU CAN DO
• Today view — what is due next, today's schedule and anything missed across all your pets, with Log dose, Skip and Undo
• Pet pill reminders — a notification at each scheduled time with the medication name and your animal's name
• Medication schedules — a daily reminder time, a start date and an optional end date for a course; with Pro, several times a day or only on chosen weekdays
• Pet profiles — name, dog or cat, and a photo, each with its own medicine list
• Any medicine — antibiotics, heart medication, joint supplements, dewormers, flea and tick or heartworm prevention. You type the name and the dose exactly as prescribed
• Notes on each medicine — with food, from the prescription label, anything worth remembering
• History — everything given and skipped, grouped by day, with a filter for each animal
• Vet-ready summary (Pro) — export the log as text and share it from your phone
• Several animals — filter the Today view and the history by name when several of them are on different medicines
• Available in 10 languages

WHY A PET MEDICATION TRACKER
• Built for pets — each dog or cat has its own list, so you always know which pill is due and for whom
• Reminders are scheduled on your phone, so they still arrive when you have no signal
• An honest record — Log dose, Skip and Undo write down exactly what happened, so the record you show your vet is real
• Simple for one animal, useful for several — a single daily tablet, or a few animals on overlapping courses

WHO IT IS FOR
• Dog and cat owners whose animal is on a course of medication
• Homes with several dogs or cats taking medicines at the same time
• Owners managing long-term pet meds — heart conditions, arthritis, allergies — or monthly flea, tick and heartworm prevention
• Anyone who would rather bring a clean medication log to the vet than rely on memory

FREE AND PRO
Free: up to 2 pets, unlimited medications, one reminder time a day per medication, the Today view, logging and the full history in the app. The free version shows ads.
Pro: unlimited pets, several reminder times a day, weekday schedules, the vet-ready history export, and no ads. Pro is an optional in-app purchase. The price is shown in the app before you buy, and a subscription can be cancelled at any time in your Google Play account.

YOUR DATA
Your pets, medications, history and photos are stored on your phone and are not uploaded. When you start, the app opens an anonymous guest session (creating an account is optional). It uses Firebase for sign-in, analytics and crash reports, RevenueCat for purchases, and an ad service in the free version. You can delete your account from Settings.

IMPORTANT — NOT VETERINARY ADVICE
Pet Meds is a reminder and record-keeping tool, not veterinary advice. It does not diagnose, prescribe, calculate or check a dose, and never tells you whether a medicine or an amount is safe for your animal. Enter the dose exactly as your vet prescribed, and ask your vet about any medical question, a missed or double dose, side effects or an emergency. Phone settings can delay or block notifications, so do not rely on the app alone for critical medication.

name: Petpoopy: Pet Poop Tracker
description:
Your dog or cat cannot tell you something is wrong. Their stool can, and it usually says it first.

Petpoopy is a stool diary that pays attention. You log what you saw in a few taps, and it keeps the story straight so that when you are sitting in the consulting room you are not trying to remember whether the bad week was three weeks ago or five.

The part most trackers leave out Petpoopy does not just write things down. It watches for the things that warrant a phone call and says so plainly: blood, black or tarry stools, straining, a stretch of loose days that has gone on too long. Straining in a male cat gets its own full-screen warning, because that one can turn serious within a day and it is easy to mistake for constipation.

It never tells you what is wrong with your pet. It tells you when it is worth asking someone who can.

Log it in seconds

A three-way choice for the everyday log, or a seven-point picture scale when you want to be precise. It is the Purina scale, made for dogs and cats, not the human chart.
Colour, blood, mucus, straining, worms, volume, and where it happened.
Up to four photos, kept on your phone and nowhere else.
"I did not see it" is a valid answer, for outdoor cats and for the hours you were not there.
One page for your vet A single PDF with the headline first: how many stools, how many were loose, the red flags with their dates, a consistency chart, weight, worming and vaccination dates, and the full diet history laid out the way a vet's nutrition form expects. Readable in about ninety seconds, which is roughly what you get.

It learns what normal looks like Every animal is different, so Petpoopy spends the first week working out what is usual for yours before it starts comparing. After that you get a plain-language score, a calendar you can see a bad patch in at a glance, and patterns worth knowing: the time of day, the day of the week, and which of your own trigger tags line up with the rough days.

More than stool Weight, worming, flea treatment, vaccinations, and every food, treat and chew. Not because a poop app needs them, but because a vet asks for all of it at a gut consultation, and a weight loss of a few percent is the thing an owner genuinely cannot see.

Yours, and only yours

No account. Nothing to sign up for.
Your logs and photos stay in this app on this phone. There is no cloud copy and no server to send them to.
No ads, no analytics, no third-party SDKs watching you.
Export everything whenever you like, as JSON or as a zip with the photos.
The only network use is Google Play handling the optional purchase.
Free, with one optional purchase Logging is free. Every safety alert is free, always, for as many days as you use the app. Petpoopy Pro is a single payment, not a subscription. It adds a second pet and beyond, the vet report, trends and patterns, history past thirty days, and the photo archive export.

A note on what this is: Petpoopy is a record you keep, not a diagnostic device. It does not analyse your photos, it stores them. Everything it shows you is a summary of what you told it. Anything worrying is a reason to ring your veterinary practice, and Petpoopy will say so.

description:

This app is free, ad-free, and without data collection. Forever.

You and you alone are responsible for your data, which is why it is not stored online.
Remember to create backup files regularly so that you don't lose them.
(Settings > Import / Export)

Life Notes is an app that allows you to record your chronic symptoms and lifestyle habits on a daily basis in order to monitor them, but also to potentially highlight some correlations.

It's possible to create your own symptom list in order to score them day after day, rating thef pain level intensity on a scale from 0 to 5.

It's also possible to record your meals, medications and add various notes, as well as your sleep schedules to highlight the causes of your symptoms. For example, it is easier to highlight the link between some of your meals and your possible stomach aches.

In addition to noting the daily evolution of the symptoms at different times of the day, it's also possible to enter an overall level of pain intensity over the course of a day in order to have a broader view of their evolution.

In short, Life-Notes offers what a simple notebook could do for you, but with a focus on tracking symptoms and providing statistics.

None of your data is sent online, 100% of your data is stored on your phone's memory.

Available languages: English, French

description:
Upright is a POTS tracker for people living with POTS (postural orthostatic tachycardia syndrome), dysautonomia and the conditions that travel with them. Diagnosed or still chasing answers, Upright turns confusing daily symptoms into clear patterns you and your doctor can act on.

ONE POTS APP FOR YOUR WHOLE DAILY ROUTINE
POTS is managed every single day: salt loading, fluids, the standing heart rate test, medications and avoiding triggers. Upright brings your whole POTS routine into one simple dysautonomia tracker, with a Today screen that shows where you stand at a glance.

STANDING HEART RATE TEST (NASA LEAN TEST)
Record your resting heart rate lying down and your peak heart rate standing. Upright flags a rise of 30 bpm or more, the threshold used for POTS, and charts your standing heart rate over days and weeks.

SALT, FLUID & ELECTROLYTE TRACKER
Log sodium and fluids in one tap and watch progress rings fill toward the daily targets your doctor set. For POTS, salt and electrolytes are frontline treatment, not a gimmick.

POTS SYMPTOM TRACKER & FLARE DIARY
Log dizziness, brain fog, racing heart, fatigue, nausea and fainting with a severity score and triggers like heat, standing, big meals and your menstrual cycle. Trends compares your symptom days with your low-salt days so you can see what sets off a POTS flare.

TRIGGER CORRELATIONS (PRO)
See each trigger ranked by how many episodes you tagged with it, its share of your flares and the average severity, over the last 30 days.

MEDICATION REMINDERS
Add midodrine, fludrocortisone, salt tablets, beta blockers or any other POTS medication with its dose and times. Upright reminds you when each dose is due, even when the app is closed, and tracks your adherence for the doctor report.

HISTORY
Browse every day you logged: salt, fluids, stand test and symptom episodes. The free plan keeps the last 30 days in view; Pro unlocks your full POTS history.

WEARABLE HEART RATE VIA HEALTH CONNECT (PRO)
With your permission, Upright reads the heart rate samples your watch recorded, through Health Connect and read-only, to fill in the resting and standing values of your stand test. Heart rate data is used only for the stand test and its trends, stays on your device and is never uploaded or shared.

DOCTOR-READY PDF & CSV REPORTS (PRO)
Export a POTS report with standing heart rate trends, symptom frequency, your top trigger, medication adherence and salt and fluid averages. Bring evidence to your cardiologist instead of a vague memory.

YOUR DATA STAYS ON YOUR PHONE
No account. No cloud. Works offline. Your health data never leaves your device.

BUILT FOR THE DYSAUTONOMIA COMMUNITY
POTS, dysautonomia, MCAS, EDS and hypermobility, long COVID and every spoonie managing a chronic illness. Upright speaks English, German, Spanish, French, Italian, Japanese, Dutch, Polish and Portuguese.

UPRIGHT PRO
PDF and CSV doctor reports, wearable heart rate sync, full trigger correlations and unlimited history. Start with a 7-day free trial on the annual plan; monthly and lifetime plans are available too. Invite a friend and you both get 30 days of Pro free.

MEDICAL DISCLAIMER
Upright is not a medical device and does not diagnose, treat or prevent any condition. Stand test results and trends are for tracking only, not a diagnosis. Always consult your doctor or a qualified healthcare professional before changing your salt, fluid or medication routine. If you faint and are injured, have chest pain or feel seriously unwell, seek emergency care.

💊 MEDICATION AND TREATMENT TRACKING
Track every dose and response across your full regimen:
- Opioids: tramadol, hydrocodone, oxycodone, morphine, fentanyl patches, buprenorphine
- NSAIDs: ibuprofen, naproxen, celecoxib, meloxicam, diclofenac
- Neuropathic agents: gabapentin, pregabalin, duloxetine, amitriptyline, nortriptyline

- Steroid courses, nerve blocks, epidurals, trigger point injections
- Scheduled versus PRN versus breakthrough doses
- Time to relief and effectiveness ratings per dose
- Opioid taper tracking with dose reduction milestones
- Side effect logging and refill reminders

🔍 TRIGGERS AND FLARE PATTERNS
Identify what pushes you into a flare and what brings relief:
- Weather: barometric pressure, temperature, humidity changes
- Activity: overexertion, pacing failures, prolonged sitting or standing
- Stress: emotional events, work pressure, sleep loss
- Diet: inflammatory foods, alcohol, caffeine, skipped meals
- Hormonal cycle phase and PMDD windows
- Flare duration and recovery time tracking
- Custom triggers you discover over time

📊 FUNCTIONAL IMPACT AND ADL SCORES
Measure what pain takes and what you reclaim:
- Activities of daily living scores: walking, dressing, cooking, driving
- Hours worked, studied, or spent upright
- Sleep disruption: onset delay, night waking, unrefreshing sleep
- Mood impact: frustration, anxiety, catastrophizing, helplessness
- Social withdrawal and isolation tracking
- Step count and mobility from Health Connect
- Physical therapy exercises and home program adherence
- TENS, heat, ice, and complementary therapy sessions

📈 INSIGHTS AND DOCTOR REPORTS
Months of entries become evidence your pain team can act on:
- Pain trends across weeks and months
- Body map heatmaps showing affected regions over time
- Medication response timelines and breakthrough frequency
- Trigger correlation charts with statistical weight
- Function and sleep overlay graphs
- Flare frequency and average duration
- PDF and CSV reports for pain management, neurology, rheumatology
- One-tap sharing for appointments

🛡️ DESIGNED FOR HIGH-PAIN DAYS
- 30-second quick logging when pain is too high for detail
- Voice-to-text for hands-free entry
- Calm low-stimulation interface
- Offline mode for entries anywhere
- Optional passcode and biometric lock

name: Pain Tracker & Diary
description:
This app helps you understand and precisely share what you feel daily and keeps track of what types of pain your treatments are helping.

WHY DID WE MAKE THIS?
You hurt. Your pain is chronic and complicated. You can’t remember everything. You want your doctors to understand, but you don’t know how to explain what you feel.

PAIN IS LIFE-CHANGING. HELP IS HERE.
Nanolume® developed the Pain Tracker & Diary to help you record the daily textures, intensities, and locations of what you feel, so you and your care team can better understand what you are suffering with and follow how your pain responds to medications and treatments.

TRACK IT BETTER. TREAT IT BETTER.
Pain is a complex experience. It often includes multiple pain types (layers), each with its own unique texture, intensity, location, and surface area.

By keeping a diary that integrates complex information, you can show your doctors what you are experiencing to help them make a better diagnosis, choose more appropriate medications and treatments, and monitor if your treatments are beneficial. In addition, by keeping such an integrated record, trends might emerge that would otherwise go unnoticed.

PAIN IS DIFFERENT.
Pain is a subjective (not objective) sensation that you cannot measure. Its assessment relies on each person’s ability to communicate what they feel. Nanolume® developed this digital diary to help you record what you feel every day.

INCLUDED FEATURES.
For each diary entry you create:
• Choose a Pain Type. Choose from a list of predefined pain types or create a customized pain type. Next, tap the icon of the pain type you feel is most intense (you can come back and add more types later).
• Select the Intensity. Select the intensity of your pain type using a Numeric Rating Scale (NRS).
• Draw an Outline. Use your finger to draw an “outline” of the type of pain you are experiencing on the front and back sides of a generalized map of your body.
• Calculated Surface Areas. The app displays the percent [%] of your body surface affected by each (or all) of the pain types you draw.
• Zoom. Need to see a larger image of your hand or foot? Double-tap: once to zoom x2; twice to zoom x4; a third time to restore the original size.
• Notes. Tap the “Notepad” icon located in the top-left corner of each opened diary entry to record any details of your medications or treatment results.
• Tap "Add Pain." Choose another pain type (layer) to draw.
• Save Your Diary Entry. Tap "Done" to create a snapshot of all the pain type layers you drew. The app attaches the date and time your entry was saved.
• Open a Saved Entry. Tap on the date and time of the entry you want to review. Look at the intensity, location, and surface area of each pain type you experienced (by touching the icon of the pain type you want to see) or see all the pain types at once and see how they overlap (tap the "All Layers" icon). Swipe the picture left or right to check how your other pain entries compare over time.
• Charts. View a summary of your data in "Charts."
• Forget to Save an Entry? Go back and recreate a "pain picture" from the past; then, use the "Calendar" icon to backdate the recreated entry.
• Calendar Backdating. Touch the "Calendar" icon to backdate any pain-picture you draw to create a record of what you remember from the past.
• Copy/Edit. Copy or edit a copy of a previous entry.
• CSV Export. Email or save a numeric file of your data, then open that data in a spreadsheet.
• Interactive Summary & Animation. Play an animation of your data to see how your pain types change within any period you choose by selecting the corresponding start/stop dates.
• PDF Export. Export your charts, drawings, and notes as a PDF file.

PRIVACY IS IMPORTANT.
Your data is stored on your device only and not collected or stored by Nanolume® LLC. Read our End-User License Agreement and Privacy Policy at www.nanolume.com.

name: TrackerControl Slim
description:
TrackerControl Slim is an Android app that allows users to STUDY the widespread, ongoing, hidden data collection in mobile apps about user behaviour (‘tracking’).

To detect tracking, TrackerControl combines the power of the Disconnect tracker list, used by Firefox, and our in-house tracker list, created from analysing ~2 000 000 apps!

Additionally, TrackerControl detects tracker libraries in apps using the signatures from ClassyShark3xodus/Exodus Privacy for the analysis of tracker libraries within app code.

The app also aims to educate about your rights under Data Protection Law, such the EU General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR).

Under the hood, TrackerControl uses Android’s VPN functionality, to analyse apps’ network communications locally on the Android device. This is accomplished through a local VPN server, to enable network traffic analysis by TrackerControl. To establish this VPN, TrackerControl expands on the work from NetGuard.

No root is required, other VPNs or Private DNS are not supported. No external VPN server is used, to keep your data safe!

name: MyCabinet: Medicine Management
description:
MyCabinet is your go-to solution for effortless medication management, making it easier than ever to organize and track medications, vitamins, and supplements in one place. Designed for individuals and busy caregivers, it promotes better health outcomes and reduces preventable risks.

What MyCabinet Can Do for You:

- Manage Prescription & Non-Prescription Medications: Track all your medications, health products, vitamins, and supplements in one place.
- Multiple Cabinets: Organize medications for yourself and your loved ones with separate, customizable medicine cabinets.
- Drug Interaction Checks: Ensure safety by checking for potential interactions between your prescription medications.
- Health Document Storage: Save and share medical documents securely.
- Medication & Refill Reminders: Set personalized reminders to take and refill your meds on time.
- One-Click Sharing: Easily share your list of medications with doctors, caregivers or in an emergency, with a single click.
- Monitor Adherence: Track your medication habits and stay consistent.
- Prescription Refills: Refill your prescriptions directly through the app.
- Drug and Supplement Discounts (Coming Soon!): Access exclusive discounts on your medications, vitamins and supplements.
- Rewards (Coming Soon!): Earn rewards and level up as you engage with the app.

MyCabinet is designed to benefit a wide range of users, from individuals managing their own medications, vitamins and supplements to caregivers responsible for loved ones' health. Busy families can streamline medication tracking for multiple members with separate, customizable cabinets, while seniors or those with chronic conditions can set reminders to ensure they stay on top of their prescriptions. With MyCabinet, anyone involved in managing medications can experience a more organized, reliable, and convenient approach to health.

MyCabinet isn’t just for medications—it’s also perfect for managing your vitamins and supplements. Whether you're tracking vitamins, minerals, or herbal products, the app helps you organize all your supplements in one place. Set reminders to take them on time and easily share your supplement list with healthcare providers so they can have a more comprehensive view of your health regimen and can identify potential interactions.

MyCabinet is fully HIPAA-compliant, ensuring that your personal health information is protected with the highest standards of security and privacy. The app is designed to meet the stringent regulations set by the Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act (HIPAA), safeguarding sensitive health data like your medication records, prescriptions, and personal information. MyCabinet offers peace of mind to users, healthcare providers, and caregivers, ensuring that health information is handled safely and confidentially.

It's medication management made simple, secure, and tailored for all. Start managing your health the easy way with MyCabinet today!

name: Chronic Friends: Symptom Log
description:
Living with a chronic condition can be lonely and hard to explain. Chronic Friends gives you a warm, private place to record how you really are, see your own patterns and meet people who understand you — because they live it too.

Chronic Friends is dedicated to chronic illness alone. The app walks beside Crohn's disease, ulcerative colitis, irritable bowel syndrome, rheumatoid arthritis, fibromyalgia, psoriasis, endometriosis, asthma, COPD, diabetes, chronic fatigue (ME/CFS), migraine, anxiety, depression and many more — close to 50 conditions, sorted by body system, so you only see what applies to you. Living with more than one? Track several at once.

YOUR DAILY CHECK-IN
• One quick journal a day: pain, energy, sleep, food, movement, mood and more
• Extra questions tuned to your conditions: joints, skin, eyes, digestion, breathing, pelvic health, mind
• A calendar that shows good days and hard days at a glance

YOUR OWN PATTERNS
• Clear charts of everything you log — across weeks, months or years
• My Flare Radar gathers your latest entries into a single picture — a starting point for your next appointment, never a diagnosis
• Download a PDF report for your doctor — free for everyone

MEDICATION UNDER CONTROL
• Reminders with their own long alarm sound, repeated up to three times until you answer
• Mark every dose as taken or missed, and get a heads-up when you are running low

FLARE MODE — FOR THE HARD DAYS
• One tap makes the app calmer and quieter
• Gentle quick entries, an emergency card and a flare report to download — all free
• Breathing and grounding exercises (Meditation) and offline games (Entertainment) are part of Premium

A COMMUNITY THAT GETS IT
• Share experiences and encouragement with people who know what you mean
• Kind by design: peer experiences, not medical advice

PREMIUM
Chronic Friends is free — including the community, the full journal, medication reminders, Health Sync and every PDF report. Premium unlocks four things: Food Scan, Tools, Meditation and Entertainment.
• Monthly US$19.99 · 6 months US$87.99 · Yearly US$167.99 · Lifetime US$599.99 (one-time)
• 30-day free trial on the recurring plans
Prices may vary by region; the final price is always shown in the store before you buy.

YOUR DATA IS YOURS
We never sell your data and never use it for advertising. You can export or delete everything whenever you want.
Privacy: https://www.chronicfriends.org/privacy/
Terms: https://www.chronicfriends.org/terms/

IMPORTANT — PLEASE READ
Chronic Friends is a wellness, self-tracking and community tool for adults (18+). It is not a medical device and does not provide medical advice, diagnosis or treatment. The charts, the radar and the summaries only show and describe the data you enter yourself — they do not predict, diagnose or detect any illness. Always talk to your doctor about any concern regarding your health, and never ignore professional medical advice because of something you saw in the app. In an emergency, call your emergency services.

We don't wait for good days: we build them.

name: TOM Medication & Pill Reminder
description:
TOM is your cost-free, ad-free and anonymous, daily medication reminder with an integrated medicine list and log, that makes it easy for you to manage your medicine and allows you to enter measurements and record activities. The TOM medical alert app is a fully integrated medical assistant with a daily pill reminder.

With our medical alert app, you can add a new medicine to your virtual medication list in just seconds. Your medical assistant TOM does the rest for you. With our pill reminder app, you will forget about any registration, charge, and advertising!
User-friendly and completely anonymous: the integrated medicine reminder will notify you whenever it’s time to take your pills, tablets, and other meds, making your daily activities much simpler. Now for measurements and activities as well, including graphs and statistics showing everything at a glance.

Developed by patients, for patients
The TOM medication reminder with the integrated medicine list and medication log is so practical and user-friendly because its developers know from personal experience which requirements a digital medication tracker and scheduler need to meet. The pill reminder is the ideal solution for simply and efficiently managing treatment regimens for a wide range of conditions, including diabetes, high blood pressure, asthma, Crohn’s disease, stroke, epilepsy, cardiovascular diseases, multiple sclerosis, and more.

Key features of the medical alert app at a glance
• Easy to use thanks to dialogue-based design: TOM asks and you reply – without filling in forms or having to tediously search through menus
• Add new meds, measurements, or activities quickly and easily
• Send or print PDFs of monthly health reports
• Medication log and medicine list with high-quality graphs and statistics for all pills taken, health measurements, and activities
• Feature for uploading your own pictures of med packaging
• Digital cabinet provides a complete medication list that can be printed out as a PDF file
• Pill reminder with alarm to refill prescriptions before they run out or expire
• Fully integrated treatment management that combines a record of meds you have taken with your health measurements (blood pressure and weight, for example) and activities (running, yoga, etc.)
• Keep your medication log up to date: pills are taken daily, medicine intervals of several days or hours, single doses or taken sporadically
• Suitable for managing the treatment of a wide range of conditions and diseases (cardiovascular disease, diabetes, high blood pressure, multiple sclerosis, stroke, asthma, etc.)
• Modern solution for managing medicine in order to ensure they are taken at the right time and to monitor the progress of your treatment
• Medication reminder if you forget to take your pills
• Maximum data security thanks to the anonymous use of the TOM pill reminder and two-way encryption

Privacy and data protection are top priority
Using the TOM medication tracker and scheduler is completely anonymous: no registration with personal details is required. The information you enter is linked only to a randomly generated ID number. Even TOM does not have access to this number, as it is also cryptographically protected. In addition, all communication with the TOM app is encrypted in both directions.

Download the TOM medication reminder on your smartphone and let the simple medication tracker and scheduler add some extra freedom to your daily life. Never forget to take your tablets, pills, or medicine again thanks to the pill reminder and medicine tracker. Suitable for a wide range of conditions, including high blood pressure, asthma, stroke, cardiovascular diseases, diabetes, etc.

SUBMIT YOUR FEEDBACK TO HELP IMPROVE TOM
Thank you for using the TOM medical alert app. Your feedback helps us to further develop the TOM medication reminder and offer you maximum benefit. We always encourage you to send your suggestions and ideas to support@tommedications.com.

name: Doctor On Demand
description:
Doctor On Demand by Included Health offers 24/7 access to board-certified doctors, licensed therapists, and psychiatrists via secure video visits from your phone, tablet, or computer. When you're feeling sick, want a doctor’s note, need help with a prescription, and more, we make it easy to get quality telehealth anytime, anywhere—with or without insurance. Download the free Doctor On Demand app to get started.

Why Choose Doctor On Demand?

Fast Access to Online Doctors – See a board-certified, US-based provider with telehealth appointments anytime, day or night.

Therapy & Psychiatry – Book virtual visits for mental health concerns like stress, anxiety, depression, PTSD, trauma, and more.

Online Urgent Care, Treatment, Prescriptions – For colds, flu, allergies, skin conditions, UTIs, headaches, and more, our providers can send prescriptions to nearby pharmacies if medically appropriate.

Doctor’s Notes – Need a doctor’s note for work or school? We’ve got you covered. See an urgent care provider for help.

Insurance or Self-Pay – We work with major health plans and many employers to reduce the costs of visits for eligible members. If not covered, we offer affordable visit costs to all patients with no surprise bills.

How It Works

 1. Download the app and create an account for free.
 2. Choose to see the first available provider, or schedule a visit.
 3. Get personalized care, prescriptions, and treatment plans in an online visit.

Conditions We Treat
✔️ Cold, Flu & Sinus Infections
✔️ UTI Treatment Online
✔️ Acne, Rashes & Skin Issues
✔️ Allergies & Asthma
✔️ High Cholesterol, Diabetes & Thyroid Screening
✔️ Headaches & Migraines
✔️ Mental Health Support: Anxiety, Depression, Grief & More
✔️ Prescription Refills & Lab Orders

Frequently Asked Questions
🕒 When are doctors available?
Our virtual providers are available 24/7, 365 days a year, including weekends and holidays. Mental health appointments are often available within days—much faster than traditional providers who can take weeks

💲 How much does a visit cost?
You’ll always see your exact visit cost upfront. We accept most insurance plans and partner with top employers and health plans to lower your costs. No insurance? Our telehealth visit costs are affordable.

👩‍⚕️ Who are the doctors?
Our US-based, board-certified doctors, licensed psychiatrists, and therapists have an average of 15 years of experience and come from diverse specialties to ensure you receive expert care.

🤳How does it work?
Join a telehealth visit to connect face to face with a provider from your phone, tablet, or computer in as little as ten minutes. Like an in-person visit, your provider will discuss with you how you’re feeling, your healthcare history, and propose a recommended treatment plan. Labs, screenings, and prescriptions will be sent to nearby facilities.

⚕️What can you treat?
Our urgent care doctors can treat hundreds of issues, including cold and flu, urinary tract infections, allergies, headache, sprains, and skin conditions. They can also order labs and screenings to help with preventative care and help manage chronic care conditions. Our extensive team of therapists and psychiatrists are able to treat anxiety, stress, depression, PTSD, trauma and loss relationships, and more.

Your Privacy is Our Priority
We adhere to strict HIPAA guidelines to protect your health data and personal information.

Our providers are unable to prescribe controlled substances.

Get Started Today
Join millions of patients who trust Doctor On Demand for fast, convenient, and reliable healthcare. Download the app now to sign up for free!

name: Kin - Record Doctor Visits
description:
Record doctor visits. Get clear summaries. Remember what to do next.

Kin helps you prepare for healthcare appointments, capture the conversation, and follow through afterward so you can stay present during the visit instead of taking notes or trying to remember everything later.

After each visit, Kin turns the conversation into a focused summary. Rather than giving you a word-for-word transcript, Kin organizes the key points, recommendations, and next steps so you can quickly understand what happened and what to do next.

Kin is available in English and Spanish. Record visits in either language and get your visit summary and next steps in Spanish when you prefer.

Use Kin for your own doctor visits or to help care for a parent, spouse, or loved one. Kin also supports women's health, pregnancy, children's appointments, specialist care, repeat follow-ups, and other important health conversations.

WHAT KIN HELPS YOU DO

Record appointments

Tap record before or during a visit. Kin captures the conversation so you can focus on the discussion instead of taking notes.

Prepare for the visit

Tell Kin about an upcoming appointment and it builds your agenda with you, asking who the visit is for and what you want from it. Or save your own questions, concerns, symptoms, notes, photos, and documents.

Talk to Kin

Ask Kin anything with your voice, from any chat or straight from the lock screen. Interrupt and change direction whenever you want.

Use Kin by text

Text Kin and it is the same Kin you use in the app. Share a visit, send photos, audio, or video, or start a group so two parents can manage a child's care together.

Bring important health information

Keep relevant health information and documents with Kin so they are easier to reference before, during, and after appointments.

Review a clear summary

See the key points, recommendations, and next steps from the conversation without having to read through a long transcript.

Stay on top of next steps

One to-do list across every visit and everyone you care for. Open a task to see which visit it came from. Keep track of medications, lab work, referrals, questions, and follow-up appointments.

Share with your care circle

Invite family members or caregivers to review summaries and stay aligned on what happened and what comes next.

BUILT FOR REAL CARE MOMENTS

Regular doctor visits

Keep a useful history of appointments and summaries across doctors and specialists.

Older adults and caregivers

Help a parent, spouse, or loved one remember instructions, organize follow-up, and share updates.

Patient portals and health records

Use Kin alongside your patient portal. Bring relevant records, documents, and questions into the visit, capture the conversation, and keep the summary and next steps organized afterward.

Women's health

Use Kin for fertility, pregnancy, postpartum, menopause, and other women's health conversations.

Parents and children

Capture your child's appointments, questions, instructions, and follow-up care so important details are easier to remember.

Ongoing and specialist care

Use Kin for specialist visits, lab work, referrals, recurring appointments, and continued follow-up.

Pet and vet visits

Keep veterinary visit notes, care instructions, and next steps organized for your pets.

BUILT ALONGSIDE DOCTORS

Kin supports your care but does not replace your doctor or healthcare provider. Kin does not diagnose, prescribe, or make medical decisions. It helps you capture the visit, understand what was discussed, and follow the care plan you were given.

PRIVACY AND CONTROL

Your health information belongs to you. You decide who can access your visit information, and you can delete recordings or summaries at any time.

Download Kin and make every important appointment easier to remember.

Timeshifter — Shift Work Edition — was developed to help shift workers reduce the underlying problem of circadian and sleep disruption inherent in shift work. With Timeshifter, you will receive highly personalized advice based on your sleep pattern, chronotype, work schedule, and personal preferences.

SHIFT WORK MYTHS VS. CIRCADIAN SCIENCE

Shift workers face a serious biological challenge: misalignment between their internal circadian rhythms and their work schedules. This circadian disruption leads to insomnia, excessive sleepiness, poor performance, and increased long-term health risks.

Popular advice — like drinking more coffee, using supplements, or simply “getting more rest” — misses the mark. These approaches don’t address the root cause: your circadian misalignment.

It’s time to replace the myths with real science.

Generic tips won’t solve circadian disruption. Only evidence-based interventions that "reset" your circadian rhythms and manage circadian timing can effectively reduce the negative effects of shift work.

THE REAL SCIENCE OF SHIFT WORK

// In your brain, a circadian clock regulates the rhythm of your day.
// Shift work causes your sleep and other behaviors to occur at biologically inappropriate times, resulting in fatigue, poor sleep, and long-term health risks.
// Light is the most powerful cue for resetting your circadian clock. The correct timing of light exposure and light avoidance is the foundation of any circadian intervention to improve alertness and sleep quality. If your timing is off, it can make things worse.

WHY SHIFT WORKERS LOVE TIMESHIFTER

// Based on the latest sleep and circadian science
// Optimizes your sleep, alertness, and performance
// Reduces the negative effects of shift work on productivity, health, and quality of life

Using Timeshifter is as simple as taking small actions at specific times.

KEY FEATURES

// Circadian Time™: Advice is based on your individual circadian clock

// Fatigue Prediction: Warns you when to be extra cautious to avoid mistakes and accidents
// Advice Notifications: Get timely advice even without opening the app

NO EXPENSIVE EQUIPMENT REQUIRED

Timeshifter is a highly empowering experience, and it requires no special equipment. Just a sleep mask and your favorite dark sunglasses.

TRY IT FREE

A 30-day free trial is available — no commitment required! After your trial, you can choose to subscribe monthly ($6.99/mo) or annually ($69.99/yr).

name: Timezone Converter World Clock
description:
Timezone converts a moment between places, keeps a world clock of the cities
you care about, and finds the hours when everybody is awake at once. It works
with no connection at all.

WHAT MOST TIME ZONE APPS GET WRONG

A time zone is not a city, and an offset is not a time zone. A zone is a rule:
a history of offsets and the dates they changed. Almost every converter here
ignores that, looks up two offsets, subtracts them and adds the difference to
the time you typed. That is wrong three ways:

• It uses TODAY'S offsets for a date in July. London is UTC+0 now and UTC+1
then.

• It uses one country's changeover dates for another. America moves its clocks
three weeks before Europe does, so for three weeks every March New York is
four hours behind London, not five.

• It cannot represent the answer at all when the local time it was handed does
not exist, or exists twice.

Here, converting is reading one point on the timeline in another set of rules.
There is no arithmetic to get wrong.

THE TWO MORNINGS A YEAR

On the morning the clocks go forward, an hour of local time does not happen.
There is no 2:30am in New York on 8 March. On the night they go back, an hour
happens twice: 1:30am in London on 25 October is two different moments, sixty
minutes apart.

Almost every app handles this silently — it shows 3:30 when you typed 2:30, or
picks one of the two 1:30s and never mentions the other. This one says so, in a
sentence, and lets you take the second.

It also knows Britain loses a different hour from America: the clocks go
forward at 1am there, so 2:30 is an ordinary time in London that morning and a
missing one in New York.

WHEN CAN WE ALL TALK

Pick two to five places and say what hours each of them works — nine to five,
eight to four, or ten at night to six in the morning. The app shows every
stretch of the day that is inside everybody's window.

It handles the day boundary, because it never works in local dates: Tokyo's
Monday morning really is Los Angeles's Sunday afternoon. And when there is NO
overlap — the honest answer for the Pacific against the American west coast on
office hours — it says so in words, rather than showing an empty strip you will
assume failed to load.

Places forty-five minutes off the hour work properly: India, Nepal, the Chatham
Islands and Eucla are real, and a three-quarter-usable hour is shown as one.

THE CLOCKS

Every city you add, ticking: the local time, whether it is yesterday, today or
tomorrow there, and how far ahead or behind you it is. Every row recomputes
itself every second, so land somewhere and the whole list re-reads itself
against your new zone.

SEARCHING

Type a city, not an abbreviation. Accents do not matter: sao paulo finds São
Paulo and zurich finds Zürich. Abbreviations are never an input, because they
cannot mean one zone — CST is three zones and IST is two — though the app will
show you one beside a place you chose.

The whole IANA database is in the app: every zone, every historical offset.
Nothing is fetched.

ALSO

• 12-hour or 24-hour, or follow the phone
• Compare against the phone's zone, or pin one while you are away
• Light and dark, and Material You if you want it
• Save a copy of your list to a file — this is how you move to a new phone

WHAT IT WILL NOT DO

No location, ever. Detecting which zone you are standing in is the flagship
feature of the paid rivals here and it is refused: the phone already knows its
own zone for free, and every other place on your list is one you typed.

No account, no sync, no server, and no notifications — nothing here will ever
interrupt you. Uninstalling deletes your list, and Save a copy is how you move
it.

Three permissions, all of them for the ads that keep it free.

• Country-specific content so you can plan for exactly where you're headed

WHY THIS APP
Montenegro offers 250+ sunny days a year, the Adriatic coast, mountains and historic towns within easy reach, and a growing international community of remote workers. Bosnia and Herzegovina brings its own mix of nature, culture and affordable living. This app brings both destinations together in one place, so you can spend less time researching and more time working — and living — well.

ABOUT THE PROJECT
Digital Nomads is developed as part of Project STAR, a cross-border cooperation initiative between Montenegro and Bosnia and Herzegovina, co-funded by the European Union, aimed at supporting sustainable tourism and remote work opportunities in the region.

Download the app to explore coworking spaces, accommodation, service providers, routes and experiences designed to make your stay easier — wherever in the region you choose to work from next.

name: Plant Care Tracker - Ploi
description:
Ploi is a plant care tracker for people who want to remember what they did and when. Log every watering, build a care history for each plant, and let Ploi learn your routine instead of following a generic schedule.

Watering reminders that learn

No app can tell you exactly how often to water your plants: it depends on light, humidity, pot size and season. So Ploi learns instead of guessing. Log a watering, and Ploi picks up your real rhythm and moves the next reminder to match. The more you log, the better the reminders fit.

Your plants on the home screen

Add the Ploi widget to your home screen in one of three sizes and see what needs care without opening the app. It shows what is overdue and what is due today, the weather where your plants live, and a count of the plants that are already happy. Tap a plant and it opens. Under Settings you choose what the widget shows and write your own message for the days when everything is done.

A journal for every plant

Every watering, feeding, repotting and note goes into that plant's own timeline, and you can scroll back through it any time. Weeks later you can see exactly when you last fertilized, how long the plant went without water, or the day a new leaf appeared. It is a care log and a plant diary in one.

Growth photos over time

Add a photo to any log entry and watch your plant's story come together. A fiddle leaf fig, a monstera, a snake plant or a peace lily all look different six months on, and Ploi keeps every photo so you can see the change for yourself.

Care guides by species

Ploi includes care guides for individual plant species, covering watering, light, soil and humidity. Look up what your plant needs instead of relying on a generic houseplant article.

Plant identification

Not sure what you have? Take a photo and Ploi identifies the species, then starts a care log for it. Most people start with identification — but what Ploi is really for is everything you record afterwards.

Wishlist and rooms

Keep a wishlist of plants you want, and group the ones you own by room or windowsill, so you can water everything in one trip around the house.

Built for people who like to keep records

When did I last water this? How has it changed? Which routine actually worked? Ploi answers all three.

Subscribe for unlimited plants and advanced care features.

name: PlantNet Plant Identification
description:
Pl@ntNet is an application that allows you to identify plants simply by photographing them with your smartphone. Very useful when you don't have a botanist on hand! Pl@ntNet is also a great citizen science project: all the plants you photograph are collected and analysed by scientists around the world to better understand the evolution of plant biodiversity and to better preserve it.

Pl@ntNet allows you to identify and better understand all kinds of plants living in nature: flowering plants, trees, grasses, conifers, ferns, vines, wild salads or cacti. Pl@ntNet can also identify a large number of cultivated plants (in parks and gardens) but this is not its primary purpose. We especially need Pl@ntNet’s users to inventory the wild plants, those that you can observe in nature of course but also those that grow on the sidewalks of our cities or in the middle of your vegetable garden!

The more visual information you give to Pl@ntNet about the plant you are observing, the more accurate the identification will be. There are indeed many plants that look alike from afar and it is sometimes small details that distinguish two species of the same genus. Flowers, fruits and leaves are the most characteristic organs of a species and it is them that should be photographed first. But any other detail can be useful, such as thorns, buds or hair on the stem. A photograph of the whole plant (or the tree if it is one!) is also very useful information, but it is often not sufficient to allow a reliable identification.

At present Pl@ntNet makes it possible to recognize about 20,000 species. We are still a long way from the 360,000 species living on earth, but Pl@ntNet is getting richer every day thanks to the contributions of the most experienced users among you. Don't be afraid to contribute yourself! Your observation will be reviewed by the community and may one day join the photo gallery illustrating the species in the application.

The new version of Pl@ntNet released in January 2019 includes many improvements and new features:
- The ability to filter recognized species by genus or family.
- The differentiated data revision that gives more weight to users who have demonstrated the most skills (in particular the number of species observed, validated by the community).
- The re-identification of shared observations, whether yours or those of other users of the application.
- The multi-flora identification that allows you to search for the photographed plant in all the flora of the application and not only in the one you have selected. Very useful when you are not sure what flora to look for.
- The selection of your favorite floras to access them more quickly.
- The navigation at different taxonomic levels in image galleries.
- The mapping of your observations.
- Links to many factsheets.

The web version of the application is also available at the following address: https://identify.plantnet.org/

name: Flora Incognita
description:
FLORA INCOGNITA - DISCOVER THE DIVERSITY OF NATURE

What's blooming? With the Flora Incognita app, this question is quickly answered. Take a picture of a plant, find out what it's called and learn everything you want to know with the help of a fact sheet. Highly precise algorithms based on artificial intelligence identify wild plants even when they are not (yet) in bloom!

In the Flora Incognita app you can easily view all your collected plant finds in a observation list. Maps show where you have found your plants. This way you can see how your knowledge about wild plants is growing.

But Flora Incognita is even more! The app is free of charge and without advertising, because it is part of a scientific research project that aims to improve nature conservation. The collected observations are used to answer scientific research questions that deal, for example, with the spread of invasive species or the effects of climate change on biotopes.

In regular stories, you will learn about news from the project, get insights into the scientific work or will be made curious about what is happening in nature right now.

WHY SHOULD YOU USE FLORA INCOGNITA?
- Identify wild plants simply by taking a photo with your smartphone
- Learn more about plant species with the help of extensive plant profiles
- Collect your findings in your observation list
- Become part of an innovative scientific community
- Share your findings on Twitter, Instagram & Co!

HOW GOOD IS FLORA INCOGNITA?
Species identification with Flora Incognita is based on Deep Learning algorithms that have an accuracy of well over 90%. It is important to take sharp and as close as possible pictures of plant parts such as flower, leaf, bark or fruit for a high identification accuracy.

WOULD YOU LIKE TO LEARN MORE ABOUT OUR PROJECT?
Visit our website at www.floraincognita.com or follow us on social media. You can find us on X (@FloraIncognita2), Mastodon (@FloraIncognita@social.mpdl.mpg.de), Instagram (@flora.incognita) and Facebook (@flora.incognita).

IS THE APP REALLY FREE OF CHARGE AND ADVERTISING?
Yes. You can use Flora Incognita anytime, as long as you want. It is free to use, with no ads, no premium version and no subscription. But maybe you will enjoy searching and identifying plants so much that it will become a new hobby. We have received this feedback many times!

WHO DEVELOPED FLORA INCOGNITA?
The Flora Incognita app is developed by scientists from the Technical University of Ilmenau and the Max Planck Institute for Biogeochemistry Jena. Its development was supported by the German Federal Ministry of Education and Research, the German Federal Agency for Nature Conservation with funds from the German Federal Ministry for the Environment, Nature Conservation and Nuclear Safety as well as the Thuringian Ministry for the Environment, Energy and Nature Conservation and the Foundation for Nature Conservation Thuringia. The project was awarded as an official project of the "UN Decade of Biodiversity" and won the Thuringian Research Award in 2020.

name: Veggie Garden Planner
description:
The Veggie Garden Planner provides you with clearly arranged information that you need to quickly compose your vegetable garden patch.

Before purchase we provide a free download so you can see for yourself what value the app provides.
Choose vegetables that harmonise well together. You will find information regarding good/bad neighbor plants for each vegetable.

For your chosen garden composition you get tabular overviews to quickly determine sowing/harvest times, and which interactions exist between vegetables.

As an bonus feature, you can visually arrange your vegetable patch with our Patch Plan Editor - with vital information regarding planting distance & good/bad neighbors at your fingertips.

Note regarding the climate zone: The seedtimes and harvesttimes are adjusted to hardiness zones USDA 7-8 (e.g. Atlanta, Seattle or Central Europe). Please adapt accordingly.

Our garden planner helps you to quickly and clearly select your desired vegetable and fruit varieties. Improve your harvest by the right plant location, whether sunny location or depleted soil. Then simply plant low-growing plants that will thrive ideally with the sunlight in your garden.

Companion planting:
Pay particular attention to mixed cropping, making sure your planned vegetable varieties get along well with each other in the bed and garden. You will find information on good and bad neighbors for each variety.
Once you have selected your planned vegetables, you can quickly see the interrelationships between the varieties on the neighbor overview. In the clear calendar you can immediately see which vegetables need to be sown when, and from when they can be harvested.

Patch planner:
As a bonus feature, you can use the virtual bed plan to create your patch and freely arrange your desired vegetable varieties. Essential information such as planting distances, location selection, nutrient requirements and good/bad neighbors are displayed directly.

Multiple patchs:
You can also create multiple beds - even for several years. Simply take over the plantings from the previous year and optimize your bed according to your needs.

Own varieties:
If our large selection of vegetables, fruits and herbs is not enough for you, you can also create your own special varieties. For example, take the data of a vegetable and edit it. Take your own photos of your vegetables and customize your varieties.

Pre-plan on the tablet:
Pre-plan your bed on your tablet - save your planning in the cloud - with your smartphone you can wonderfully track or optimize the planning in the garden.

Note regarding the climate zone: The seedtimes and harvesttimes are adjusted to hardiness zones USDA 7-8 (e.g. Atlanta, Seattle or Central Europe). Please adapt accordingly.

► Watch them grow

Get instant warnings for plants that aren't safe around pets and kids, with clear tips. Your plants stay a source of calm, not worry.

-Revive the "unrevivable." Bring dry, yellow plants back to lush and full.

-Grow with confidence. Drop the guesswork. Get it right every time.

-Create your sanctuary. Build the calm, green, Pinterest perfect home you want to come back to.

name: MyPlants: Plant Care Tracker
description:
Grow plants, not guilt.

Most plants die of good intentions. MyPlants keeps your plant care calendar and names the pots that are thirsty today, before you have to ask. It remembers which one drank when, so you water them in one tap and get on with your morning.

A nudge, not a nag. One quiet watering reminder arrives on the day a pot is thirsty, written like a friend. "Rosa the monstera and Gael the fern would love a splash." You pick the hour it lands, and however many pots you keep, that is one message a day, never forty.

Every plant keeps its own rhythm. You know your windowsill better than a species chart does, so you set the interval yourself, from 3, 7, 14 and 30-day presets or any number you like, and its plant watering schedule builds itself. Succulent care runs on its own clock, and the thirsty fern beside it runs on another.

• Every pot gets a status you can read in a glance. Happy, thirsty, or taking it slow
• A plant photo timeline that shows one plant month by month, so you catch the week it finally took off
• Every drink, feed and repot lands in a plant journal. Add a photo and a year of growth fits in one scroll
• A streak chip on Home that counts the days nobody went thirsty
• Fifteen plant stickers, for the pots you never got around to photographing
• Eight plant-named themes, from Peace Lily to Bird of Paradise, and ten home-screen icons, so it looks like the plants you own

Your garden sorts itself the way a plant parent looks at it, thirstiest first. A garden tracker should show you the shape of a week, so the tiles count the plants you keep and the waters you have poured, and Coming up answers the question you keep asking yourself, which is when do I water my plants.

The journal is a garden tracker with a memory. Every water, feed, repot and note lands on one timeline you can filter, so the plant care log writes itself out of what you already did. Read it back as a plant diary, or skim the monthly tiles for the shape of a season.

Three pots or thirty, a plant tracker app should fit the shelf you have. A jade that wants succulent care once a month, a fiddle-leaf fig that sulks when you are late and a balcony full of indoor plants sit side by side, each on its own plant watering schedule. From there the plant tracker counts the days so you do not have to.

Houseplant care that fits the two minutes before you leave the house. For the new plant parent with five pots and no idea what each one wants. For the collector whose indoor plants drink on ten different days, where succulent care and fern care are two different jobs. Every plant parent has a fern they nearly lost, and this is how you stop losing them.

Your garden tracker lives on your phone. This is a houseplant care app that works offline by design: no account, no cloud, no ads, no analytics, and every photo of your home stays where you took it. Indoor plants get watered on a plane, in a greenhouse with no signal, in a basement with no bars.

A cosy corner for your leafy friends. Five plants, every watering reminder and the full care log are free forever. Premium lifts the cap and opens every theme, timeline and sticker.

Grow without limits.

Verdura is an adaptive houseplant care companion that learns how you care for your plants and builds a personalized watering schedule around your real habits.

Most plant care apps give you a fixed timer. Verdura is different. It watches your actual watering patterns, factors in your indoor light, humidity, pot size, soil type, and the current season — then suggests
when each plant truly needs attention. The more you log, the smarter it gets.

ADAPTIVE WATERING SCHEDULES
Verdura combines species data with your real care history to calculate the ideal watering interval. After just a few logs, the schedule shifts to match your rhythm — not a generic guideline. It even adjusts
automatically for winter dormancy and summer growth based on your hemisphere.

COMPLETE CARE LOGGING
Track every care action: watering, fertilizing, misting, pruning, repotting, and pest treatments. Add optional notes to any entry. Your care history becomes a detailed plant journal you can review anytime.

SMART REMINDERS THAT RESPECT YOU
Get gentle or standard notifications at your preferred time. Snooze reminders with one tap (+1 day or +3 days). If you repeatedly skip a reminder, Verdura quietly backs off — no nagging. You can also set a
manual next-check date for any plant when you know better.

PLANT PHOTO JOURNAL
Snap a photo when you add a plant and update it over time. Watch your collection grow visually from your dashboard.

CALENDAR VIEW
See your entire care schedule at a glance. Know exactly which plants need attention today, tomorrow, or next week. Review past care actions on any date.

FLEXIBLE DASHBOARD
Switch between grid and list views. Sort your collection by next check date, plant name, or last care action. Quickly see which plants are overdue and which are thriving.

FIXED OR ADAPTIVE — YOUR CHOICE
Prefer a strict schedule? Switch any plant to fixed interval mode (3 to 60 days). Want the app to learn for you? Keep adaptive mode on and let your pattern shape the schedule.

BUILT-IN SPECIES DATABASE
Search hundreds of houseplant species with localized common names. Each species comes with a recommended baseline watering interval, light preference, and humidity needs — giving Verdura a smart starting point
from day one.

PRIVACY FIRST
All your data stays on your device. No account required. No tracking. No analytics. No data collection. Export your plants as JSON or CSV anytime. Delete the app and everything is gone — no cloud, no trace.

PAY ONCE, OWN FOREVER
Verdura is a one-time purchase. No subscriptions. No in-app purchases. No ads. Every feature is unlocked from the start, and all future updates are included.

AVAILABLE IN MULTIPLE LANGUAGES
English, German, Spanish, French, Ukrainian, Japanese, Korean, and Arabic.

Whether you have one pothos on your desk or fifty tropical plants across your home, Verdura is the houseplant tracker and garden planner that adapts to you — not the other way around.

name: Home Brewing: Beer Recipe Log
description:
Home Brewing is a homebrew log for people who make beer at home. Keep every beer recipe in one place, log hydrometer and temperature readings while the batch ferments, and get your ABV the moment your original and final gravity are in.

YOUR BEER RECIPE BOOK
Write down your malt bill, hop additions, yeast and water notes, then list your mash and brew-day steps in order. Tag each recipe with a beer style — IPA, pale ale, stout, porter, lager, pilsner, wheat beer, sour, amber ale or other.

New to a style? Pick it and tap AI Suggest Starting Recipe: the app fills in a starting malt bill, hops, yeast and steps that you review, change and save as your own.

Tweaking a recipe for the next batch? With Pro, clone it into a new version (v2, v3…) instead of overwriting your notes.

FERMENTATION LOG & ABV CALCULATOR
Add gravity and temperature readings as you take them with your hydrometer and thermometer, each with a date and an optional note, and keep the whole fermentation log for the batch in order. Move a batch from fermenting to conditioning to completed. Enter original gravity (OG) and final gravity (FG) and the ABV calculator works out alcohol by volume instantly.

TASTE, RATE, IMPROVE
Rate a finished beer from 1 to 5 and write tasting notes on aroma, mouthfeel and carbonation. The Stats tab sums up your home brewing: total batches, average rating and the beer styles you make most.

AI BREW ADVISOR
Stuck mid-ferment? The AI Brew Advisor takes the style, your gravity readings, days fermenting and taste-note chips — too bitter, watery, flat, cloudy, too sweet, gravity stalled — and returns a plain-language diagnosis with concrete adjustments for this batch and the next. It is process advice, not a sanitation guide.

FEATURES
• Beer recipe book: malt, hops, yeast, water notes, ordered brew-day steps
• Starting recipe for any style, suggested by AI and ready to edit
• Fermentation tracker with dated gravity and temperature readings
• Automatic ABV from OG and FG
• Batch status: fermenting, conditioning, completed
• Tasting ratings (1–5) and notes
• Stats: total batches, average rating, style breakdown
• Brew Advisor for troubleshooting a batch
• Light and dark themes, 10 interface languages

WHAT'S FREE
Recipes, batches and fermentation log entries are unlimited. Ratings, tasting notes and Stats are free. The Brew Advisor includes 3 free analyses, and recipe suggestions have a monthly free allowance. The free version shows banner ads.

WHAT PRO ADDS
• Unlimited Brew Advisor analyses
• Clone any recipe into a new version
• Version comparison in Stats: batches from v1 and v2 side by side
• No ads

Pro is an auto-renewing monthly or annual subscription; the price for your country is shown in the app before you buy. Payment is charged to your Google Play account; cancel any time in Google Play → Payments & subscriptions.

YOUR DATA
Your brewing log (recipes, batches, readings, tasting notes) is stored on your phone, with no sign-up form: the app creates an anonymous guest profile so your subscription and free allowances work. When you use an AI feature, the details you entered for that request go through our server to a third-party AI service. The app also uses Firebase (sign-in, analytics), RevenueCat (subscriptions) and Google AdMob (ads in the free version).

FOR ADULTS
Home Brewing is for adults of legal drinking age who make beer at home. It is about the craft — recipes, process and measurements. It does not track how much you drink, does not encourage drinking and makes no health claims. Sanitation and local home-brewing rules are your responsibility.

From your first extract kit to your fiftieth all-grain batch, Home Brewing keeps your beer recipes, fermentation data and tasting history in one brewing log.

name: HomeBrew BT Bridge
description:
This app manages the Bluetooth connection from a HomeBrew HBG3/HBG4 adapter connected to a Celestron Telescope mount, with the popular SkyPortal and SkySafari apps on a smart device.

One tap sets up the connection for using the apps on the same Android device. A checkbox also enables sharing the connection across the local network (WiFi or Ethernet). Dead simple, giving a reliable Bluetooth SPP or BLE connection that works wherever "Celestron WiFi" is expected.

The app can also send GPS data to the HomeBrew device, for use by Celestron Hand-Controllers and the CPWI app.

There are also menu options to explore and modify all of the internal configuration settings, including set-up of Wi-Fi parameters, for each HomeBrew device, and to view and interact with the HomeBrew screen/menus on the Android device's screen.

The app also features extensive session logging capability, for helping debug and diagnose issues with the telescope mount and accessories.

And finally there is an easy Firmware Update feature to check, download, and install the latest HBG3/HBG4 firmware directly to the HomeBrew device. This does normally require that the Android device first be connected to a 2.4GHz Wi-Fi network (not 5GHz), though some devices like newer Pixel phones may work even when on a 5GHz network.

description:
PintVision is a 3D beer recipe calculator and beer color simulator for homebrewers. Build your recipe, calculate SRM color, and see a live 3D visualization of what your beer could look like in the glass — before you brew it.

SEE YOUR BEER BEFORE YOU BREW IT

Stop guessing whether your grain bill will produce pale gold, deep amber, or jet-black beer. PintVision turns your homebrew recipe calculations into a visual 3D pint you can inspect before brew day.

BEER COLOR & SRM CALCULATOR

• Calculate SRM from your grain bill

HOME BEER RECIPE VISUALIZER

• Build and visualize your grain bill
• Scale batch volume
• Adjust malt Lovibond values and weights
• See how recipe changes affect beer color
• Preview clear, hazy, and murky beer

HAZE & CARBONATION SIMULATOR

• Control turbidity from clear to murky
• Simulate carbonation from 1.5–4.5 volumes of CO₂
• View changing carbonation and live PSI
• Compare different beer appearances before brew day

FAQ / COMMON QUESTIONS

🍺 What is the best beer recipe calculator?
PintVision is a visual beer recipe calculator for homebrewers. It calculates SRM beer color from your grain bill and shows the result as a live 3D pint, so you can see what your recipe may look like before brewing.

🍺 How do I calculate the color of my homebrew?
PintVision calculates beer color using your grain bill and malt Lovibond values, then visualizes the calculated SRM as a 3D beer pour.

🍺 What is an SRM beer color calculator?
An SRM calculator estimates the color of beer based on the ingredients in a recipe. PintVision combines SRM calculation with a 3D visualization so you can see the expected beer color rather than relying only on a number.

🍺 What does SRM mean in beer?
SRM stands for Standard Reference Method and is a measurement used to describe beer color. PintVision uses SRM as part of its beer color calculation and visualization.

🍺 How can I tell what color my beer will be before I brew it?
Enter your grain bill and malt color information in PintVision to calculate the expected SRM and preview the beer as a 3D pour before brew day.

🍺 Is there a beer color calculator for homebrewing?
Yes. PintVision is designed specifically as a homebrew beer color calculator and visualizer, allowing you to explore beer color from pale straw through deep black.

🍺 How do I calculate SRM from a grain bill?
PintVision calculates the expected SRM from your recipe's grain bill and malt color values, then shows the calculated color visually in a 3D glass.

🍺 What is the difference between SRM and Lovibond?
Lovibond describes the color contribution of a malt, while SRM is a measurement of the resulting beer's color. PintVision lets you enter malt weights and Lovibond values to calculate and visualize the resulting beer color.

🍺 How do I know if my beer will be clear or hazy?
PintVision includes a haze and turbidity simulator that lets you adjust the appearance from crystal clear to hazy or murky and see the result in the 3D beer glass.

🍺 Can I simulate beer carbonation?
Yes. PintVision simulates carbonation from 1.5 to 4.5 volumes of CO₂ and provides live PSI information so you can visualize the effect of carbonation.

🍺 Can I use PintVision without internet?
Yes. PintVision is designed to work completely offline. Calculations and 3D rendering run on your device, with no account or cloud connection required.

🍺 Is PintVision a replacement for a full homebrew recipe app?
PintVision focuses specifically on recipe visualization, beer color, SRM, haze, and carbonation. It is designed to complement a full homebrew brewing tool by helping you visualize what your recipe may look like before you brew it.

name: Partender – Fast Bar Inventory
description:
As featured on Paramount Network's "Bar Rescue" Partender is a patented, subscription-based business tool with a proprietary design that empowers you to:

- Place, track, and receive those orders online

- Get your Actual Cost of Goods Sold (COGS for Bev Cost %)
- See what’s trending in your venue such as Top Movers and Dead Stock

And besides saving time and labor, our customers:
1) Reduce Inventory Value On-Hand by 20-40%
2) Reduce Beverage Cost by 6-8%
3) Reduce Cost of Goods Fluctuation by 10%

...all in just 90 days of weekly use after setup.

Here’s what some of them had to say:

"Inventory takes less than 15 minutes now. It used to take 2 hours with 3 people counting, for a total of 6 labor hours."
- Grant S. at Boston Pizza

“It takes us just 15 minutes to do inventory, which we do at least twice a week. We stopped running out of things, and thanks to Partender, we managed to get beverage costs down to 20% in a matter of months."
- Mike W. at Marriott

How? Why?

Because when you count your inventory as accurately and as frequently as you count the cash in your register, less disappears. And the average shrinkage in our industry is 23% because no one's counting how much is there.

So when your inventory is 10-50x more valuable than your cash register, it makes sense to count it as carefully as the till, but that's been impossible until Partender.

So throw out your paper-and-pen and homegrown spreadsheets. Do inventory in minutes - not hours. See what's selling the best/worst, what's dead stock (and needs to get phased out via happy hour promotions), and what's about to run out and get 86'd (so you never miss a sale).

Stop manually typing your inventory into Excel or a glorified web-based spreadsheet. Let Partender streamline all of your inventory, ordering, and accounting operations in just 15 minutes a week.

With Partender, you can also:
- Monitor actual depletions
- See real-time customer insights for your actual customers on a per-product or per-category basis
- Instantly receive your Value On-Hand (like a "Balance Sheet") in wholesale and retail dollars after every inventory
- Optimize your par levels (based on online graphs) to buy more of what's selling the best and less of what's selling the worst
- Clearly understand why your cost of goods is going up (due to Price Change Alerts or due to shrinkage* via our Usage / Variance Report online

*Shrinkage is the loss of inventory due to over-pouring, theft, breakage, spillage, not tracking comps, etc. And there's an average 23% shrinkage in the industry which causes 60-80% of bars and restaurants to fail within 3 years. Or let significant amounts of revenue just walk out the door.

HOW DOES PARTENDER WORK?
Build a virtual "blueprint" of your venue after organizing your bar to split up the work of inventory across Main Bar, Back Bar, Stock Room, etc. Instead of manually writing down your inventory using an arbitrary 10-point scale, cumbersome scales, or expensive hardware, simply tap where the liquor level is on the real image of the bottle and swipe to the next bottle on your shelf. That's it! Our proprietary algorithms are up to 99.2% accurate so you know down to the drop & dollar-value how much each bottle is worth in Retail & Wholesale Dollars ($).

INVENTORY ANYTHING:
In addition to liquor, you can inventory beer, wine, smallwares, kegs, and FOOD! Our database is huge. If there's something on your shelf that's not in our database: take a picture of it, and our proprietary algorithms will do the rest.

ANALYTICS IN THE CLOUD:
Just log into your web dashboard to see COGS, beautiful graphs & trends of what customers are drinking in real-time.

name: Home Inventory & Food: InvenDo
description:
Stop throwing away food you forgot about. InvenDo is a home inventory app for your kitchen and the rest of the house: it keeps track of what you have, where it is stored and when it expires, and reminds you in time.

Scan a barcode or type a name, put the item in a storage place (fridge, freezer, pantry, garage, bathroom cabinet), and you always know what is in the house without going to look.

STOP THROWING FOOD AWAY
- Nothing spoils at the back of the fridge again: give an item an expiry date and it is flagged as Expires soon, then Already expired
- A reminder arrives at the time of day you choose, so you use things while they are still good
- Opened a jar or a pack? Mark it opened, and InvenDo sets a Consume by date from the shelf life you enter once, then remembers it for next time

NEVER RUN OUT OF WHAT YOU ALWAYS NEED
- Coffee, diapers, cat food: set a Minimum quantity and InvenDo tells you before the last one is gone
- Everything below its minimum sits on one screen, ready to go onto the shopping list
- Set the minimum for a whole category, not just item by item

BUY ONLY WHAT IS MISSING
- A shopping list built from what your pantry actually lacks, instead of from memory
- Group the list by store, so one trip covers one shop
- Check things off in the aisle, then move what you bought straight into your inventory
- Send the grocery list to whoever is going out, as plain text

ADD THINGS IN SECONDS
- Scan a barcode to add an item, scan again to take one away
- A scanned barcode can fill in the product name and photo for you (available in many countries, not all)
- Start typing and InvenDo suggests things you have had before

FIND ANYTHING WITHOUT SEARCHING THE HOUSE
- Storage places inside storage places: the freezer, then the top drawer
- Categories with colors, and subcategories when you need them
- Photos of your items and your storage places, and an icon for each storage place
- Unit sizes that add up for you: 1 pack = 6 pcs, or 1 pack = 250 g, with the total on hand
- Search your whole home inventory by name or by voice

KEEP THE WHOLE HOUSEHOLD IN SYNC
- Invite your partner, children or roommates by email, and everyone sees the same list as it changes
- Keep several lists (home, parents' house, a hobby collection) and choose who sees which
- People you invite get the paid features on your shared list at no extra cost
- Works offline, syncs when you are back online
- Check the shopping list off from an Android home screen widget, or open your inventory in a browser at web.invendo.app
- Export to Excel whenever you like, or import a spreadsheet you already keep

WHO IT IS FOR
Anyone who wants a pantry inventory that is actually up to date. Food in the fridge, freezer and pantry. Medicines and their shelf life. Cosmetics. Clothes you forget you own. Tools in the garage. Hobby collections. Wine, spices, camping gear, baby supplies, printer cartridges. It is built for a household rather than a business, and it is simple enough that the rest of the family will actually use it.

NO ADS, AND A GENEROUS FREE VERSION
The inventory, storage places, categories, the shopping list, barcode scanning, expiry and low-quantity reminders, Excel export, sharing the list, the widget and sync across devices are all free, and there are no ads anywhere in the app. Premium adds photos, storage icons, Excel import, deeper subcategories, extra lists, inviting other people, filling the shopping list from low-quantity items in one tap, and the web app. Take it monthly, yearly, or as a one-time Lifetime purchase: pay once and use it forever.
