name: Store & Forget: Home Inventory
description:
Snap a photo. The app fills in the rest.

Months later, search in plain words ("cord for the TV", "the drill") and Store & Forget points you to the exact box, shelf, or drawer. Photograph anything you store, pick where it goes, and the app writes the name, brand, and specs.

Ever thought: I know I own that thing, but where did I put it? Stuff vanishes into closets, bins, and drawers.

Most apps make that worse: hours of categories, barcodes, and typing. Store & Forget is the anti-organization home organizer for people who throw things into boxes, forget them, and find them later. It's a home inventory without barcodes, because the photo does the work.

📦 THE "STORE & FORGET" METHOD
1. Snap & Forget: Drop items into any box, drawer, or room and snap a photo.
2. Smart Scan: Vision AI identifies the item and fills in its name, brand, and specs.
3. Smart Find: Put the box away. Search by what the item does ("things to keep me warm") and it returns the box it's in.

🏠 WHAT PEOPLE USE IT FOR
• Moving: A moving box inventory you build while you pack. Label the boxes, snap what goes in, and unpack without opening every lid.
• Storage units, garages, and attics: A storage unit inventory and storage organizer for bins in a shed or a rented locker.
• Insurance: Build a personal property inventory before you need one. Keep proof of ownership photos, serial numbers, and receipts, then export a PDF for an insurance claim. For renters, household contents, and disaster prep.
• Kitchen and pantry: A pantry inventory with food expiry dates and low stock alerts that feed a grocery list.
• Decluttering: A home organizer and declutter tracker for what you boxed up, donated, or stored.
• Households: A shared home inventory so family or roommates can find things without asking you.

✨ FEATURES
• 🔍 Smart Find: Find lost items at home by what they do ("tool to make holes in wood"), not the name you gave them.
• 📸 Smart Scan: A photo inventory that writes itself. AI fills in the description, brand, and specs, several items at once.
• 🛒 Shopping List and Low Stock Alerts: Set "tell me at 2 left" on anything. What runs low joins a shopping list you tick off, and buying it puts the stock back.
• 📅 Expiry Date Tracker: See what expires next and get reminded before it does.
• 📄 Export to PDF, CSV, and Excel: A summary PDF, a detailed PDF with a photo of every item, or an .xlsx spreadsheet zipped with the photos. Built for an insurance claim, estate inventory, and moving. Export your whole home inventory, one area, or one spot.
• 📥 Spreadsheet Import: Move a CSV or Excel inventory in with column mapping, a pre-flight check, and duplicate handling.
• 🤝 Lend Tracker: Log borrowed items, set a due date, and get a reminder when one runs late.
• 👥 Share & Forget: A household inventory app you can share with family or roommates from a QR code. Items and photos are end-to-end encrypted. Both sides sign in with Google.
• 💲 Inventory Value: Put a price on anything and the app totals it by currency.
• 🧾 Receipts and Warranties: A warranty tracker, receipt keeper, and serial number log that keeps the paperwork with the item. Photograph several pages into one PDF.
• 🏷️ QR Location Labels: Print labels for boxes or shelves on Avery 5160, 5163, or 4x6 thermal sheets. Scan one to see what's inside.
• 🔒 Local-First Privacy: An offline inventory app with no sign-up. Your photos and database stay on your device. Smart Scan, Smart Find, and reading printed details need a connection and a cloud AI service.
• ☁️ Backup & Sync: Back up your home inventory to your own Google Drive folder, so the record survives the house.
• 🔑 Bring Your Own Key: Plug in a free Google AI key and scan on your own quota.

No categories to set up and no barcode database to fight. Sharing and backup need a Google sign-in; everything else works without an account.

Download Store & Forget, start your home inventory in one photo, and find anything later without digging through every box.

name: My Board Game Collection
description:
What if you could have all the information about your boardgames in one beautiful location?
Not only the data coming from the online database (BoardGameGeek), but also your custom data & play sessions.

What if it could translate the information to any language?
We have systems at our fingertips that allow us to translate to any language in the world. We use those systems to allow you to translate descriptions & comments.

By making use of BoardGameGeek & BoardGameAtlas we are able to give you an enourmous amount of information about your collection and/or about board games you want to check out.

No database is perfect so we created a way for you to add to the existing data.
You can add videos (f.e.: how to play), website urls (f.e.: alternate play rules), images (f.e.: your pictures), your notes, game language, tags, purchase date & purchase price and more.

Finding new boardgames can be very exciting, so we are giving you options to be able to find cool new games.
You can view dynamic lists and you can search the database with various filters. Search filters like player count, age, play time, ...

Choosing a boardgame to play is not always easy, that is why we give you multiple options to filter your collection: name, cooperative play, number of players, playtime, release year, is digital, difficulty, tags or/and a favorite.

Even with all these filters it can be hard to choose, some people just have a lot of very cool games in their collection. For these situations we have added a 'pick random' action to the list.

We are a strong believer in open formats so My Board Game Collection uses an open format for its backup/restore files.

Log your play sessions and keep track of what, when and where you played. You can also log who played and who won and with what score. Never forget.

My Board Game Collection is fully usable in its free form, but creating an app requires a huge amount of time and resources. To be able to support My Board Game Collection going forward we have added ads & a couple of premium features. You can remove the ads and unlock the premium features in 2 ways:
1. FREE: You can watch reward videos that will give you ad free time with the app. This ad free time can also be used to use PREMIUM features.
2. PAID: An single in app purchase is available to remove all ads and unlock all premium features.

PREMIUM Features:
- Remove all ads.
- Search images using our in app search screen.
- Change the limit of 2 score / health / resource tracker to unlimited.
- Enable the 'fast jump' on the bottom of the boardgame list.

Check out our social channels to see what is coming, show your support or tell us about any suggestions you might have.
Also available on other platforms. Check out our social channels for more info.

name: Score Counter
description:
Have you ever played a game where you needed to write down points for each player and count them up right away — and couldn't find a pen and paper at the same time?

Score Counter replaces paper, pen and calculator. Pick a ready-made game or set up your own, add players with one tap, and type in points as you play. The app keeps the score, the standings and the history.

Board games, card games, dice games, darts, golf or a pub quiz — Score Counter is a favorite for Yahtzee, Rummy, Canasta, Uno, Skull King, Scrabble and virtually any game where you add up points.

PLAYING
• Ready-made games: Yahtzee, Rummy, Uno, Mau Mau, Canasta, Skull King and more, set up in a couple of taps. Yahtzee and Rummy are free; the others are Premium, or unlock one for a single game by watching a short ad.
• Named rounds (Premium, or one ad per game): score rows can carry a name instead of a number — "Upper section", "Buildings", "Trump: hearts". Paste the names in as a list, and edit them straight from the game menu.
• Score chart: see how the scores evolved round by round, right under the final standings.
• Match recap: a one-line summary of the game — the comeback, the close finish, the runaway win — that travels with the result you share.
• Milestones and rivals: the app celebrates a new personal best or a winning streak, and shows each player their rivals.
• Template statistics: standings, win rates and score trends per game, filtered by date range.
• Game rules: a target score or round limit that finishes the game for you, reverse scoring for games where lower is better, a starting player that can rotate each round, and an initial score for games that begin with a balance.
• Live ranking during the game, score editing with a tap on the cell, and finished games you can resume any time.
• Player profiles with win counts, career stats and avatars (Premium).

YOUR DATA
• Game templates (Premium): save players, rules and target score once and start new games in seconds. Give a template an icon and the games started from it wear it too.
• Cloud backup and sync (Premium): sign in with Google or Apple to keep games, players and stats backed up and in sync across your devices.
• Export and import (Premium): games, players and templates to CSV or JSON, and back in from JSON.
• Custom toolbars (Premium): build your own score-input toolbars with the buttons you use most.
• History: every game you have played, searchable, filterable by status, with the leaderboard one tap away.
• Dark, light or system theme with adjustable contrast, and side-by-side layouts on tablets.

PREMIUM
Score Counter is free to use. Premium is a one-time purchase (a monthly plan is available too) that unlocks everything marked Premium above and removes the ads. Some Premium features can be used for a single game by watching a short ad instead.

Focus on the game, not the math!

Found a bug? Send me an email with a short description and I'll fix it as soon as I can. Thank you!

All trademarks are the property of their respective owners. Score Counter is an independent app and is not affiliated with or endorsed by them.

name: ScoreMate Board Game Scorecard

• Instant Resume: Close the app anytime — your exact tabletop state is restored instantly.

📊 6. STATS & H-INDEX PROGRESSION
• Match History: View win rates, high scores, and player leaderboards.
• H-Index: Track your collection’s play frequency and gaming milestones.

────────────────────────
💎 PURE PRIVACY-FIRST GAMING
────────────────────────
• 🚫 100% Ad-Free: Zero pop-ups, banners, or interruptions at the table.
• 🔒 Complete Data Privacy: All matches and custom templates stay strictly on your device.
• 🎨 Tactile & Themed UI: Sleek dark mode, crisp high-contrast cards, and haptic feedback.

⚖️ DISCLAIMER & COMPLIANCE

ScoreMate is an independent companion utility. It is not affiliated with, endorsed, or sponsored by the publishers or trademark owners of any referenced games (including Catan, Wingspan, Carcassonne, Yahtzee, Qwixx, Sleeping Gods, or BoardGameGeek). name: Price Guide - U.S. Coin Values
description:
PriceGuide is the fastest way to look up what your U.S. and Canadian coins are worth.

Whether you've inherited a jar of old quarters or carefully collected key dates for years, PriceGuide gives you accurate, up-to-date prices for every grade — instantly. Open the app, find the coin, see the value. No collection to set up, no account to create.

FEATURES

• Every major U.S. coin series — from Indian Head Cents to Morgan Dollars to Saint-Gaudens Double Eagles
• Pricing for every grade, mint mark, proof, specimen, variety, and error
• Live precious-metal melt values for every silver, gold, and copper coin — from real-time spot prices
• Mintage figures so you know how rare each coin really is
• Live eBay listings to see what your coins are actually selling for
• Series Info pages with the story behind every coin design
• Composition + historical melt chart for any coin, with selectable time ranges
• Full Canadian coverage in addition to U.S.

JUNK SILVER & MELT CALCULATOR

The Metals tab shows current silver, gold, platinum, and copper spot prices alongside the melt value of popular coins:
• 90% silver dimes, quarters, halves, and dollars
• 40% silver Kennedy halves (1965–1970)
• War nickels (1942–1945)
• American Silver Eagles
• Pre-1933 gold ($2.50 / $5 / $10 / $20)
• American Gold Eagles and Gold Buffalos
• Pre-1982 Lincoln cents and large copper coinage

Tap any coin or spot price to see composition, weight, per-metal value, and a melt-value chart you can scrub through.

WHAT PRICEGUIDE IS FOR

• Looking up what a coin is worth before selling
• Checking key date premiums (1909-S VDB, 1916-D Mercury, 1893-S Morgan) at a glance
• Estimating melt value on junk silver, war nickels, pre-1933 gold, and copper cents
• Verifying mintage and rarity before bidding on eBay
• Pricing inherited coin collections without a dealer visit

WHAT PRICEGUIDE IS NOT

PriceGuide is a price reference, not a collection tracker. To catalog the coins you own — grades, purchase prices, completion progress, portfolio value — use our sibling app LuckyCoin. PriceGuide is for the moment you just need to know "what is this worth, right now."

PRICEGUIDE PREMIUM

Unlock the full app:
• Pricing for every grade (free tier shows two)
• Live spot prices on the Metals tab (free tier shows a one-week-old snapshot)
• Proof and specimen pricing
• Variety and error pricing
• Pricing for Proof Sets and Mint Sets

Subscribe monthly or yearly, or unlock everything once with a Lifetime purchase. Cancel anytime in Settings.

FREQUENTLY ASKED

Q: How accurate are the prices?
A: The database refreshes regularly from auction and dealer data. Actual sale prices vary by grade, eye appeal, and certification.

Q: Does PriceGuide track my collection?
A: No — it's a price lookup reference. For collection tracking, use LuckyCoin.

Q: Are melt values accurate?
A: Yes. Calculated from real-time silver, gold, platinum, and copper spot prices using each coin's actual composition and weight.

Q: Free or paid?
A: Free with two grade points per coin. Premium unlocks every grade, varieties, errors, proofs, and live melt values.

Q: Privacy?
A: No account required. We don't track your lookups or sell your data.

Made by Stuck at Home, LLC — also behind LuckyCoin (coin tracker), LuckyFind (metal detecting log), LuckyVinyl (records), and the Lucky family of utility and collector apps.

1. The easiest way to shop for groceries

Each week you'll have a personalized meal plan with simple & healthy recipes that are catered to your exact needs and preferences.

Eliminate decision fatigue after a long day's work - simply pick a recipe from your meal plan and cook it in less time than it takes to pick up an unhealthy (and expensive) takeout meal.

With the most personalization options of any minimal-waste meal planner out there, you can cook exactly how you want to eat.
From classic, flexitarian, pescetarian, low carb, paleo, keto, vegetarian & vegan diet types to gluten-free, shellfish free, fish free, dairy free, peanut free, tree nut free, soy free, egg free, sesame free, and mustard free allergy restrictions to 119 individual dislikable ingredients, your meal plans will be truly personalized to your specific needs.

5. Save money with minimal food waste
It's annoying when you purchase ingredients from the grocery store, cook a meal or two, and have a bunch of ingredients going bad by the end of the week, isn't it?

With Mealime, your days of wasting food are over! All meal plans are intelligently created in order to eliminate food waste as much as possible. You'll use up the majority of purchased ingredients if you cook your meal plan each week, saving you hundreds - if not thousands - of dollars per year.

• Exclusive Pro-only recipes added every week

AUTOMATED SHOPPING LISTS

name: SuperCook - Recipe Generator
description:
How many times have you found yourself looking for that perfect recipe – only to find that you’re missing one or more ingredients?

How many times have you opened the fridge and thought to yourself -- what can I make ?

How many times have you thrown away an ingredient, because you couldn't figure out how to use it before it expired ?

SuperCook to the rescue!

Unlike other recipe apps, SuperCook only shows you recipes that require the ingredients you already have.

All the recipes you see on SuperCook are recipes you can make right now. No more inconvenient grocery runs for a missing ingredient, at a time when you should be home, with your family and friends

Why purchase new ingredients when you can focus on what you already have?

Here’s how it works:
• For Supercook to do its magic, it needs to know all the ingredients you have at home.
• Visit the pantry page in the SuperCook app and choose from a list of 2000+ ingredients broken down into categories like fruits, vegetables, meats, and many more.
• Start adding ALL the ingredients you have at home to your SuperCook pantry – including oils, spices, and yes - even that old bottle of Worcestershire sauce in the back of the fridge!
• Sit back and watch SuperCook work its magic by finding recipes that match your ingredients.

SuperCook’s Unique App Features:

--Customized Recipe Ideas--
We’ve consolidated over 11 million recipes from 18,000 recipe websites, in 20 languages to create the largest recipe collection ever. This knowledge was fed into an AI system that learnt the intricacies of all ingredients and how they can be mixed together.

All you have to do is build your pantry on the app – and you’re ready to make delicious meals without ever leaving your house!

SuperCook will find you any recipe you need, whether it’s for breakfast, lunch, dinner, or even a midnight snack.

--Easily Add Your Ingredients--
Save time and money with an intelligent pantry. SuperCook’s voice dictation mode allows you to quickly add ingredients to your in-app pantry by simply saying them out loud.

Just open your fridge, click the microphone button, and start listing everything inside. The app will automatically add the ingredients to your pantry for a quick and easy way to find recipes!

--Automatic Recipe Recommendations--
The app will automatically find you recipes to make with what’s in your fridge – so all those lost ingredients in the back of your cupboard now have a place on your table. It’s that simple!

When you run out of an ingredient, simply open the SuperCook app and remove it from your pantry - and all the recipe ideas will adjust accordingly.

--Get Creative in the Kitchen--
SuperCook inspires new ideas and activities in the kitchen for new cooks, busy parents, foodies, and pro chefs alike.

With over 11 million recipes available in 20 different languages, SuperCook promises that you’ll never cook the same thing twice (unless you want to, of course!).

--What's on the menu ?--
The menu page is where you'll find all your recipe ideas. Why is it called menu? Because just like the menu in a restaurant, everything on the menu page is available to you now. SuperCook instantly analyzes 11 million recipes and finds the ones that match your unique ingredients.

Most likely your menu page will contain thousands of recipes, but don't worry, we've broken them down into helpful categories like soups and stews, appetizers and snacks, salads, entrees, desserts and more.

--Reduce food waste--
Most people don't realize how much food they throw away every day — from uneaten leftovers to spoiled produce. SuperCook is one of the best ways to reduce food waste in the home. It finds recipes that use as many of your ingredients as possible, so nothing goes to waste. SuperCook makes food waste prevention fun and easy, just open the menu page on the app and choose a recipe. We help you use what you have, so nothing goes to waste!

The recipe converter tool allows you to scale, multiply, divide, or portion your recipes to the serving size you desire. Easily convert recipes to your desired serving size by typing in (*or copying and pasting*) the ingredients from your favorite online food blogs or recipe sites.

*Note: Due to the nature of text formatting, the copy and paste function may not work directly for some websites and certain mobile browsers.

The ingredient unit converter tool allows you to convert by ingredient between volume and weight units, such as cups and grams. Choose from more than 250 of the most common ingredients, such as butter, eggs, flour, and sugar!

The tool also includes basic conversion calculators for Volume, Weight, Length, Energy, Time, and Temperature. For most conversions, you can directly type in fractions as an input value, such as "1 1/2" or "3/4". The tool also keeps a history of your past conversions.

In addition to conversion calculators, the app has a Gas Mark reference and a cooking temperature references that allows you to quickly look up information about cooking temperatures for meat, candy, and other dishes.

Take the power of recipe conversion with you by downloading this app. MyKitchenCalculator.com, recipe conversion made easier!

Recipe Converter:
Multiply, divide, or portion recipes with ease. This tool will take fraction inputs and output them to the nearest fraction also!

Ingredient Unit Converter:
Convert by ingredient between common volume and weight units for more than 250 ingredients! Includes sticks of butter conversion and conversion of medium, large, and x-large whole eggs!

Volume Converter:
Convert between units of teaspoons, tablespoons, cups, pints, quarts, gallons, fluid ounces, milliliters, liters. You can also convert between US and UK (imperial) units. There is also a conversion to "Cups and Spoons". This conversion will convert volume units to denominations of common measuring cups and spoons. For example, 1.75 cups = 1 cup + 3/4 cup.

Weight Converter:
Convert between units of grams, kilograms, ounces, and pounds. You can even convert to "Pounds and Ounces".

Length Converter:
Convert between units of millimeters, centimeters, meters, kilometers, inches, feet, yards and miles. You can even convert to "Feet and Inches".

Energy Converter:
Convert between Joules, Kilojoules, Gram Calories, and Food Calories (Kilocalories)

Time Converter:
Convert between seconds, minutes, hours, days, weeks, months, and years.

Temperature Converter:
Convert between units of Fahrenheit, Celsius, and Kelvin.

Gas Mark Reference:
View common gas mark settings in Fahrenheit or Celsius.

Cooking Temperatures:
Easily look up the USDA recommended cooking temperatures of most dishes such as meats, eggs, and casseroles. You can also look up candy cooking temperatures that tell you the stages of sugar at each temperature range.

Easily share your conversions with others if your device has compatible share action apps such as certain email or text messaging apps.

Notes:
1)Conversions are calculated approximations and may not be exact.
2)US volume conversions are NIST based rounded values.
3)Conversions by ingredients are based on USDA values and actual measured values.
4)Always check for proper conversions before using converted recipes.
5)This tool is based on rounded and simplified values and is not recommended for mathematical, engineering, or scientific calculations that need precision.

name: Jotbook: Bullet Journal & Bujo
description:
Jotbook is a digital bullet journal you can also use for tasks, a diary, and habit tracking. Open and write: jot down a task, an event, or a thought in one short line, move unfinished things forward, and keep it all by day, week, month, and year — like a paper notebook, without a pile of overdue alerts.

WRITE IN SECONDS
Open the app and you are on today’s page. A symbol plus one short line is enough; press return and start the next. No forms, no folders.
• Tasks: things to do — check them off, move them, set them for a later month, or cross them out
• Events: what happened or will happen — meetings, dates, little moments
• Notes: ideas, reminders, anything you don’t want to forget
Type -, o, !, or * to switch the type or add a highlight as you write. Add #tags in the line itself; tap a tag to see everything on that topic. Break a big item into smaller ones. Pick the symbols you like, or tap them above the keyboard.

DAY, WEEK, MONTH, YEAR
Flip through your life the way a paper journal does, without being chased by due dates:
• Daily: one page per day; swipe to change dates. Yesterday’s unfinished tasks show up quietly at the top
• Weekly: the week’s focus, with each day beside it
• Monthly: this month’s list and a look back; things you set for a month reappear when that month arrives
• Yearly: what you want this year, with a month-by-month view
Unfinished tasks can move to another day, a future month, or your own list. Tidying replaces nagging; if something keeps getting moved, Jotbook asks whether it is still worth doing.

YOUR OWN LISTS, PLUS SEARCH
Books, shopping, travel, projects, wishlists — make your own pages, written the same way as your journal.
Everything lives in a simple table of contents. Search any line and jump straight to it.

HABITS
Build a habit or quit one. Count times, or time yourself.
Every day, weekdays, or a few times a week; reminders are optional.
See progress by day, week, month, and year — a year view, streaks, and how often you followed through.
Shrink the timer, tap to pause, hold to stop, and stay on the page.

QUIET AND SIMPLE
It looks like paper. Light or dark, and you choose which day the week starts on.
Optional evening reminders: one minute to look back on today.

WHO IT’S FOR
If you keep a paper bullet journal and want the same way of writing on your phone; if to-do and calendar apps feel too loud; if you want a diary, a planner, and habit tracking in one notebook — Jotbook is for that.

Start writing with Jotbook today.

name: Prompted Journal - Shadow Work
description:
Prompted is a guided journal: a private diary that asks you a question every day, so the writing starts before the blank page can stop you.

It is built for reflection, introspection and personal growth through carefully crafted daily prompts — not just recording how you feel, but giving the feeling somewhere to go. Wellness living, manifestation and shadow work all start from the same place: a question you would not have asked yourself.

WHAT'S INSIDE

- 190+ guided journal prompts for reflection, introspection and shadow work.
- A five minute habit: one daily question, one honest answer.
- "Dive Deeper" follow-up questions on every prompt, for the days you want to keep going.
- Write your own prompts and keep them alongside the catalog.
- A private diary with a biometric lock. Your writing stays yours.
- Daily reminders that keep the habit going.
- A free quote of the day to open each entry.
- Use it as a gratitude journal, a mood diary, a dream diary or a guided journal — whatever your daily writing practice needs.

WHY A GUIDED JOURNAL

A blank page is the hardest part of keeping a diary. A guided journal with writing prompts gives every entry a starting point, so reflection happens even on the days when you have nothing to say. Dedicate five minutes and the practice becomes a routine that supports personal growth, so you can focus on what matters: understanding your inner self.

SHADOW WORK AND INTROSPECTION

Shadow work is the part of journaling that asks about the things you normally steer around. Prompted approaches it the same way it approaches everything else — with a question rather than a blank page. Use the introspective prompts to explore the parts of yourself you tend not to write about, and pair them with mood check-ins and gratitude entries so the practice stays balanced. name: Three Good Things - Gratitude
description:
Three Good Things is a simple gratitude journal for the end of the day — a private daily gratitude diary for positivity, mood and calm.

Every evening, write down three good things that happened and how each one made you feel. That is the whole practice. Write them, then put the phone down.

Inspired by the Three Good Things exercise studied in positive psychology.

WHAT THE APP DOES

- Three good things a day. Short entries, not essays.
- The "I felt" prompt. After each good thing, note the feeling that came with it.
- Memories. Re-read past entries and watch your good days collect over months and years.
- A daily reminder at a time you choose.
- A quote each day.
- Themes, including a night mode for reading in bed.
- Works as a mood diary too: the feelings you note build a quiet record of your moods over the months.

A JOURNAL APP THAT ASKS FOR LESS

Most journal apps hand you a blank page and a cursor. This one asks the same question every evening, so a diary entry is finished in the time it takes to make tea. If you have looked for a free journal app, a gratitude diary or a daily writing habit and bounced off the effort, that is the gap this gratitude app is built for.

PRIVACY

- No account is required. There is no sign-up, and no email address to hand over.
- Journal entries are stored locally in app storage. Exporting or sharing creates a copy through your device's share controls.
- No ads. No AI.

YOUR ENTRIES, YOUR COPY

Export a CSV that can be imported later, or a PDF readable archive. Premium includes unlimited exports; the free app includes three.

FREE AND PREMIUM

The daily practice is free. Premium adds decorative themes and a polished PDF keepsake. Price, billing period, renewal terms and any free trial are shown in the app and on this store listing, in your local currency.

A DAILY GRATITUDE HABIT

Three short entries make a five minute gratitude practice. Done nightly, the gratitude journal becomes a daily habit of noticing — a small act of self care before bed. Some people keep it alongside a longer diary or a mood tracker; this one only ever asks for the good things, so being grateful stays easy.

ABOUT THE PRACTICE

The three good things exercise asks you to name three things that went well and your part in them. It has been studied in positive psychology as a gratitude exercise, and it is deliberately small: the point is that it is easy enough to do on an ordinary evening, in the ordinary mood you happen to be in.

WHO IT IS FOR

People who have started a journal before and stopped. If a blank page has ever felt like homework, this daily gratitude diary asks for a good deal less: three good things, a feeling for each, done.

Download Three Good Things and start your gratitude journal tonight — a simple daily journaling practice for a more grateful evening.

name: Moodi: emotions & mood tracker
description:
Moodi is a self-help therapy journal with effective psychological exercises and emotion tracker to strengthen your mental health and overcome anxiety & depression, stress, low self-esteem, or other psychological difficulties. Take advantage of this CBT mood diary therapy and help yourself to raise your mood, increase awareness, and enjoy its anti-stress effect.


A psychological diary is a highly effective self-help practice


Psychologists recommend keeping a psychological diary. It can be an emotion tracker, a mood diary a CBT journal, or free-form entries.


As the best self-help practice, it will help you:


  • Better understand yourself, your thoughts, feelings, reactions, and relationships with other people

  • Express emotions and experiences, rather than suppressing them, and ensure better emotional regulation and stress reduction

  • Approach problem-solving and decision-making mindfully

  • Identify sources of stress and anxiety and find ways to cope with them

  • Improve personal development and growth

Self-help practices you will find in this mental health therapy app


Negative situations diary


A Negative Situations Diary is a very effective self-help technique for solving psychological problems. It will help you cope with painful and anxious moments more easily, understand how some events affect your feelings and mood, and strategize your reactions for similar situations in the future.


Make entries about every negative moment, track your thoughts, mark emotions, and select a cognitive distortion. With this therapy journal, you can better understand yourself, your behavior, and your feelings associated with a specific event. Help yourself to free your mind from negativity, and feel much better. By changing your approach to resolving negative situations, your reaction to them will also change.


Positive moments diary


In the Positive Moments Diary (Gratitude Journal), you can write down all your positive events, good emotions, and gratitude. It helps you pay attention to the pleasant moments and, thus, reduce stress and other negative feelings.


Everything that causes positive emotions truly matters. So, use these positive emotions for self-help mindfully. Whether you had a significant event or something fleeting, write it down and mark the emotions you experienced. And motivate yourself.


Morning diary


With the Morning Diary, you can help yourself set up for the day ahead and free your mind from needless worries, irrational anxieties, and negativity. By practicing this morning diary and mood tracker, you will notice how your energy, motivation, awareness, and creativity rise.


Write down your emotions, feelings, experiences, plans, tasks, goals, and desires every day, immediately after you wake up. Write down everything that seems important to you at that moment.


Evening diary


An Evening Diary is an effective self-help practice. With it, you can track your emotions, feelings, and thoughts at the end of the day, right before going to bed. With this mental health tracker, you can analyze your day and get rid of unfounded worries, stress and tension, anxiety & depression. All this helps you relax, sleep better, and recover.


Write down your events and impressions of the past day. Describe your emotions, feelings, self-esteem, and physical condition in detail. Write down the lesson you learn from this day. Don't try to write it correctly, just be honest and record things you believe to be important for you at that moment.


Download Moodi, a CBT therapy journal and mental health tracker. Put one of the most effective self-help practices on your service. Trace and analyze your negative situations and positive moments, and keep a morning journal and evening mood diary. Learn to save and cherish positive feelings and get rid of anxiety & depression.

name: Menu cost calculator
description:
This calculator is developed for for financially literate people who verify receipts and invoices issued by restaurants.

It's no secret that you can get cheated in a restaurant and pay a little more than you need to. To prevent this, this calculator has been created.

Suitable for a large company and banquets, when you need to quickly calculate the cost of all dishes.

The menu calculator will allow you to quickly check the restaurant bill against a pre-entered list of dishes(food)

Imagine a situation, you go to the same place for lunch every day and order about the same meals.

Your restaurant has a permanent list of business lunch menus.
After lunch you pay at the restaurant.

To check the cost of your lunch, simply add all the restaurant's dishes to our app.

This can be done on the 👉Food tab via the menu.

When visiting a restaurant, add the dishes you ordered to the calculator from the 👉Food screen. You can do this by clicking the add button near the name.

Next, go to the 👉Calculator tab and select them using the checkbox to the right of each dish or by pressing.

The app will calculate the total cost of your lunch.

Before going to the restaurant

You should start working with the application from the restaurants tab.
Add all the places where you go to eat on this tab.

Next, go to the 👉 Food tab and select add from the menu.

Add all the dishes you would normally order for each of your restaurants. Specify the price of each dish and select a restaurant when adding.

It is better to take a picture of the restaurant menu before going to it and add the main dishes that you plan or already order often.


How to use app in a restaurant?
After lunch, add all the dishes you ordered through the 👉 Food tab. Click add next to each dish.

You can change a restaurant in the drop-down list of dishes at the top of the list of dishes. All dishes of the selected restaurant will be shown.

Another alternative option for filling out the list for calculating the cost is to go to the Restaurants tab and by long-clicking on the selected restaurant select 👉Load menu.

Next, go to the 👉Calculator tab and mark the dishes you want.
The price of all dishes will be calculated at the top next to the For pay label.

If suddenly you need to find out the price for half a portion, then by long pressing in the calculator menu, select 👉Half portion. The price of the selected dish will be halved.

If you ordered a new dish that is not in your calculation list, select Add dish from the menu and set the dish name and price.

The dish will be included in the calculation immediately
How to delete dishes from calculation
With a long press on each dish, a menu appears. Select 👉Delete from the menu and the selected dish will be removed from the list. To delete all dishes from the calculator - select 👉Clear

Deleting a dish in the calculator does not delete it from the application. It remains in the list of all dishes.

Finally, delete the dish through the menu by long pressing on the dish on the 👉Food tab.

name: Dosecast - Pill Reminder App
description:
Established in 2010, thousands continue to use Dosecast - Pill Reminder & Medication Tracker App, the most easy Medication reminder app to help manage ones & their loved one's medications, vitamins, or birth control pills on time -- with unique live sync between devices!

Dosecast - Pill Reminder & Medication Tracker App has been featured in the New York Times, Real Simple magazine, Reader's Digest, About.com, Fierce Mobile Healthcare, and iMedicalApps.com. Remember to take the right drug, the right way & time with this Pill Reminder.

💊 Dosecast Free edition:

🔔 RELIABLE NOTIFICATIONS: Dosecast reliably sends dose reminders to your phone, tablet or Android Wear device and lets you postpone them, like a snooze button. If you miss the first reminder, It can nag you until you respond. It can also sound a continuous alarm. Dosecast Pill Reminder updates your reminder times as you travel across time zones.

⏰ FLEXIBLE SCHEDULING: Some apps can only remind you to take your medication at a fix time daily. Only Pill Tracker helps you take doses on a daily/weekly/monthly schedule, every X days/weeks, only on certain days of the week, or even after a pre-set number of hours or days since the last dose. Avoid dangerous overdoses by setting a maximum number of doses allowed per day.

📝 CUSTOMIZABLE DOSE AMOUNTS AND INSTRUCTIONS: Set the drug name, dosage information, directions, and notes that appear in the reminders for each dose. You can also track each drug's expiration date.

⏱️ POSTPONE MEDICATION REMINDER: You can postpone a pill reminder before or after it goes off.

🔇 SMART SILENCING: Dosecast tracks when you're sleeping or your treatment begins & ends.

🔒 PRIVATE AND SECURE: No personal information is collected when using Pill Reminder. All drug information is encrypted when in transit, so using it's safe even in a public area.


Features of Pro edition with Cloud Sync:

📱 MULTI-DEVICE SYNC: The Dosecast - Pill Tracker & Medication Reminder Cloud Sync service keeps your data up-to-date across an unlimited number of Apple and Android devices.

💉 MULTIPLE DRUG TYPES: You can track drugs taken via injections, inhalers, drops, sprays, ointments, patches, liquid doses, and more.

💊 DOSE HISTORY AND COMPLIANCE: Dosecast - Pill Reminder & Medication Tracker logs the date & time of doses you take, skip, or postpone so you can view or email the history at any time. It even logs late & missed doses so you can accurately track your drug compliance. If you forget to log a dose when you take it, you can edit the history later.

💯 QUANTITY TRACKING AND REFILL ALERTS: Dosecast tracks the remaining quantity of each drug you enter and delivers a refill alert when running low. It will even track the number of refills remaining and alert you when you have no refills left!

👨‍👩‍👧 MULTI-PERSON SUPPORT: Assign specific medication reminder to different people (or even pets). Sort your medications by person, time of next dose, drug name, or drug type - so you can keep your whole family's medication schedule organized.

👨‍⚕️ DOCTOR AND PHARMACY TRACKING: Use your contacts to track which doctor is prescribing which drug, as well as track the pharmacy and prescription number for each.

🗃️ DRUG DATABASE: Entering drug information is easy! Simply pick your medication from our drug database to pre-populate the drug name, type, amount, strength, and route.

🖼️ CUSTOM DRUG PHOTOS: Take your own photos of each drug to identify it more easily. With drug photos, you can be sure you're taking the right drug when a dose is due.

The Pro Edition comes with a 7-day free trial. It can be cancelled at any time.
Confidently take the right drug, the right way, at the right time, every time with Dosecast - Pill Reminder & Medication Tracker App!

Your medical data is securely stored on your device. We prioritize your privacy and have no access to your Electronic Health Records (EHRs) whatsoever.

Take, Skip, and Snooze

Medication History Tracking
Stay informed about your medication intake patterns. Monitor your adherence over time and gain valuable insights into your medication habits to optimize health outcomes.

Manage Multiple Medications
Organize and track multiple prescriptions effortlessly. Stay on top of all your medications to prioritize your health and well-being.

Pause/Resume Functionality

Light/Dark Theme
Customize your experience by setting your preferred theme: light mode, dark mode, or system setting for optimal visibility and comfort.

Support

name: Pill Reminder Medicine Tracker
description:
Pill Reminder keeps you safe, healthy, and perfectly on schedule. The fully-featured Medicine Tracker transforms your iPhone, iPad, and Apple Watch into a caring nurse that never forgets a dose. With smart alarms, refill forecasts, and one-tap logging, Pill Reminder removes guesswork so you can focus on living, not worrying.

🚀 Instant Setup
Add any medication in seconds: tablets, injections, drops, or vitamins. Pill Reminder auto-suggests icons, strengths, and instructions, then builds a precision schedule. Whether you need an every-4-hour antibiotic, a once-weekly methotrexate, or a 21-day birth-control cycle, our Medicine Tracker is flexible enough to handle it all.

🔔 Reliable Alerts
Loud, silent, or vibration-only pill tracker notifications

Persistent medicine reminder banners until you confirm

Apple Watch haptics and lock-screen widgets for hands-free alerts

Smart Reschedule moves missed doses to the safest next time
Our rock-solid Medicine Tracker engine fires locally, so Pill Reminder never fails—even in airplane mode.

📊 Complete Dose History
Missed a pill last Tuesday? Scroll the timeline and see every confirmation, skip, or snooze. Export beautifully formatted PDF or CSV reports straight to your doctor. Your med tracker data stays private on-device and end-to-end encrypted in iCloud if you choose to sync. Because keeping a detailed Pill Reminder log builds trust between you and your care team, every tap matters.

🛒 Automatic Inventory & Refills
Keeping track of bottles is as important as taking the dose. Pill Reminder subtracts each confirmed pill, warns you when only three days remain, and creates a pharmacy shopping list you can share. Your Medicine Tracker automatically calculates refill-by dates and even spots insurance-eligible mail-order opportunities.

🧑‍⚕️ Designed For Every Situation
Seniors needing a large-text med reminder

Parents juggling children's cough syrups and allergy drops

Athletes monitoring supplements and electrolytes

Chronic conditions like diabetes, hypertension, HIV, epilepsy, ADHD, transplant follow-ups
Wherever life takes you, Pill Reminder and its companion Medicine Tracker module travel too.

✨ Advanced Extras
• Siri Shortcuts—say "time for my meds" to log instantly
• Dark Mode & Dynamic Type for tired eyes
• Color tagging distinguishes morning, noon, evening, bedtime routines
• Calendar sync drops each Pill Reminder into your existing schedule
• Secure Face ID lock & stealth notifications protect sensitive info
• Multiple profiles keep family members separate without extra subscriptions
• In-app note field records side-effects, mood, or blood-pressure values for a holistic medicine reminder experience
• Barcode scanner fills drug names, strengths, and NDC codes automatically

🔐 Total Control & Privacy
We're independent—no big-pharma backing, no ad networks. All analytics are anonymous and optional. Because trust is medicine too, Pill Reminder lets you back up, restore, or delete everything with one tap.

💳 Plans & Pricing
Download free and explore the complete feature set for 7 days. Love it? Keep healthy habits running with:
• Weekly – $0.99 (flexible, cancel anytime)
• Yearly – $19.99 (save 60 % and get priority support)
Both plans unlock unlimited medications, family profiles, PDF exports, premium themes, and future Medicine Tracker upgrades. If you change your mind, just cancel in Settings; your Pill Reminder stays fully functional until the period ends.

❓ Frequently Asked Questions
Q: What happens if I switch phones?
A: Sign in with the same Apple ID and the Medicine Tracker sync engine restores every schedule.

Q: Can I track PRN "as needed" pills, like ibuprofen?
A: Yes—mark them as "Take when required," and Pill Reminder logs the exact time and dose.

Q: How many alarms can I set?
A: Unlimited. You can run 30 prescriptions, 50 vitamins, or a single daily tablet—the Pill Reminder core handles it effortlessly.

name: Pill Reminder: Medicine Alarm
description:
Stay on schedule and remember every medicine dose with Pill Reminder: Medicine Alarm, a medication reminder, pill tracker, dose organizer and personal health tracker for your daily routine.

Whether you take prescription medicines, tablets, capsules, vitamins, supplements, antibiotics or short-term medication, create timely reminders and keep your medicine schedule, dose history, appointments and health records organized in one convenient place.

PILL REMINDERS FOR EVERY SCHEDULE

Create a pill reminder with the medicine name, dosage, quantity, time and treatment instructions. Schedule one or multiple doses each day, choose specific weekdays and manage different medication routines without relying on memory.

RELIABLE MEDICINE ALARMS

Receive a clear medicine alarm when it is time to take your medication. View the medicine and dosage, snooze the pill alarm when needed, or mark the dose as taken or skipped. Each reminder shows what is due and when.

TRACK EVERY MEDICATION DOSE

Use the medication tracker to view today's schedule and upcoming pill reminders. Record taken, skipped and missed doses, then review your medicine history to check whether you have already taken a dose. A clear history can reduce confusion when managing several medicines throughout the day.

KEEP MEDICINES ORGANIZED

Store the medicine name, dosage, quantity, reminder time, daily or weekly schedule, treatment instructions and dose history in one place. Update schedules and stay prepared for upcoming alarms. Organize prescriptions, tablets, capsules, vitamins, supplements and multiple daily doses.

TRACK HEALTH MEASUREMENTS

Keep useful personal health records alongside your medication routine. Manually log and monitor:

• Weight
• Water intake
• Sleep
• Blood pressure
• Glucose or blood sugar
• HbA1c
• SpO2 or blood oxygen
• Body temperature

Regular entries help you review progress over time. The app records the values you enter; it does not measure, diagnose or interpret medical conditions.

LOG ACTIVITIES AND SYMPTOMS

Record physical activities and daily symptoms. Keeping medication, measurements, activities and symptoms together makes it easier to review your routine and remember useful details.

DOCTOR APPOINTMENT REMINDERS

Add the healthcare professional, purpose, date, time and notes. Choose when to receive a reminder before a doctor visit, check-up or other healthcare appointment.

HEALTH STATISTICS AND PROGRESS

Review statistics based on the health information and medication activity you record. Follow changes over time, check daily progress and maintain a clearer view of your routine.

SIMPLE MEDICATION TRACKER FOR EVERYDAY USE

Quickly view today's medicines, upcoming reminders, dose history and health entries. The clear design is suitable for adults, seniors, busy users and anyone organizing medication and personal health information.

WHY USE PILL REMINDER?

• Create multiple medicine reminders
• Set flexible medication schedules
• Receive timely pill alarms
• Snooze reminders when necessary
• Mark doses as taken or skipped
• Review medicine and dose history
• Log health measurements
• Record activities and symptoms
• Schedule appointment reminders
• Review health statistics

A SMARTER WAY TO ORGANIZE YOUR HEALTH ROUTINE

Replace unclear phone alarms with a medicine reminder that keeps dosage, schedules and dose history together. See what is due next, review doses, log measurements and remember appointments.

Download Pill Reminder: Medicine Alarm and create an organized medication and health schedule that is easier to follow every day.

IMPORTANT

Pill Reminder is intended only for medication scheduling, reminders, personal dose tracking and manual health record keeping. It does not provide medical advice, diagnosis, dosage recommendations, treatment or emergency services. It does not replace professional medical care or medical devices. Always follow instructions from your doctor, pharmacist or qualified healthcare professional.

Please note that Medication Reminder & Refill is a utility tool designed to help you organize your schedule. It does not constitute professional medical advice.

name: KnowDrugs Drug Checking
description:
KnowDrugs is the easiest way to lookup drug testing results, pill warnings and drug alerts and provides you with drug info about more than 200 drugs, along with advice on harm reduction and safer use. Taking drugs always involves risks - however, if you do decide to take drugs, KnowDrugs can help you to take appropriate measures to reduce potential harms.

DRUG INFORMATION & EDUCATION

Check the profiles of more than 200 drugs for educational purposes: Stimulants like MDMA and Amphetamine, depressants such as Alcohol and Benzodiazepines or psychedelics like 2C-B, LSD and DMT.

KnowDrugs provides you with drug education harm reduction advice, focusing on MDMA / Molly / Ecstasy and other psychoactive substances. Knowing about the wanted and unwanted effects of drugs, their duration, interactions and risks helps you to make more informed decisions, reduce risks and reflect upon your drug habits and consumption behaviour.

DRUG CHECKING, PILL WARNINGS & DRUG ALERTS

Search for drug name, substance or location, to find drug alerts from nearby and learn about their ingredients and dosage strength to avoid overdose and particularly dangerous cuts (e.g. PMA).

Drug checking or pill testing is a way to reduce the harm from drug consumption by allowing users to find out the content and purity of substances that they intend to consume. This empowers users to make safer choices: to avoid more dangerous substances and combination and to use smaller quantities.

If you don't have access to professional drug testing services, looking up recent drug testing results can still help you make a more informed decision about your consumption.

HARM REDUCTION & RESPONSIBLE DRUG USE

Harm reduction aims to minimize the harms associated with recreational substance use. The harm reduction approach follows from the idea that substance use is a high-risk activity that innately entails the possibility of injury, addiction, and death. Therefore, the best strategy one can employ (outside of avoiding use entirely) is to take appropriate measures to mitigate its potential harms.

KnowDrugs highlights the harm-potential of more than 200 substances and demonstrates strategies on how to reduce the harms associated with the consumption of drugs.

KNOWDRUGS CAN ALSO HELP YOU TO:

- learn how to spot and react in case of an emergency, take care of someone experiencing a bad trip at a party or festival
- find a free and confidential counselling service which accepts you and your personal choices, and helps you develop the right strategies and competencies if you want to change something about your consumption behaviour.

name: OpenRx : Drug Interactions

anyone can understand.

⚠️ Important Medical Disclaimer
• OpenRx is NOT a medical device and does NOT provide medical advice, diagnosis, or treatment recommendations of any kind.
• OpenRx is an independent third-party app. It is NOT affiliated with, endorsed by, or officially representing the U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA) or any government agency.
• All data comes from the FDA's publicly available databases, including the FDA Adverse Event Reporting System (FAERS) and official drug labeling.
• FAERS contains voluntary reports submitted by patients, healthcare professionals, and manufacturers. A reported reaction does NOT mean the drug caused it. Reports are not verified for accuracy or causation.
• Statistical report data is NOT a substitute for professional medical judgment.
• NEVER start, stop, or change any medication based on information in this app.
• ALWAYS consult your doctor, pharmacist, or licensed healthcare provider before making any decision about your medications.
• If you experience a medical emergency, call 911 or your local emergency number immediately.

▶ Official Data Source
• OpenRx retrieves data exclusively from openFDA, the official public API of the U.S. Food and Drug Administration.
• FDA Adverse Event Reporting System (FAERS) : real-world side effect reports
• FDA Drug Labeling : official warnings, interactions, dosage information
• https://open.fda.gov/apis/authentication/

▶ Key Features
【 Drug Interaction Checker 】
• Select two or more medications and instantly see reactions reported to the FDA by people who took the same combination.
• View total report counts, the most commonly reported reactions, and clear visual charts all based on real adverse event data.

【 Medication Side Effect Search 】
• Search any prescription drug or over-the-counter medicine. Compare official label warnings against real-world FDA reports. See total report volume, serious outcome percentages, drug interactions from the label, and dosage information presented in clean, readable cards.

【 My Meds - Personal Medication List 】
• Keep a private list of the medications you take. Add drug names with automatic FDA label matching, record your dosage, and manage everything in one place stored only on your device.

【 Daily Medication Reminders 】
• Never miss a dose. Set daily reminders for each medication and receive alerts at your chosen times even when the app is closed. Reliable, exact-time notifications help you stay consistent with your regimen.

【 Save & Share Reports 】
• Save interaction check results to your history for quick reference, and share clean summaries with family members or bring them to your next doctor or pharmacy visit.

▶ Who is OpenRx for?
• Anyone taking multiple medications who wants to look up reported interaction data Caregivers managing medications for family members
• People who want a private medication list and daily pill reminder

▶ Your Privacy Comes First
• OpenRx is built on a strict privacy-first architecture.
• NO account or sign-up required
• NO personal data collected, uploaded, shared, or sold ever
• Your medication list, reminders, and saved reports are stored ONLY on your device
• The only network requests are anonymous drug-name queries to the public FDA API no personally identifiable information is ever transmitted

Widgets

Completely ad-free and open source

ReceiptFile is an offline receipt scanner and business expense tracker for Canadian freelancers, contractors and small business owners. Keep receipt photos and PDFs connected to your expense records, then export an organized package for your accountant at tax time.

Scan and review receipts
Take a photo or import a JPEG, PNG or PDF saved on your device. On-device text recognition suggests the merchant, date, total and tax amounts to reduce typing. Review and correct the details before confirming, or save them to check later. You can also enter expenses manually.

Keep business expenses organized
Store a copy of the original receipt with its expense record. Choose a category, add notes, record refunds and set the business-use percentage for mixed purchases. Keep separate businesses organized in one app.

Record Canadian receipt taxes
Keep GST/HST, PST/RST and QST amounts alongside each purchase. Review your records in Canadian dollars. For receipts in a supported foreign currency, enter the converted CAD total and a note about the conversion.

Find the receipt you need
Search expense records by merchant, date, amount, category or notes. Browse a monthly calendar, open a day's records or review a whole year. Find entries that still need checking and return to the saved receipt to verify the details.

Prepare your year-end records
Export a ZIP package for each business and year with CSV expense records, category summaries, original receipt files and change history. Open the CSV files in your spreadsheet app or pass the package to your accountant for review.

Work offline, without an account
Scan, review and organize receipts on your device. Your receipt images, recognized text and expense records are processed and stored locally. No sign-up or bank connection is required.

Back up your receipt collection
Create a password-encrypted backup of your businesses and years, and restore it when needed. Keep a separate copy on a computer or USB drive and store your password safely. Backups are manual; losing your phone or uninstalling the app can remove local records. CSV and accountant ZIP exports are not password-encrypted.

ReceiptFile helps organize records for bookkeeping and tax preparation. It does not calculate tax deductions, file tax returns or submit records to the Canada Revenue Agency. Scanned details need your review, and recorded totals are not confirmed deductible amounts.

Do you have to repeat something every so often? Then, this app may be for you.

Simply set your interval and press "Start". You will get a beep, and smartwatch notification, every interval.

Caution: leave the display on else Android's "battery saver" algorithm could make the app unreliable. Switch to other apps as needed but return to RR (because the app, when in the foreground, blocks the display from turning off).

There are a number of options to make the app work just right for you.

2 modes
* In the Alarm mode, the app will beep at the end or each interval
* In the Interval Training, aka Countdown, mode, the phone will countdown each period

Favorites
* Stores "favorites" -- up to 9 for Alarm, 9 for Interval Training
* Swipe through your favorites
* Active period. Will only beep during the hours that you define for the favorite

Some uses :
* HIIT [other intervals -- work/rest, study/internet]
* Round-the-dinner-table "debates"
* Kitchen timer (my favorite! Pancakes, steak, burgers)
* Pill reminder
* Take a break from staring at your computer screen (or co-worker)
* Get off your butt periodically (in the office)

name: Hvacio: Serwis HVAC, Przeglądy
description:
Hvacio to mobilna aplikacja dla niezależnych serwisantów branży HVAC w Polsce. Pozwala prowadzić bazę klientów, rejestr urządzeń i historię wizyt serwisowych bezpośrednio z telefonu, także bez dostępu do internetu w terenie. Po zakończonej wizycie automatycznie generujesz protokół serwisowy w formacie PDF i wysyłasz go do klienta jednym kliknięciem.

Aplikacja jest narzędziem profesjonalnym, zaprojektowanym dla osób obsługujących kotły gazowe i urządzenia objęte dozorem UDT, klimatyzacje typu split, multisplit i VRF, pompy ciepła powietrze-woda oraz gruntowe, rekuperatory i wentylację mechaniczną. Sprawdzi się też w serwisie innych urządzeń HVAC, ponieważ formularz wizyty pozwala dostosować listę czynności do typu obsługiwanego sprzętu.

W aplikacji prowadzisz bazę klientów wraz z pełnymi danymi kontaktowymi, adresem i numerami identyfikacyjnymi firmy. Dla klientów biznesowych dane firmy można pobrać automatycznie z rejestru REGON Głównego Urzędu Statystycznego po podaniu NIP, bez ręcznego przepisywania. Bazę można też zaimportować z pliku Excel, jeśli prowadziłeś ją wcześniej w arkuszu.

Do każdego klienta przypisujesz urządzenia, które serwisujesz, wraz z numerami seryjnymi i historią przeglądów. Podczas wizyty wybierasz urządzenie, zaznaczasz wykonane czynności z listy dopasowanej do jego typu i opisujesz zużyte materiały. Wszystko zapisuje się od razu w pamięci telefonu, a po powrocie w zasięg sieci synchronizuje się z chmurą.

Każdej wizycie możesz dorzucić zdjęcia urządzenia robione prosto z aplikacji oraz notatki głosowe nagrywane w terenie. Notatki głosowe pozwalają udokumentować szczegóły obsługi szybciej, niż pisanie palcem na ekranie podczas pracy w kotłowni czy na dachu.

Po zakończeniu wizyty aplikacja generuje protokół serwisowy w PDF, zawierający dane firmy, listę wykonanych czynności, użyte materiały i datę przeglądu. Protokół wysyłasz klientowi e-mailem prosto z aplikacji. W stopce możesz dorzucić link do formularza opinii Google Maps, który pomaga budować pozytywne oceny firmy w wyszukiwarce.

Każdy serwisant otrzymuje publiczną mini-stronę pod adresem hvacio.pl, na której prezentowane są dane kontaktowe i lista obsługiwanych typów urządzeń. Strona ma uporządkowane meta-dane dla wyszukiwarek, dzięki czemu klienci szukający lokalnego serwisu mogą cię znaleźć w Google.

Powiadomienia push przypominają o nadchodzących przeglądach, dzięki czemu nie tracisz zlecenia z powodu zapomnianej daty.

Wszystkie dane synchronizują się przez bezpieczne połączenie HTTPS. Zdjęcia i nagrania głosowe trzymamy w europejskim regionie chmury, we Frankfurcie. Subskrypcję obsługujemy na stronie hvacio.pl, w aplikacji nie ma żadnych płatności wewnętrznych.

Procedura usunięcia konta i wszystkich powiązanych danych dostępna jest pod adresem hvacio.pl/usun-konto. Pomoc techniczna oraz pytania o prywatność: support@hvacio.pl.

name: Pomodoro Timer
description:
Bring structure to your workflow by utilising time blocking technique.


Time blocking is an effective strategy for using time wisely and achieving greater results. Blocking out time for specific activities allows you to focus on one task at a time, limit distractions and procrastination.


It's really simple to use:


1. Define your tasks at hand, make a task list.

2. Define a block of time during which you will eliminate all distractions and give all your focus to your tasks. Start the timer and work.

3. Take frequent breaks. Regular breaks are conducive to greater productivity and concentration. During these breaks take a breath of fresh air, do some push-ups, stretch or anything else that helps you to restore your power. Your body will thank you.

4. Repeat this work/break cycle and take a longer breaks when you feel you need to.

That’s not true! Let us explain the real reasons.

● Repetition Leads to Boredom:
When the initial novelty wears off, the repetitive nature of the task can make you feel bored and tired.

● Overly Negative Focus:
Focusing on what you haven't accomplished rather than acknowledging what you have done can lead to negative self-evaluation and loss of motivation.

We offer hundreds of unique planet designs, satisfying your curiosity and desire to collect with constant surprises. See a planet's full appearance only after evolving it through focused efforts. Earn Stardust coins by focusing to unlock new planet seeds, motivating continuous concentration.

● Meticulously Crafted Design

DOES THIS SOUND LIKE YOU?

WHY INFLOW?

Inflow is based on Cognitive Behavioral Therapy (CBT) principles. We don't just give you a tool; we teach you the "why" behind your brain and how to cope when motivation is low.
Thriving starts with understanding your unique neurodivergence. Meet your goals, kick the distraction habit, and create a daily structure adapted to you.

🧠 SCIENCE-BASED MODULES FOR ADHD SUPPORT (CBT-INSPIRED)

- Focus and concentration

- Goal Setting and Consistency
- Time management and routines
- Emotional regulation and self-criticism

- Impulsivity & Anxiety related to ADHD

⚙️ TOOLS FOR EVERYDAY LIFE

Inflow helps you build routines one day at a time. Whether studying, organizing your home, or making space for self-care, our tools help you focus on what matters most.

WHO IS INFLOW FOR?

Whether you’re newly diagnosed, late-diagnosed, or still figuring things out, ADHD doesn’t have to dictate your day. Inflow meets you wherever you are on your journey. You do not need a formal diagnosis to use our tools.

- Think you might have ADHD? If you relate to things like distraction, time blindness, or task paralysis but don’t have a formal diagnosis, Inflow can help you understand your brain and start building better habits. No doctor’s note required.

- Newly Diagnosed? Diagnosis explains the ”what”, but Inflow teaches the “how”. We bridge the gap between clinical diagnosis and daily life by teaching you the practical CBT skills and coping mechanisms that complement medication and clinical care.

- Living with ADHD? Even pros hit burnout. Consistency is hard! Inflow provides the external structure and community accountability ("Body Doubling") you need to stay on track and reset when life gets overwhelming.

- Struggling with Executive Function? Focus and regulation issues aren't exclusive to ADHD. Whether navigating Autism (ASD), OCD, Depression, or general burnout, our tools help you overcome paralysis regardless of your specific label.

name: Sectograph. Day & Time planner
description:
🎯 Sectograph is a new, intuitive way to view your calendar and daily schedule.

It shows your day as a circular planner — a 12-hour clock face — with events and free time between them.
A visual time planner for time blocking, time management, and a clearer sense of time.


⚙️ HOW IT WORKS

Sectograph is lightweight, privacy-friendly, and works with your existing calendars on the device.
It overlays your day planner (routine, local calendar, Google Calendar) onto a clock-face timeline and automatically calculates:

• upcoming events
• time blocks and durations
• gaps between events and your real free time

Everything updates as time passes, keeping your schedule always current.
Not a to-do list — it’s a calendar-based schedule planner that visualizes what’s already on your calendar.


👀 HOW IT LOOKS

Like an analog clock your brain already understands — but with your day mapped onto it as sectors.

• Events appear exactly in the hours they happen (a radial / circular calendar view)
• Each sector width matches the event duration (a true pie-chart schedule)
• See gaps and the time from “now” to the next event at a glance

A clock planner / visual planner that helps you read your day instantly.


🎯 USE CASES & IDEAS

Use Sectograph as a day planner, daily planner, time planner, or routine planner for time management and daily schedule planning.
Great for time blocking (deep work, meetings, breaks), work/shift schedules, class schedules, travel itineraries, and Pomodoro planning (place focus sessions as time blocks).
If you like Chronodex, you’ll feel right at home.


🔄 SYNC & CALENDARS

Reads events from Google Calendar and your local device calendar; Microsoft Outlook calendar: beta.


📱 HOME SCREEN CALENDAR WIDGET

Keep your schedule always visible with a calendar widget / home screen widget.

• Automatic updates (including a clock refresh once a minute)
• Tap a sector to open details and quick actions
• Flexible visual settings + free widget themes: Dark / White / Gray
• Optional: light/dark app theme, 24-hour mode & extra zoom (1–12h), month/day grid views


⌚ WEAR OS (SMARTWATCH SUPPORT)

A true Wear OS calendar / smartwatch calendar at a glance:

• Watch app with an interactive widget
• Tile for quick access to the circular planner
• Watch face for continuous schedule awareness (installed separately)
• Large complication to enhance some third-party watch faces


🧠 HELPFUL FOR ADHD & “TIME BLINDNESS”

Designed to make time easier to grasp — especially if you struggle with time blindness, which is common for people with ADHD.
(Sectograph is not a medical app.)

✅ Install Sectograph and get a calm, visual overview of your day.

name: Diem: Big Group Chat Energy
description:
AI Search, Community Chats

Welcome to Diem! We’re building your new front door to the internet.

Diem is a search-engine-meets-social-network designed first for girls, women, and LGBTQIA+ folks. You can search the internet with Diem AI and find answers to anything life throws at you. “How do I get over a friend breakup? What’s the best way to negotiate salary? My boyfriend follows models on Instagram—is that a red flag?” Diem is here to help.

Our platform is also full of novel, collective knowledge from people all over the world. You can socialize your search to start conversations, discover a network of communities, connect over shared experiences and browse trending topics.

Joining Diem means showing up with no judgment and immersing yourself in the candid, funny, authentic, important, supportive, outrageous, honest, and wholesome questions of other Diemers, which span everything from birth control to friendship, sexuality to pop culture, parenting to relationships, money to reproductive health, career to books, and so much more. Diem feels more like searching for answers in the girls’ bathroom than spiraling alone on the internet.

Here’s what you can find in the app today:

Diem AI-powered search

Ask Diem AI, our AI-powered search tool, your questions! Our search engine is designed to be less bias than other models. You can think of Diem AI as your most knowledgeable Virgo “big sister” who lives in your back pocket. Diem AI draws from across the internet and the collective wisdom of Diemers to generate you a speedy answer. When you ask Diem AI you’ll receive a short summary answer, community sources (previous, related conversations in Diem), community spaces, web pages, Reddit threads and TikTok videos. You can dive in to these search results OR you can post your search to the community feed to get real-time feedback from people who’ve been there.

Diem AI Lenses

You can now ask questions of leading experts and your fave creators in Diem. Ask their Lens anything and your search result will feature their opinions & content from across the internet.

Discover thousands of authentic conversations

From awkward sex questions to wholesome big sisterly advice or navigating life’s highs and lows, Diem is full of the collective knowledge of girls, women, and LGBTQIA+ folks in over 100 countries.There’s no judgment here and you’ll feel that very quickly.

Post anonymously or under a pseudonym

We think of the anonymous feature as a confidence booster. Sometimes posting ‘taboo’ questions or personal stories publicly can be nerve-wracking, so this feature is designed to make you feel more comfortable while getting the advice you need.

Community Spaces

Community Spaces are micro communities that are also discoverable when related questions are searched via Diem AI. A few currently live: Am I wrong?, Big Sis Advice (BSA) and Is this Normal…? (ITN) We’re still early in building out Spaces and you can request additional Spaces or host your own.

Creating Posts

If you have a longer story, recommendation or advice to offer you can click the + button on your Discover feed and type out all your stories or wisdom. These posts will be discovered via the search engine and in Diemer’s discovery feeds.

Upvoting & Bookmarking

See a post or response you want to save for later or give some love to, click to bookmark, “heart” or upvote it!

Safety & Privacy First

Safety & moderation are our top priority at Diem. See something, say something! We have distributed moderation—if you report something, we review it, ensuring there’s no violation of the community culture. We also take your privacy very seriously—whatever you search is your business.

We’re still early in our journey to build Diem into your new ‘front door’ to the internet, if you have any problems or ideas for the app, get support at help@askdiem.com.

Happy Dieming!

name: Open Food Facts
description:
🔍 Scan, Discover & Compare Over 4 Million Food Products


The app allows to scan the 4 million products already contained in the free and open database Open Food Facts.
The app is collaborative. If we don't have the product, you can add pictures and data to get the Nutri-Score and NOVA score on food processing.

In short, we're kind of "the Wikipedia of food", as many have nicknamed the project. Open Food Facts has enabled the creation of over 100 apps like Date Limite, Yuka or FoodVisor.

🥦 Make Healthier Food Choices



➜ The Nutri-Score grade, from A to E : Nutritional quality
➜ The NOVA group, from 1 to 4 : Avoid ultra-processed foods (Group 4)

🌍 Join Our Mission for Food Transparency



➜ Open Food Facts is a food products database made by everyone, for everyone.
➜ You can use it to make better food choices, and as it is open data, anyone can re-use it for any purpose.
➜ You can start contributing today by adding a product from your fridge.
➜ Open Food Facts is a non-profit project developed by thousands of volunteers from around the world. We have lots of exciting projects you can contribute to in many different ways.

🏷️ Decode Food Labels with Ease



➜ Open Food Facts helps you decipher products labels. You will be able to find:
➜ carbon footprint (CO2 emissions) and packaging (as well as recycling instructions),
➜ Nutriscore (nutritional score), nutrients, fat / fat content, saturated fatty acids, carbohydrates, sugars, fiber, protein and salt and sodium.
➜ brands, allergens, labels (bio, gluten free, vegan, vegetarian, halal, kosher ...), traceability information (packaging codes, origins of ingredients)
➜ On wines and beers, you will find the alcohol content.

🔬 Backed by Science, Supporting Research


➜ We don't make up things. We rely on peer-reviewed science.
➜ The Nutri-Score has been created by the independent French team led by Professor Hercberg.
➜ The NOVA groups on food processing have been designed by the international team of Professor Monteiro.
➜ The additives synthesis is based on reviews by EFSA on exposure levels on food additives.
➜ The Open Food Facts community is collaborating with research teams across the planet to improve nutrition research that benefits all.

🔒 Your food, your data. Privacy-Centric App


➜ Your data is yours, and is never sent online
➜ You can use the app anonymously
➜ You can export your scan history

🚨 Set Allergen Alerts


➜ Milk, Gluten, Eggs, Soybeans, Nuts, Fish, Celery, Mustard, Sulphur dioxide and sulphites, Peanuts, Sesame seeds, Crustaceans, Molluscs or Lupin allergy ?
➜ Speed up your shopping by doing an initial screening of your food with Open Food Facts.
➜ Be careful that the information may not be 100% accurate, and detection may not be 100% accurate. So always double check by yourself, with the packaging.

💰 Open Prices: Transparency on Food Costs


- Contribute to Price Transparency. When you shop, add the price on the shelf, or at home, add the receipt. Let's track shrinkflation, cheapflation & more.

💄🧴🐶 More Than Just Food: Scan All Your Products


Open Beauty Facts: Scan cosmetics and hygiene products. You can check for ingredients you want to avoid by setting up "ingredient bans" to get personalized alerts.

Open Pet Food Facts: Find information on food for your furry friends.

Open Products Facts: Discover information on all other products (e.g., electronics, toys, clothes). This database helps you make more circular choices and increase the life of your products.

🌐 Open Food Facts: More Than An App


Open Food Facts is also available on the web at openfoodfacts.org
Feedback : mobile@openfoodfacts.org

The app comes directly from the research team at Monash and includes the following:

- General information about the FODMAP diet and IBS.
- Easy to understand tutorials to guide you through the app and the 3-Step FODMAP diet.
- A Food Guide detailing the FODMAP content for hundreds of foods using a simple 'traffic light system'.
- A list of branded products that have been certified by Monash as low FODMAP.
- A collection of over 70 nutritious, low FODMAP recipes.
- Functions that allow you to create your own shopping list and add notes to individual foods
- A Diary that enables you to record food eaten, IBS symptoms, bowel habits and stress levels. The Diary will also guide you through step 2 of the diet - FODMAP reintroduction.
- The ability to adjust units of measurement (metric or imperial) and activate colour blindness assistance.
