The Low FODMAP diet can be difficult because specific foods, serving sizes, the elimination phase, reintroduction, and personal tolerance all matter. Bloat Gone helps you connect what you eat with how you feel, without keeping everything in separate notes.

Low FODMAP food list and scanner

* Check a Low FODMAP food list with Low, Moderate, and High levels.
* Search foods by name, category, and FODMAP level.
* Use the barcode scanner for packaged foods when shopping.
* Review packaged food ingredients and save found products to your own list.
* Add custom foods when you want to observe your personal tolerance.

Meal tracker, food diary, and FODMAP stacking

* Log meals and foods eaten throughout the day.
* Build meals from multiple ingredients and review the total FODMAP load.
* Track FODMAP stacking in a meal when several foods are combined.
* See which FODMAP groups may matter: oligos, fructose, lactose, and polyols.
* Plan meals during the elimination phase and reintroduction.

IBS symptom tracker

* Record symptoms such as bloating, gas, abdominal pain, stool changes, and severity.
* Add notes about stress, unusual meals, time of day, or other observations.
* Connect symptoms with meals to make possible reactions easier to notice.
* Use the IBS symptom tracker for irritable bowel syndrome, SIBO, or digestive sensitivity.

Low FODMAP diet phases

* Use the app during elimination, reintroduction, and personalization.
* Observe which Low FODMAP foods are better tolerated by you.
* Save foods that may trigger or worsen digestive symptoms.
* Build your personal tolerance profile instead of relying only on general lists.

Reports for a doctor or dietitian

* Prepare tolerance reports and possible food trigger summaries.
* Export meal logs, symptom records, and notes.
* Show your doctor or dietitian more organized data from your food diary.
* Use reports during appointments about IBS, SIBO, bloating, abdominal pain, or food intolerance.

This FODMAP app can support people following a Low FODMAP diet for IBS, SIBO, or irritable bowel syndrome. You can use it as a Low FODMAP food list, meal tracker, food diary, IBS symptom tracker, and a place to observe food intolerance and possible reactions after eating.

Important: Bloat Gone is not a medical device and does not diagnose, treat, cure, or prevent any disease or medical condition. The app is intended for educational and self-tracking purposes only and is not a substitute for professional medical advice, diagnosis, or treatment. Follow a Low FODMAP diet with guidance from a doctor, dietitian, or another qualified healthcare professional.

name: IBS Coach Complete FODMAP Diet
description:
The Gold Standard FODMAP Diet Plan

Based on 15+ years of scientific research, studies show the low FODMAP diet is effective at reducing IBS symptoms in up to 75% of people.

The low FODMAP diet helps manage digestive symptoms, including: Bloating, Abdominal pain, Diarrhoea, Constipation, Cramps, Excessive Gas, and other digestive complaints.

The Shortest Path to Getting Results

People typically feel relief within 10-14 days of starting a low FODMAP plan. IBS Coach is the complete FODMAP diet app for beginners - guiding you through a step-by-step plan, without the stress of figuring it out on your own.

Low FODMAP isn't a forever diet. It's a temporary, structured plan to calm your digestion, identify your unique triggers, and get back to normal living.

Have you been told to try a low FODMAP diet?

You might have been given a FODMAP food list and left to get on with it. Attempting the FODMAP diet with a simple food list when you need a guided plan is the reason people fail the elimination phase or get stuck eating low FODMAP forever.

The Plan in Three Steps

IBS Coach has been developed with dietitians and doctors to make the process simple, enjoyable, and delicious:

1. Calm your gut: Get your digestion under control with our guided low FODMAP elimination phase.
2. Test your triggers: Safely test your tolerance to specific foods to identify your trigger ingredients. Everyone is different. Don't skip this step.
3. Get back to normal living: Knowing your triggers means you're in control and can enjoy meals again.

What's Included: Your Complete FODMAP Plan

Built with dietitians and doctors, your gold standard FODMAP plan includes:

- Meal Planner & Automated Shopping Lists: Personalised weekly plans with shopping lists built for you.
- 100+ Dietitian-Approved Low FODMAP Recipes: Breakfasts, lunches, dinners, desserts and snacks — with Gluten-Free, Dairy-Free, Lactose-Free, Vegan & Vegetarian options.
- A–Z FODMAP Ingredient Database: Look up any ingredient and know instantly if it's safe, caution or avoid.
- The SOS Flare-Up Guide: Know exactly what to do when symptoms strike.
- Comprehensive Symptom Tracker: Log symptoms, add your own notes, and spot the patterns behind your triggers.
- Progress Reports: Track and monitor your improvement over time.
- Knowledge Bank: Bite-sized education to understand your gut and stay in control.

Daily Science-Backed Education & Practical Tips

As well as the complete FODMAP plan, IBS Coach helps you understand and improve your digestion:

- Diet education: learn about FODMAPs and how ingredients trigger symptoms
- Stress management: science-backed techniques to calm non-dietary triggers
- Exercise for digestive health: practical movement tips to support digestion
- A good sleep plan for digestion: improve sleep, a key factor that may contribute to flare-ups

Everyone is different, and your personalised plan helps you take control of your IBS. Join over 100,000 people discovering meals that work for their gut. Get back to living your life again.

Please note: IBS Coach does not diagnose, treat or cure any disease and does not replace a medical doctor. You should seek a doctor's advice before starting any new diet or wellness plan.

It takes an average of 6 years to receive an IBS diagnosis. Tummily helps change that.
Turn your symptom logs and food diary into a clear, exportable PDF report to share with your doctor or dietitian, while staying in control of your data.

Tummily was founded by leading IBS dietitian Chelsea McCallum APD after years of supporting thousands through her digital clinic.

name: Gluten Dude: GF Restaurants
description:
EATING OUT SHOULDN'T BE THIS HARD.

If you have celiac disease or a gluten intolerance, you've probably done this before.

You find a restaurant that looks promising.

Then the work begins.

You read reviews. You search Facebook groups. You look at crowdsourced apps. You study the menu. You call the restaurant. You hope the person on the phone actually understands what you're asking.

Maybe you feel better.

Maybe you don't.

Either way, you're still left making one of the most important decisions of your day with incomplete information.

That's the part I wanted to fix.

EVERY RESTAURANT EARNS ITS PLACE.

All restaurants start with someone in the gluten-free community who had a safe experience and told us about it.

Then our team gets to work.

First, we research the restaurant — looking into their gluten-free practices and reputation before we ever reach out.

Then we vet it directly. We contact the restaurant and ask the questions that matter. How do they prevent cross-contact? Is there a dedicated fryer? Does the staff understand celiac disease?

Then we write everything up in plain English, so you know what to expect before you ever walk through the door.

Community starting points.

Independent research.

Complete transparency.

WHY I BUILT GLUTEN DUDE.

I've had celiac disease since 2007.

Like you, I've spent way too much time trying to figure out where it was actually safe to eat. I've been glutened by restaurants that sounded confident. I've asked all the awkward questions.

After years of doing the same research over and over, I had one thought:

Why isn't someone doing this for us?

So I built the app I wished I'd had.

KNOW WHAT YOU'RE LOOKING AT.

Every restaurant is clearly labeled, so there's never any guessing about what you're getting.

• 100% Gluten-Free
Dedicated gluten-free restaurants.

• Dude Vetted
Personally researched by our team, complete with detailed notes about cross-contact procedures, kitchen practices, dedicated fryers, and staff knowledge.

• User Suggested
Restaurants we've researched but couldn't fully verify directly, backed by positive experiences from our community.

• Trusted Chains
Chain restaurants our community consistently trusts.

No mystery ratings.

No hidden scoring.

Just complete transparency.

BUILT FOR LIFE WITH CELIAC.

Gluten Dude is more than a gluten-free restaurant finder.

It's a travel companion.

• Trip Planner
Find trusted restaurants along your exact driving route.

• Airport Dining
Browse gluten-free options in more than 100 airports, organized by terminal.

• Destination Planning
Know your safest dining options before you leave home.

Because the best trips are the ones where you spend your time making memories, not searching for your next meal.

NO PAY-TO-PLAY.

Restaurants can't pay to be featured. No ads influencing what you see.

Every restaurant is here because it earned its place.

Because trust is everything.

SAVE MONEY.

Living gluten-free is expensive enough.

Gluten Dude members get exclusive discounts on hundreds of gluten-free products to help make it a little easier.

TRUSTED BY THOUSANDS.

"Your approach is far superior to other apps in terms of safety. Your app is desperately needed." - Sandy

"Nothing else I've seen has the breadth of up-to-date, peace-of-mind info on where to safely go." - GF Seeker

"I feel much more confident using your app vs. any other. How diligent you are is what separates you from the rest." - Laura

"I won't use any other app besides yours - because safety first!" - Kelly

"Love the app when I was planning a road trip! So nice being able to see different routes with GF options!" - Kristen

FROM SOMEONE WHO GETS IT...

I know what it's like to stand outside a restaurant wondering if you're making the right decision.

I know what it's like to be tired of second-guessing every meal.

That's why Gluten Dude exists.

Not to tell you where to eat.

To help you feel confident about where you choose to eat.

- Scan history: every result you scan, saved for next time

It names the ingredient
A red light is only half an answer. When a product contains gluten, this ingredient checker names the one responsible, wherever the database has that detail, so you start spotting the usual suspects on labels yourself.

Just diagnosed?
The first weeks of a gluten free diet are a crash course. What has gluten in it? Is soy sauce gluten free? Which beer can you still drink? The app answers those questions while you find your feet, so the grocery shop stops feeling like an exam.

Missing product? Get an answer anyway
Sooner or later you'll scan something the app hasn't seen before. Photograph the barcode, the name, and the ingredients list, and often you'll have a verdict while you're still in the aisle. If it needs a human eye, we review it, and your addition is there for the next person who picks up that product.

Offline mode (Premium)
Supermarket dead spots, basement aisles, flights. Download the database once over Wi-Fi and the food scanner carries on with no signal at all; it refreshes itself the next time you open the app online. It packs well, too: scan your way round a supermarket abroad with mobile data switched off.

Scan history (Premium)
Every result is saved, so you look a product up once and the answer is waiting next week. No more trying to remember which brand it was that passed.

Share what you find
Scanning for a child, a partner, or a friend? Share a product's result in one tap, so everyone doing the shopping sees the same answer.

For every gluten free shopper
Coeliac disease, non-coeliac gluten sensitivity, a gluten intolerance, or a coeliac friend coming to dinner: the question in the aisle is the same. Is it gluten free? Scan snacks, cereals, bread, pasta, sauces, chocolate, and drinks on the weekly grocery shop, and get a straight answer on each one.

A note on gluten
Gluten comes from wheat, barley, rye, spelt, and triticale. On a label it hides behind names like barley malt, malt extract, wheat starch, and hydrolysed wheat protein, and it turns up where you least expect it: soy sauce, stock cubes, soups, sweets, and beer. The app reads the ingredients and warnings recorded for a product and flags the ones that mean gluten, including "may contain" and shared-facility warnings where they're recorded, so you're not decoding every label on your own. It can only read what's on record for a product, so always check the packaging, and talk to your doctor about managing coeliac or celiac disease. Gluten Free Scanner is not a medical device and does not diagnose, treat, cure, or prevent any medical condition.

Install it before your next shop and try it on whatever's in the cupboard.

name: How to Gluten Free
description:
How to Gluten Free helps coeliacs eat away from home: the places we checked, a trip planner, a label tool and a meal planner, with the same evidence rule under each.

ONE PERSON, NOT FOUR CATEGORIES
Whether you are travelling, packing a lunchbox, cooking or reading a label, you are the same coeliac. One site, one app, one community. Four tools, one person:

EAT OUT — Atlas, the places we checked
14,000+ gluten-free places in 90+ countries, on a map that never flattens the difference: gold ★ for verified dedicated kitchens, a separate marker for self-declared places awaiting our check, GF-serving from shared kitchens. Every listing carries a dated evidence line: the source we relied on and the date we last checked it. Filter by what a coeliac actually asks: Dedicated fryer · Separate prep · Staff trained · GF menu. Recall alerts for the countries you choose. Stadiums, theme parks, hospitals — the venue types few maps bother with.

PLAN — Compass, your trip and route planner (beta)
Build a trip stop by stop and see the listed places along the way — at both airports, around the midpoint, on every stretch. A scouting aid for the week before, not road navigation.

LEARN — Label Lab and the field guide
Label Lab tells you what a gluten-free claim, a logo or a "may contain" line means on a label — pick your market: EU, UK, USA, Canada or Australia/New Zealand. Translation cards show staff what you need, in their language, written for coeliacs, not for tourists. The Ingredient Decoder reads an ingredient list with you, the Translator carries coeliac questions to the table, and the Flour Library explains every gluten-free flour and what it stands in for.

COOK — Meal Lab (beta)
A week planner with a grocery list: plan the week, shop once. New, and growing.

WHAT "DEDICATED" AND "VERIFIED BY US" MEAN
★ Dedicated marks a kitchen that is 100% gluten-free — nothing containing gluten is prepared there, so there is no shared fryer, oven or prep bench to worry about. "Verified by us" means exactly that: a person at How to Gluten Free checked the evidence — never a machine, never a review. A place that calls itself dedicated but hasn't been through our check is shown as "Dedicated — self-declared, pending our check", clearly and without the star. Community reports are read by a person before they appear; they are experience, never a safety verdict, and they never set a tier.

HELP US MAP IT
Found a dedicated bakery we don't have yet? Somewhere that closed, or changed its protocol? Tap "Suggest a place" or "Report a change" — three taps, straight to our review team, and a person checks every single one. A map of real places is never finished: it gets better every week, and your finds are part of that.

SAFETY INFORMATION IS NEVER BEHIND A PAYWALL
Tiers, the evidence line, search, the map, Label Lab, the translation cards and recall alerts are free for everyone, with no account needed — and they stay free. Any optional membership only ever unlocks travel conveniences such as offline packs and trip boards, never the evidence.

A NOTE ON TRUST
How to Gluten Free is a travel and communication aid — not a medical service, and not a guarantee. Always confirm the gluten-free protocol with staff when you arrive.

name: Baby Meals: 3-Day Allergy Log
description:
Which food did you try first, and how did your baby react that day?
Starting solids is a lot to keep in your head. Baby Meals logs the meals and
watches every new food for three days so you do not have to remember.

■ Three days of watching for every new food
Save a meal that contains a food your baby has never had, and the three day watch
starts right there. From the next day on, one box a day: just mark whether anything
happened. Three quiet days and the food moves up to Safe. One symptom and it is
marked Allergic straight away.
Symptoms you can tag: Rash, Vomiting, Diarrhea, Hives, Other.

■ Ingredient library
94 foods commonly used for weaning are already in the app, from rice and beef to
broccoli, apple and pumpkin. They are sorted into Grains, Meat, Seafood, Vegetables,
Fruit, Dairy, Legumes and Other, and every food carries one of four states:
Not tried, Watching, Safe, Allergic.
31 of them are common allergens such as wheat flour, milk, peanut and shrimp, and
they are flagged so you look twice before the first spoonful. Anything missing from
the list you can add yourself.

■ Meal log
Date and time, weaning stage, the foods, how much was eaten and how your baby reacted.
One photo per meal, plus a note if you want.
The stage follows your baby's birthday and moves through Early, Middle, Late and Final
on its own, or you can set it yourself.
Pick a food already marked Allergic and the app tells you before it saves.

■ Calendar and stats
Tap any day in the calendar to see that day's meals, and fill in past days you missed.
Stats cover this week and this month: new foods tried, meals logged, the foods your
baby ate well and the ones that did not go down.

■ A reminder so it does not slip
Once a day at the time you choose, if a food is still being watched.
Change the time or turn it off whenever you like.

■ Everything stays on this device
No account, no sign in. What you write stays on the device and is never sent to a
server. It works the same with no connection at all.

■ Premium (one time purchase)
No ads
Multiple babies
CSV export
Home screen widget

The app follows your system theme, or you can pick light or dark yourself.

The guidance in this app is based on general information about starting solids.

name: NutriSpy: Food & Symptom Diary
description:
NutriSpy is a food diary that finds what sets off your symptoms. A symptom that keeps coming back, a bad gut day, an afternoon with no energy — and no idea what caused it. Log what you eat, how you slept and how you feel, and NutriSpy puts it all on one timeline and shows you likely triggers. Verifiable from week one, in your own days.

Make sense of your symptoms

Complaints often trail their trigger by hours, so memory alone rarely finds the connection. NutriSpy records meals and symptoms with their times and shows which habits and foods go with your better and worse days — more fat in the evening, a shorter night, fewer steps — what settles your digestion, and what leaves you drained. It is honest about how strong each pattern is — a hunch is labelled a hunch.

A food diary that fits your life

Log meals, symptoms, bowel movements, sleep, activity and supplements by voice, photo, barcode or text — one sentence is enough, NutriSpy structures it. Sleep and workouts sync from Apple Health or Health Connect, so your diary fills itself while you live your day.

See what actually helps you

Whether you want to calm your digestion, get to the bottom of a symptom, have more energy or sleep better, NutriSpy shows which foods and habits help and which hold you back. Your daily form tells you at a glance how the day is going, and a coach tip tells you what to try next. Want to lose weight or build muscle instead? Calories, protein and your weight trend sit side by side, with a calorie target that follows your goal. Full nutrient data sits underneath: calories, macros, fiber, vitamins, minerals, omega-3/6 and supplements. Fiber is counted under every meal, soluble and insoluble separately.

Find your triggers

NutriSpy connects nutrition, digestion, symptoms, sleep, activity and cycle, and highlights the relationships that matter for you — "your bloating tends to follow high-fat evenings", not generic averages. A bowel movement or a symptom takes seconds to log and becomes part of the picture instead of another chore.

No pressure to be perfect

You don't have to log everything, every day. Miss a day and your insights still work — this food diary is built for real life, not streaks. Share your log with your doctor or coach whenever it helps.

Free food diary, Premium insights

The food diary is free, AI logging included: meals, symptoms, bowel movements, sleep and supplements by voice, photo or text, with calories and macros. Premium adds the insights: which foods and habits go with your symptoms, the full nutrient and FODMAP analysis with lactose, fructose and the polyols, six months of sleep trends, a coach tip on every entry, sync back to your health app, and a CSV or PDF report for your doctor. For IBS, food intolerance, histamine or heartburn, that makes your food log a symptom tracker. Prices in the app.

Important: NutriSpy is not a diagnostic tool and should not be used for medical diagnoses, treatments, or as a substitute for professional medical advice. Always consult qualified healthcare professionals for health concerns or medical decisions.
